comments: I had a lovely time staying at Eleanor's apartment in Southie. She is hospitable, super laid back and made me feel comfortable and well situated. Cowboy the dog is a big sweetie and only added to my experience. I was in town for a conference and it was seamless to get to the convention center area from here. Would definitely recommend.

This was my first time using airbnb and decided to use it since my husband's parent would be with us and we wanted to all stay together.  We had a great time staying at Lev's place. The location was absolutely perfect and the house met our needs. We were provided with everything we needed and were able to rest comfortably, much better than staying in a hotel.

Salman was a very accommodating host. He greeted us with tea and snacks and made sure check in and check out worked for our schedule. The patio was lovely and the overall space was clean and pleasant. We definitely appreciated the advice with parking and getting around the area.

Sachin's charming Boston apartment was absolutely perfect for my conference at the Hynes Convention Center. It is centrally located, and was safe for walking back at night. Sachin was very helpful both leading up to and during my stay. Even while traveling, he made sure to check-in to see if I needed anything. He also recommended some lovely tourist sites. I would certainly recommend Sachin as an AirBnb host.

My friend and I got to stay at 26 Preble for one night and I am glad we chose this airbnb. Jason and Steph are amazing host. When we first arrived Jason helped us carrying our 5 suitcases up the stairs and showed us around. Since there wasn't anyone staying the night before we were even able to check in early. 
The room is really nice and as it was already said, even snacks, bottled water and a kettle are provided. 
Jason even offered to get up at 6 o'clock to bring our luggage downstairs.
The apartment is super close to the T and only two stations from Boston Common.
We had a really nice stay and would recommend this Airbnb to everyone who wants to stay in Boston.

Lovely building and unit, very comfortable for our stay in the Navy Yard. Nitzan was a welcoming host and met us promptly, and was responsive quickly to any needs. He also graciously left us some food basics and coffee makings, which was very much appreciated.

What a beautiful home, and such nice people! I wish I'd had more time to spend with Bruce and Barry. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and they were so willing to go above and beyond to make me feel comfortable. Highly recommended.

Rachel has been an excellent host and very easy to reach even when away. She has put a lot of love and effort into her home and we thoroughly enjoyed it. Even our 3 year old child was at awe and loved the place. It was clean with very easy instructions and recommendations for things to do. We wish we stayed longer to enjoy the city. While our trip was marred with mishaps, Rachel's place made us feel at home. Highly recommended. We would not hesitate staying here again.

Very nice, quiet, clean home. The location is excellent, a short walk to great restaurants and amenities.
Finola and Damon were more than accommodating, made sure we felt right at home. 
We'll definitely be calling again, the next time we're in town!

I had a wonderful stay at Danielle's place. Some of the major pluses were: 1. it is literally right next to the T. Get down and walk 3 minutes to the house right in front. This made it extremely convenient to go downtown and back. 2. The house is very new and spanking clean--it was the closest to a nice 4 star hotel-style look and feel  I've been in. And finally 3. Danielle was a very friendly hostess.
I highly recommend a stay here.

Bruce and Barry were exceptionally gracious hosts and were very helpful as we planned our days in Boston.  We enjoyed getting to know them as well as staying in their lovely, interesting home.  We especially enjoyed interacting with the other, international people staying in this home.  Our room was comfortable, decorated with flair, and the breakfast choices varied.  Several beautifully updated bathrooms were available to us, so their use was always convenient.  

We were easily able to access the train system to get to all points in Boston we wished to see.  We felt very safe walking in the neighborhood, even after dark.  Parking was provided for our rental car at the house and we didn't need to use it during our stay.

We highly recommend this Airbnb home to anyone interested in traveling to the Boston area.

We had a wonderful experience at Byron's condo in the heart of the North End.  Very clean and suited our needs perfectly.  The only drawback was the amount of weight I put on eating at all the wonderful restaurants.

My husband and I greatly enjoyed the time we spent with Lucia in her comfortable home. Her neighborhood is very peaceful, but still accessible to the rest of Boston. The guest room is very well-kept and the bed is SO comfortable! Lucia was a very welcoming host that made us feel at home- her dog, Angus, is also great : ) We would definitely stay at Lucia's house again!
The appartment was just awesome!  Perfect location!  Generous host that provided the appartment with goodies and beverages.  Parking is easy in the street during week-ends.

This home exceeded my expectations.  A beautiful home in a beautiful neighborhood.  I've made many trips to Boston this year for work but never really got the chance to explore since I stayed in hotels less than a mile from work.  I had an opportunity to stay two weeks including a weekend this trip.  This home's location was a perfect hub to explore from.  I felt like I finally had a true Boston experience during this stay.

Besides being in a perfect location, the home itself is amazing!  I had employees in town from out of country staying with me for the two weeks.  My family also came up for part of it.  The house was plenty big for all of us with 5 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, large living areas, etc.  It was very clean upon arrival.  We had a printout from Peter with details on the house and suggestions for places to go in the neighborhood.  Communication with Peter before, during and after the stay was easy.

The park across the street was a relaxing place to visit and had free events going on almost everyday during my stay.  I felt very safe wandering around the neighborhood and park at night.  I couldn't ask for anything better for this trip.

Thank you so much Peter.  I hope we can make a similar arrangement again in the future.

--Joe
Perfect location and lovely well maintained modern apartment, warm and welcoming.

I stayed at Cindy's for a weekend and loved it. The neighborhood is wonderful with tons of restaurants and shops. The apartment itself was very nice and comfortable. Cindy was responsive leading up to and through our stay. Would definitely stay here again!

Chelsea was very flexible and responsive. Her place is perfectly located near the famous Commonwealth Ave. and Newberry St. The place was also clean and comfortable, which is very important. She was kind to let us keep our luggage there for the day (our flight wasn't until the afternoon) while we explored the city after checking out. Loved the decor too!! :) Thanks Chelsea!

We absolutely loved staying at this homy and comfy apartment which was just perfect for a group of 5 adults (even 6 would work out perfectly). 

I can't stress enough how warm and cordial the welcome was (delicious homemade banana bread) and post-it to explain all important stuff you Need to know.  Jeff and Rachel were so helpful and flexible, although we unfortunately did not even meet them in Person. 

Great place, if you want to be away from the city rumble and still be in the city in around 30 minutes.
The Kelly house was the perfect base for us in Boston. Lots of space and a big back yard to grill in. Walkable to JP amenities and the arboretum.  Best spot!!!

Jason kept us up to date before our arrival with lots of suggestions for things to do, restaurants, and points of interest.  The apartment was clean and the location could not have been better or easier to get to from the airport. We would highly recommend this location if you are planning a visit to Boston.  As they say in Boston it was wicked good.

I loved my stay with Gerard and Marie.  They were very friendly, welcoming and helpful.  The apartment was comfy, immaculately clean, charmingly furnished, and in a nice neighborhood of Charlestown.  I was able to get to the T easily, and it was a quick, pleasant walk to some nice restaurants and convenience stores.  Be sure to plan a brunch at The Grasshopper, a cozy breakfast place just around the corner.  I hope to visit Boston again soon, and would definitely stay with Gerard and Marie again.

Heather was very friendly as she  greeted us with the keys and was flexible with our arrival time. The apartment was in a great location and had everything we needed to enjoy the holiday weekend. I would definitely recommend!

Andreas house was beautiful, in a great location, and we felt very welcome there- Andrea and her family went out of the way to make us feel at home and we loved every second of our stay! The room is beautiful, clean and comfortable and very interesting! We would definitely come again.

Eleanor is very responsive, friendly, and has a nice, clean place, and the bed is truly very comfy!  The air conditioning was on all day for us so we could arrive in a cool room on a hot day. The neighborhood has places in walking distance, and it's a short drive to the airport if you're traveling, as we were.

We've spent a very great time at Lyralen and Judy's, the room was comfortable and cosy, the appartment si very quiet. Very easy to go in Boston dowtown with the subway, ten minutes walking. Thank you Lyralen and Judy, we appreciated talking with you during breakfast time !

We had an excellent stay at Christine's apartment. The apartment is very spacious for the city, clean, and has an amazing large bathroom. She also has a nice flat screen TV with VCR/DVD player. The process was very easy to stay with her. The location of the apartment is perfect, close to both the subway and bus system, is on a side street with little traffic, and a half block from a very nice park. The stay was wonderful!!

My stay at Jazz's was great. The room and the loft were perfectly clean. Jazz is nice, welcoming and helpful.
It was the second time I used Airbnb. My first experience was awful and Jazz completely changed the apprehension I had. I hope we will meet again in the future.

Lev is a great host- super easy to coordinate with and excellent in every way to make us feel at home. The apt was exactly as stated and amenities are wonderful. I would highly recommend Lev and this apt to anyone. Airbnb had in mind hosts like Lev as the exemplar for the business.

Jez and Ken are great hosts!  They went above and beyond the call of duty in making my stay fantastic .  I rarely give anyone a perfect score when rating them but Ken and Jez come pretty close.  I really enjoyed the location of their place so close to the ocean.  Great dining close by and very easy to get into Boston proper.  Their room is lovely with a very comfortable bed.  If you are coming to Boston  would certainly tell you to consider staying with Jez and Ken.  I certainly will be the next time I get to Boston.

Everything was perfect. Kristin's description of where she lived was exactly what we got. Her place was clean and neat with everything you could need. My husband and I liked the location in the navy yard  because it was quiet and only a $3 and 10 minute ferry ride to downtown. Much better alternative to a hotel! Plus, Kirstin's communication with me was fast and always answered my questions. Thank you!
strongly recommended for travelers, the location is convenient as  it is a shopping district which near from copley and prudential mall (1 block walking), cafes, mini market, and train station.

We didn't actually meet Robin, but everything was really clearly explained on notes in the apartment so we felt very well informed.  The apartment was fill of interesting curios and books, with plenty of games, places to sit and things to do to while away the hours, so it would have been very easy to stay there particularly as Boston was the last leg of our travelling journey and we were quite tired. However we did drag ourselves away to visit Boston and all the sights, and this was definitely worth the effort.

This apartment is close to perfection! Honestly, my husband and I are quite picky, but there's really not much we can say here!
It is spotless, comfortable, charming, located near to Copley square, in a very quiet street, etc.
If we really want to find something which is not perfect, I would say that the air conditioning unit (which is in the bedroom) is a bit noisy, and curtains would be a nice addition to the white blinds in order to darken the rooms for sleeping.
But really, what a great couple of days we had there!

Lucia's home is in a great location, close to transportation and Jamaica Pond. It's quiet and clean with its unique old house charm. Natalia is a great person to occasionally hang out with, since she has been quite busy with her lab work during my stay. The bed is very comfortable, and there's plenty of space in the room. I really felt at home during my stay, where I get watch tons of TV and cook my own meals. If I ever come back to Boston, I'll try to stay with Lucia again :)

Peter was a perfect host! He was there to welcome me, tell me about the area and offered tips for using public transit. The room was clean and bright with a private full bathroom (bathtub, shower, sink) and a private deck. The location is walking distance to the Boston Conference Centre and to many restaurants. I highly recommend this Airbnb!

Daniel was very kind from the beginning and always available to provide useful informations. The loft is awesome and it's 5 mins walking from the tube, absolutely perfect for who's visiting Boston. Absolutely recommended to everyone!
Susan kindly hosts my parents while they visit me. It is a very nice cottage in a quiet neighborhood. Susan has everything nice and comfortable for my parents to stay. Recommend for 1~2-person trips.

Tessa was the perfect host. I stayed at her place to take the bar exam (the venue was within walking distance, as opposed to where I live way out in the suburbs) and when she handed off the keys she was the sweetest. She left some nibbles in the fridge, wrote me a little welcome card, and gave me the contact info of a friend who'd just become a lawyer. Tessa is a peach, just lovely. Hopefully I won't need to take the exam again, but if I do I know where I'm staying! The place is clean, well-appointed, and cozy.

It was my first time using Airbnb and my stay could not have been better. The Room and House were really beautiful and Chris is a very nice person and a perfect host.

Es war das erste Mal, dass ich Airbnb genutzt habe und mein Aufenthalt hätte nicht besser sein können. Das Zimmer und das Haus waren wirklich schön und Chris ist war sehr nett und ein perfekter Gastgeber.
Had a great time at Boston/Cambridge staying at Lev's. Great location, room and apartment was clean and well-kept, easy communication with the host. Couldn't ask for more!

Terry made our week-long stay in Boston go so smoothly, from great restaurant recommendations to showing us around the local area and how to use the T! The perfect host all round!

His apartment is clean, beautiful with all the home comforts to help you get settled in quickly.  Located in a great neighbourhood, very close to the T and a short walk to the main city bars and restaurants.  Also a real treat for any Joan Miro fans!

Plotting a return trip already!

Adam has a nice apartment, well located for the Green and Orange T line and Boston sights. The apartment is well maintained and has a great kitchen. Adam was friendly and welcoming, we recommend his place!

Andrew and Katie provide a great space for the weary traveler.  We had not only comfortable bedroom and bath, but also a T.V. lounge room which had a relaxing and cushy couch.  The location to Boston Logan Airport and downtown Boston can't be beat! We'd stay again if our travels ever take us back to Boston.  Ruth & Allan

Lia was an incredible host! Her apartment is in the perfect location to explore Boston! It's an easy walk to most places or a very short uber ride of you don't feel like walking. There are tons of cute places around her apartment to eat and shop! She answered all our questions very quickly and even gave us some recommendations before our weekend! She provided us with all the essentials we needed for a great weekend.

My stay at Shawn's place was great. The room I got is spacious and comfortable and everything was as described. Bathroom was also very good. House is at walking distance from a T station and is fairly easy to get from there to the main points in the city. I unfortunately did not manage to interact personally with Shawn, but our online conversation was always very nice and friendly. Shawn replied to my messages pretty quickly and was always very helpful. I definitely recommend his place.

Que dire sur Molly and Ben... Des hôtes vraiment adorables, prêt à renseigner, à aider ! Molly parle vraiment très bien le français.
L'appartement est très bien situé, à 5 min de la station de métro, et en a peine 10min vous êtes dans le centre!
Très propre, nous avions notre chambre (avec tv et ordi) et une salle de bain privative!
Accès à la cuisine et aux machines (lave linge et sèche linge).
Vraiment enchanté de nos 4 nuits chez eux, on conseille vivement.
Maya saura aussi Vous accueillir!

Perla's place was beautiful and in such a good location. Just parked for the weekend on the street and took the blue line into the north end one or two stops. No dealing with the traffic or tight streets of Boston. The porch with the view of Boston is nice to just wake up and take in the view. Quiet neighborhood by the water and definitely an up to date apartment with great taste in décor. Perla was very helpful when we needed and arriving and leaving was super smooth. Definitely will come back here to stay when I need to stay in the area again!

Bob's home is beautiful, very well appointed and met all our needs.  Snacks and cool drinks awaiting our arrival were much appreciated by weary travellers! As were the very comfortable beds! The unit's location & neighbourhood is terrific - we even got street parking right outside for 2 cars. A lovely walk into the centre of town or an quick economical cab ride.
We would love to return to Boston and would definitely stay at 42 Mystic again.  Thanks Bob!

From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect! Stuart greeted us and showed us the adorable studio apartment. It was the perfect size for us. We love to cook, so the kitchen was absolutely perfect for us too! The space is bright, airy, and has tons of victorian character.  

The neighbourhood of Jamaica Plain is a little out of the way of the downtown core of Boston, but VERY close to the subway and buses. 

We were SO impressed by their hospitality, and will definitely be recommending them to all of our friends and family. Thank you Helen, Stuart, Faith, and Carl for being such wonderful hosts.

Beautiful apartment close to everything!  We went to Bunker Hill a couple of times and to the Warren Tavern which is not to be missed!  My daughter and son-in-law loved going to places where The Town was filmed!  The apartment is clean with more than enough amenities to make your stay comfortable.  Can't wait to go back!

My experience staying in Hyde Park was great and perfect for the circumstances in which I was looking for a temporary place to stay in for the week until I could move into my graduate student apartment. The house was clean, and peaceful. I was gone for the most of the day due to obligations, but if I needed anything, Aisha was always readily available and quick to respond back via text or phone to assure that everything was good and that we were enjoying our stay and comfortable. If you desire more privacy, or your simply tired, Aisha's place is perfect for the latter as she was definitely not intrusive and respectful of our space. The location is also extremely convenient only being a short walk away from the commuter rails and bus stops in Fairmount and Hyde Park area. In addition, you are also only a short walk from the grocery store and restaurants that have plenty to offer whether you desire Caribbean, Italian, or American. The Fairmount Grille is nice, I definitely enjoyed their brunch and live jazz and blues on Sundays. The only suggestion I have is to perhaps have a tea kettle available for hot tea or coffee in the morning. I would definitely stay again and recommend, thanks!

We had a wonderful experience with James and his place. He warmly greeted us as soon as we were accepted. A day before our stay, he reached out and gave us all the details on where to find the key and made himself available to any questions we had. We didn't arrive until late, and he still made sure we got in ok. The place was perfect for the two of us. Clean, safe, and in a great location. It is in the heart of the Italian district of North end, so we were surrounded by food, cafes, and history. The place had everything we needed for our stay in Boston. We highly recommend and will stay here again!

My girlfriend and I traveled to Newton in search of a private cabin. We desired a space sporting both a rustic aesthetic and modern amenities; a winter getaway in a quiet, beautiful town that was within driving distance of Boston's nightlife.
Susan's Cabin met all these criteria and surpassed our expectations. Thank you for a wonderful trip!

Sincerely,

Maxwell

Robin is a fantastic host who immediately made us feel welcome (post-midnight no less) and accommodated every single one of our requests throughout our stay.  The listing is lovely.  We had our own balcony overlooking a wonderful park and ancient trees.  There was a beautiful skylight above the bed, and I had some great naps with the rain tap-tapping away above.  There is an HD Television with full cable access, high speed wifi, and ample closet space.  Most important, the bathroom was clean, beautiful and private en-suite.  Robin also provides off-street parking, which made our lives so much easier.  Robin has a wonderful family that will give you all the privacy you desire but will also happily engage should you be so inclined.  I have been to Boston many times before but never experienced it as a resident.  I must say its a wholly different experience and Brookline has some of the highest  standards of living I have seen anywhere.  Exquisite parks, friendly neighbors and some great restaurants.  This was my first Airbnb experience and was highly positive in every way.  Thanks Robin and Airbnb!

Tiffany is a great and nice host. She made the place very clean and nice. We also like the design and decoration of the place very much. The location of the place is very convenient: next to Boston Common and many other attractions. Also, near public transportation. We highly recommend Tiffany's place.

A wonderful family to stay with.  The room is on the top floor and has a window air conditioner.  Very comfortable bed!  Everything clean. The neighborhood is safe and plenty of parking on the street.  I would recommend.

Bruce and Barry are two of the nicest people I've had the pleasure of meeting! All weekend they made sure I was well fed and had everything I needed; it was like being at home. Their house is absolutely beautiful, clean, and orderly and the neighborhood is very quiet and everyone I encountered in the area was very friendly. There are several awesome places to eat within walking distance and nearby subway access. If you are looking for a place to stay, this is it!
Jay is very nice. His place locates in a great neighborhood. The location is convenient, the subway is within 2 blocks. We really enjoy our stay here.

Julie's place could not have been better in terms of EVERYTHING. Great spot in the middle of it all. The apartment is very cozy, quaint and beautiful. Julie was excellent with her communication. I will definitely stay here again!

Donny and Chris were great hosts. Very helpful with detailing the fine things Boston had to offer. Beautiful well appointed apartment in South Boston. Parking in the area mostly requires a resident permit except on weekends. There is a modern well run parking garage a short walk from there apartment.  Nice classic style diners in the neighborhood as well as a Starbucks, Boston sports club just a short distance away. Well connected with bus and subway. Great experience.

The Carneys were wonderful hosts. The house was beautiful  and clean. The neighborhood was safe and pleasant.  We hope to
stay there again for upcoming visits to the Boston area!

I had a short but lovely stay with Mary and Barney. The room was just what I needed, and the house was spotless, charming and had everything you'd need. Even though there were a few other guests staying in the house, you wouldn't know it - it was very quiet and peaceful. It's about a 10 minute walk to the T station which was very convenient, and I loved being able to run along the waterfront which was a short jump away. I didn't have much time to explore the neighbourhood but it felt very safe. Wish I'd been able to stay longer - and enjoy another muffin, delicious! Thanks for the great stay, I look forward to staying with you again the next time I come to Boston!
A quiet, romantic oasis in one of the most picturesque areas of hectic Boston! There aren't enough superlatives to describe these accommodations and the host.

The cottage in Newton was perfect for us, and we are so lucky to have found it.  Susan added some special touches to the cottage that made it even more special. The location was perfect, with a stop right in front of the house that took us right into Boston. Susan was super easy to work with and went out of her way to make our stay wonderful. I would highly recommend the Newton Cottage for anyone looking for a nice, quiet space that is close to all Boston activities.

Tiffany was such a courteous and responsive host. She went above and beyond to accommodate my arrival, even picking up a clothes steamer(!) The loft is comfortable and clean, the building is secure, and you can't beat the location if you are visiting Boston. Highly recommend!

Mohsen was very prompt amd professional in his communication. He reached out to me with directions to his place well ahead of time. Unfortunately, I had to cancel the trip at the last moment due acessive delay in the schedule. He was cognisent of the situation and kind enough to offer a discount next time.

91 Perkins St is a beautifully renovated older brick built property with all the amenities you need. After staying for the last 5 weeks through some of the most brutal winter weather I can say the apartment is very cosy and homely whilst still being light and airy. One of the best things is the car parking space! When the whole of Boston is fighting for any space dug out of the snow, it is such a relief to have a magically cleared private parking space. John and Gerry are lovely and will really look out for you. Its only a short walk to Sullivan Square Orange T-line and not too far to get to Assembly Square outlet stores and Restaurants overlooking the river. The only small criticism I can give it is the bedroom wall can feel a little thin at times between the apartments (mainly due to the neighbouring room being a baby's room at the time of my stay!), however I still highly recommend it as a modern and very comfortable residence in Boston.

Elegance at Salem Street more than surpassed our expectations. The apartment was very clean and comfortable and Elizabeth was the perfect host. She got the balance perfect between catering for our needs and letting us enjoy our privacy. The neighbourhood turned out to be an oasis in a busy city and after long sightseeing days we were perfectly happy to dine in the many fine restaurants we found in Charlestown. We would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone planning a visit to Boston.

I had an awesome stay at Enzo's place last weekend! Enzo was incredibly hospitable and welcoming, and his place was perfect. He made sure he was available on my arrival, and took the time to demonstrate how to use the keys to get in and out, and check that I knew how to get around on the T, even providing me a handy reference map. When my plans changed and I had to leave a day early, he was very accommodating and even let me stash my backpack at his apartment for the day before my train arrived. The room was great, and the bed was extremely comfortable. If you're looking for a spot in the North End, definitely check him out!

Wonderful host, comfortable home, convenient location. Alice was in touch with me before my arrival to make sure that I would find everything I needed. She made me feel right at home. The room was very comfortable and the private bath was great. Alice provided fresh fruit, yogurt, water and more in a little refrigerator in the room. Her big kitchen was available for breakfast. Her home is very close to Boston University and the Green Line. I was visiting my son (a BU student) and was thrilled to find such a lovely, convenient place to stay. I would certainly stay there again! Great experience!

This apartment was just as the site and other reviews suggest. Beautifully decorated and in a great location. I stayed for two nights with my husband and three young children. Jason was an attentive and generous host. 
Everything is very easy - from getting the keys, to finding the extra air bed for my child. The beds are comfy and the apartment has everything you need for a stay. It's a professional set up that I would highly recommend either for a family, couple or individual when in Boston.

This was our third time at Stacy's place and it continues to be our favorite place to stay in Boston when we come up there for work. Everything was perfect, as always, even though she and her family were away in Spain! Check in was seamless and Stacy and her husband were very attentive all the way from Madrid when there was a small problem with one of their TV's! We will always want to stay there when we are in town but this treasure is starting to get tough to book with so many others discovering it. We continue to love the neighborhood and it's central location.

Tim and his wife were so welcoming and friendly. As their posting had mentioned, we had access to the kitchen and to the upstairs balcony which had a beautiful view. We received Wi-Fi access which was super helpful for us to get directions around the city. The room with it's own access was very convenient and our stay overall was amazing. The extra little snacks that were provided was very thoughtful!

Eran was very helpful to me prior to my arrival.  He responded to my emails quickly and provided great information.  I arrived to a bowl of chocolates and a very clean and neat apartment.  I tried several of the restaurants Eran recommended and also took a walk around Jamaica Pond, which is absolutely beautiful.  I was in town for a workshop and walked everywhere, love the town of Jamaica Plain and appreciated the laid back feel of a town so close to Boston!  I was traveling alone and felt 100% safe at all times.  It was a privilege to have such a wonderful home to stay in during my visit to Jamaica Plain.  I would highly recommend it!

The studio was very nice, a bit dark, but with everything that you could need for a comfortable stage. The bed is really comfortable, the shower very nice, the wifi works perfectly. Some noise from the condition air machines of the neighbourgs disturbs during the night, but this is not the owner's fault. M was very helpful and friendly, she even agreed to extent my check out time until 5pm according to my flight schedule and provided all the information I requested. Although we did not meet personally, she was always available and made communication very easy. The neeighbourghood is outstanding, very centric and safe and definetly appropriate for visiting Boston. Summarizing, an excellent place . I will not doubt to book it again if going back to Boston.
Staying at Megan and Stephen's place was absolutely wonderful. Megan is very responsive and clear with instructions. The place is spotless and beautifully decorated. I would definitely stay again!

Apartment was beautiful. Loved the building complex with the pool and gym - great having a concierge when we had a quick question. Apartment is exactly as described in the reviews - clean, bed is fantastic, absolutely everything we needed. Location was perfect - close to Boston common where we walked the freedom trail and close to lots of great restaurants. We loved Boston and would definitely stay here if we come back again.

I had a great experience at this place. It is beautiful and very nicely appointed and the neighborhood is great. It not only looks as described - it is better. The location also perfect for Boston - close to the downtown and the Hines convention center, and you can walk to Cambridge Kendall Square area, making it an excellent alternative to the expensive hotels there. I was on a short business trip for a meeting in Cambridge and I found it much better than staying there. Jason and Nicole where in touch with me during the process, making sure they know when I was arriving. Jason meet me at the apartment when I arrived, and explained everything. I would definitely stay here again in my next trip to Boston/Cambridge.
Erik and Traci are great hosts ! They're very welcoming and nice and their kids are adorable. The place is very clean, well located and looks like the pictures.
Great stay, and nice meeting you Lev!

Had an incredible visit at Bruce's home. The photos don't give the house justice. This was one of the more unique places I have stayed but also one of the more memorable. Bruce is a fantastic host and felt more like an old friend then a stranger whose home I was staying in. Both Bruce and Barry were very helpful in giving directions (and even a ride) to the nearby T Station. I would recommend this home to anyone looking to stay in Boston. Also felt very safe, as two females traveling alone it can be a bit intimidating staying in a new city but never once did either of us worry. Felt very safe and taken care of. Thanks Bruce and Barry!

Very appreciative of my 2-day stay with Lynne and Eric and their family. I'm still new to Airbnb happily seeing a pattern of good-hearted warm and welcoming hosts. They made me feel most welcome - private when I wanted to be - and great conversations when we shared  cappuccinos and breakfast. The room was huge! The private bathroom is a walk from the bedroom - but worth every step: brand new - beautifully designed and built & a killer shower. Their dog Gracie wins the sweetest pet award. Highly recommended. Close to Boston and all its burbs.

Justin and Heidi's place was the perfect experience. We had everything we could need and loved the roof deck. We walked everywhere and loved the Charlestown neighborhood. Will definitely look to stay here again when we return
Always a joy starting here! The house is beautiful and Ken and Jez make you feel right at home! Wonderful bnb, I highly recommend it!
Everything was exactly as pictured/described. The neighborhood and apartment were both clean, quiet and convenient. Very enjoyable experience.

The place was gorgeous and very clean. We were not arriving until after midnight and Jason arranged a lockbox so we could get in. I would highly recommend this place to others. Great back bay location and very convenient to all Boston has to offer.!
Fanatastic hosts and excellent location to take in Boston's sights. Katrina and Andy welcoming and attentive to any need. Plus, their puppy is absolutely adorable. Highly recommend!

John was truly a gracious host, and his apartment is spectacular.  I'm reluctant reviewing positively, however, as I want to make sure it is available whenever we return to Boston!  Thank you so much for your accommodations!

Lev made my first Airbnb experience to be a very pleasant and unforgettable one. His apartment is clean and cozy as shown in the picture provided in the post. I was able to go out to dinner and go shopping due to the great location of his apartment which is a short walking distance from the MBTA Red Line (Charles/ MGH.) We kept in contact through text and he replied quickly to any inquiries plus I was able to meet him and made my stay be memorable and fun.

Having lived in Boston years ago, we wanted our kids to experience the city just as we had. Jeff's apartment was in an ideal location for getting the most out of our short stay. His apartment is beautifully appointed and spacious with high-end amenities. The roof top deck was a great place to relax and unwind. Jeff was very helpful, accommodating and always quick to respond to our questions. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
My husband and son spent really great time in Ray's house. That made their journey in Boston more wonderful. It's a big house and they really appreciated to live there.
Just as described. Lovely street on the edge of the Boston University Campus. Lots of amenities around.  Jason was very gracious and responsive.

We felt welcome in Lisa's home from the moment we arrived. We flew into Boston in the morning and she allowed us to check in early. She met us at the door and showed us around. There were many great amenities (Charlie card, light breakfast, coffee, snacks, water, toiletries, etc.). The best thing was the the great advice Lisa gave us on transportation, places to visit, and restaurants. The bus stop right outside the front door was great too, especially with the included Charlie Card! We enjoyed our time in Boston and our first Airbnb stay. We would definitely visit again and stay with Lisa again.
A very great place to spend his vacation. Toll and lovingly decorated, we were unfortunately only one night. Almost like a hotel from the equipment, for sale should, you ought to forgive 6 star.

The place was perfect for our needs. It was clean and comfortable. The concierge service was top notch. When we had a glitch in our plans they stepped right up to help out and Dave was an excellent host. Very easy transaction for our first airbnb experience.

Jen's apartment is the perfect destination for a city getaway whether you're in town for a conference or to have fun. The space is spotless and vert nicely appointed, complete with a very comfortable bed, ample closet space, kitchen amenities, bottled water and even wine. I made use of the private terrace, too. The apartment is conveniently located in a safe neighborhood close to great shopping and restaurants.

The location was fine. Just minutes to the train that allows access to the city.  Coffee shops and shopping and cafes.  Salman was very busy but still was always available by text. We had no problem with that. Many things to use, dishes, stove and the like.

We stayed with A & L over Memorial Day weekend, and what a lovely experience it was!   The 3rd floor suite with adjoining full bathroom was clean, fresh and has a great view of the JP neighborhood.    Our hosts were attentive and very helpful regarding nearby restaurants, sites, etc. and they welcomed us with shared breakfast goodies from a local bakery.    Finally, the location was fantastic, walkable to both Jamaica Pond and Centre Street.   We really enjoyed a Jamaica Plain Historic Society free walking tour, which are scheduled each Saturday during the summer at 11 AM.    Overall, we highly recommend A & L's B&B as a friendly oasis in JP.

Beautiful apartment in a modern building. Communication from Katie was very good. Katie kindly left some snacks and stocked the bathroom with toiletries which was a pleasant surprise as I was expecting to have to have to go out and buy these items. Highly recommended.

I had a wonderful experience staying in this condo.  It was just as beautiful as the photos.  It was clean and Jason made our stay so easy.  I was visiting Boston while taking my son on a college tour.  The location was perfect and just a short car ride to everywhere we wanted to go.  The neighborhood was safe and very accessible to the major roadways.  It was far better than staying in a hotel!  Having a washer and dryer available for our use was also a nice perk.  The bed was very comfortable.  Truly a wonderful experience.  I told Jason that if my son gets accepted to one of the colleges we saw in Boston, I will become a regular.

We loved our stay at The Brickhouse! It's in a lovely neighbourhood, easy access to the T; roughly 15 minutes into the city centre. The house was well equipped with everything you could possibly need, including coffee, tea and other store cupboard ingredients. There was even a large array of shampoos, shower gels etc. The house was spotlessly clean and very comfortable. We'd definitely stay again if we're back in Boston!

Jason and Stephanie were excellent hosts. Super nice,  knowledgeable about the area with all kinds of recommendations on where to eat and drink. Their home is very nice, modern, clean, and comfortable. They make you feel right at home with snacks and  drinks right in the room. The bed was super comfy, but the noise from the street in the morning woke me up. However, they do provide ear plugs if you decide you need them. Another thing I really appreciated was their house smelled amazing. It's also right around the corner from the red line, and right off the highway so it was convenient. I would highly recommend staying here, and I'm sure I will too next time I visit Boston!

Janel's home was lovely! My in-laws stayed with her for three nights and absolutely loved her place. It has beautiful views of the monument and is located in a great part of Charlestown. I would highly recommend this location!

Great apartment to stay in Boston. Cosy but big enough for 4 people. The apartment was very clean and fully equipped. Ethan was a great guest that was very helpful along the whole stay.
Totally recommended for a great stay in Boston!

Maria was a wonderful host.  Friendly and helpful without being intrusive.  Our room on the top floor was away from the main living area of the house and very quiet.  The overall atmosphere was very relaxed.  Queen size bed very comfortable.  Great neighborhood with a number of good places to eat nearby.  Easy walk to the T station and the free parking on the street was a convenient bonus.  Would recommend Maria's home without hesitation.

The place was great and filled with all sorts of wonderful amenities to keep you entertained. The neighborhood is serene but close to all the attractions Cambridge has to offer. Christopher was friendly, flexible, and helpful. Could not have asked for a better host. We would definitely stay here again!

Heather is probably the fastest host to answer questions through emails or airbnb messages. I planned to arrive early to check-in and Heather arranged everything for my early check-in. However, I couldn't make it on time and arrived later but everything went smoothly. I didn'T get the chance to meet Heather but the check-in process was flawless.  The place itself is huge and clean! it was perfect for our group of 4. The place had everything we needed. The neighborhood is very convenient and quite charming. We had our car and had no issue to find parking. If you need clean place for your group, I recommend this place.

Mark's place was great. We were travelling with an 11 month old baby and he had a highchair, change table and bed for the baby. Although the bed was set up for a young child we just turned it against the wall so our baby didn't escape. The apartment was close to public transport, shops and restaurants and was clean and tidy. If we are lucky enough to ever return to Biston we'd stay again.

Bruce and Barry were wonderful hosts.  The house was accommodating and in a great location close to the T.   This was my sister's first experience doing AirBNB and I was nervous of what she would think -- she loved it and loved the house.

This was our first time using AirBNB, so I was a little nervous.  Any apprehension went away as soon as we met Stephen and Megan.  They are amazing hosts!  They were very friendly, personable, and knowledgeable about the city.  The accomodations were great.  The bedroom and and bathroom are very well kept.  The bedroom and bathroom are also set aside, so it never felt like you were intruding on the hosts.  That also helped us have our own privacy.  

Next time we're in Boston, this will be the first place we'll look to stay.

We had a wonderful time at Maria's home. The room was very large, clean and comfortable. The bathroom was also large and very clean. It was REALLY quiet and we even slept in! Maria helped us find transportation and gave us ideas as to where to eat. She even let us use two of her umbreallas, which came in handy all day! It was easy to find, and we felt safe when we got back late at night. Thanks Maria and tell Harry hello, what a great kid!
Beautiful house, and clean room and bathroom. Great coffee and coversation!

A lovely home in a pleasant suburb of Boston.  5-10 minute walk to the 'T' where just a few stop away lies downtown Boston and connections to Cambridge.  A bit far from downtown, especially with the walk to the T, to come back in the daytime and then go out again at night.  Really pleasant family and the top floor, where a very large, comfortable room with your own bathroom is, couldn't be better.  Thank you very much!

This was a perfect weekend getaway! Everything about this home was excellent. The bed was very comfortable and we had more than enough closet space. The living area was lovely, with plenty of room for relaxing and a great range of seating. The kitchen was a great room too, and even the bathroom shower was beautiful!
 
We loved the page of suggestions for coffee shops, groceries, and restaurants as well as the useful transportation info. Nice to have so many options! This was a great location with easy walking to anything we needed; being very close to parks and beach areas was an unexpected bonus.  And nice to be within an easy walk to several bus lines.

The directions Kevin left for operating the air conditioning, lighting, ceiling fans, etc. were all user friendly.  We appreciated knowing details such as location of trash and exactly where to leave keys. Check in and check out both went smoothly. We will definitely stay here again when we visit our son in Boston if this condo is available!
These are amazing people and I absolutely loved staying in their home !!!

Paul was an outstanding host that went above and beyond to make our stay as comfortable as possible. He was extremely friendly while respecting our privacy. The accommodations were exactly as described and I would recommend Paul's place to anyone needing a place in Boston. Will stay here again.

The apartment was spacious and clean and well located. Very convenient for travel throughout Boston. The hosts were very helpful. Definitely would recommend this as a place to stay in Boston.  Thank you!

The place was better than I had hoped or imagined. I stayed for two weeks and was sad to leave. It was impeccably clean, had everything I needed, was quiet, in an ideal location, private, cute... honestly perfect. Bed was incredibly comfortable. I jogged along the river every morning (only a block away), walked to Harvard campus for work daily (5-10 min walk), and enjoyed the private terrace in the evenings. Craig was a perfect host -- available to answer questions or to say an occasional hello. But I also felt full respect, privacy, and autonomy. I'd recommend this place to anyone staying in Cambridge for any duration of time. What a gem. 10 stars. :)

We really, really, enjoyed our stay here. Chris and Kelly have a beautiful apartment that has everything you would ever need and more. 
The place is much bigger than it appears in the photos and all 4 of us we were extremely comfortable there. The both beds were wonderfully and the bathrooms amazing. I think I could spend all morning in that shower! 
The kitchen was both beautiful and functional. LOVED the coffee machine and there was plenty of milk and basics in the fridge for us. 
The location is perfect and you would hardly know you're downtown when you're in the apartment. 
We can't wait to come back!
Great experience.  Our family trip was a disjointed one,but Lyralen and Judy made us feel welcomed and "rolled with it!"

We had a very wonderful and enjoyable stay with Jez N Ken for our trip to Boston! The house is in a small and beautiful town, although not in the central of Boston but very close to the city and very easy to travel by public transportation. Additionally, facilities of the house are so comfortable to use. Hence, it is a perfect place for a visit to Boston! Apart from the location, the hosts are very kind, friendly and lovely; they offered us with all kinds of support that they could during the time we visited and really treated us as closed friends, they offered us nice coffee and cookies everyday in the morning before we went out.  
I would recommend their houses to anyone who is going to visit Boston, and of course happily visit them again if we have the next trip to there.

Lev was an excellent host. A very clean apartment - clean sheets, towels, bathroom and kitchen. He also gives a great rundown of local spots - places to eat, drink, and public transportation in the area. Lev was very responsive and easy to communicate with while we were planning our trip. Highly recommend!
Robert King is a gracious and thoughtful host and his home is wonderful:  Great bed, room/bath, house and location.  Extraordinary.

Jason was fantastic and his place is great! We had a pretty strange request: to come over to his place and watch a sporting event that we couldn't get at our hotel. He was more than helpful and extremely friendly. Clean place with a great TV.
My stay with Jazz couldn't have been more pleasant. The loft was spotless, and I immediately felt at home.
Chloe's place was great all around. Nice room, comfortable bed, pleasant apartment. The location was also good, with a pleasant and safe environment. Warm recommendation. Thanks Chloe.

The host is gracious, kind, and wonderful. They were accommodating to our needs and made sure that we were taken care of. The location is awesome, literally just a few steps away from a Train stop which takes you to the heart of Boston. The view of the Boston skyline is AMAZING! There is a park close by, and enjoyable walkways are also near.  The apartment is very modern, with a gym, an incredible lounge with multiple TVs and a pool table, and there is even a conference center if you wish to work. We have thoroughly enjoyed staying that this location. Everything was a win. Location + Hosts + Accommodation + Venue = an incredible experience.

Excellent experience overall - a lovely apartment in a truly fantastic part of town, a stay here will absolutely contribute to a quintessential Boston experience. The apartment itself is clean and well presented, having been recently refurbished. Really nice touches like a supply of Nespresso pods. All communication with Jason was very clear and easy to follow, great attention to detail.
Highly recommended!

This apartment is exactly as described and was perfect for myself and a couple family members. Christine is an excellent communicator with a noticeable love of her city and care for her home. The place has a fully equipped kitchen and living room with a great printed guide to the home and neighborhood and a small widescreen TV in the bedroom. It sort of has a cottage feel in the big city. There is no elevator however there are 2 flights of narrow stairs to navigate. The neighbors are nice and extremely quiet and the building is well maintained and safe. My family and I loved our stay 100%!
Great hostess. Extremely helpful. Fantastic location: Easily accessed by public transportation and great restaurants very nearby

I had a perfect stay at Danielle's place. The apartment is very nice, comfortable and it is located in one of Boston's best locations. Danielle is a wonderful host, always available for suggestions and for a chat. I fully recommend!

Susan and Stephen were very welcoming and had great information to make our stay as easy as possible. 
The location was great for access to Boston and journeys beyond such as Salem or Plymouth. Highly recommend this location for your stay in Boston.

Ethan was great host who was always responsive and flexible to our needs to make the trip as smooth as possible. The apartment was perfect and had everything we needed. Roof deck was a great way to spend an hour at the end of the day!

We had a great stay at Molly and Ben's flat. This was as discribed: easy from both AirPort and downtown, very clean and comfortable. Even if we have not seen our host much they were very nice and helpful before we come. I would recommand this place.

We had a really wonderful stay. Alice was a wonderful host, making sure we had everything we needed. The jewish bread was especially tasty and we really appreciated the strawberry's, eggs etc that were provided for our breakfast. Her home is really wonderful and grand. It's in a great location just a few minutes to a train and a close walk to some great cafes too.

I had a great experience staying at Boyd's place.
Very nice apartment, close to the airport and close to a ton of entertainment.  I would highly recommend staying here.

Ken and Jez were the kindest, most gracious hosts. Everything was perfect down to the finest detail. It was wonderful spending time talking to and getting to know these lovely people. They have a beautiful home, a genuine interest in new people, and they open up to their guests with true warmth. Thanks, guys!  -Ahmed and Javier

Our stay in The Pink Room was beyond awesome!  Starting from booking to check out, Andrea was readily accessible to answer any questions and always willing to help. When we arrived, she was there to personally greet us. She gave us a tour of the place and showed us all the details about the room.  And speaking of the room... So Awesome!  The lofted bed stole the show.  The shower is amazing. The entire house was great. 

Andrea is on my top 'favorite persons list' in the entire world. She is so amazing and spending time with her and in her home was an experience we will never forget. 

I strongly suggest The Pink Room to anyone traveling to Boston. It's a 5 minute walk to the T (Boston's subway), and you can get basically anywhere from that. If you are going to be there a few days, buy a week pass - it's like 19 bucks - definitely worth it. And if you have any questions about what to do, see, or go, Andrea knows!  Just ask her and she will tell you.

The listing was very accurate. The house was clean with fresh towels and speedy internet. What more could somebody want! The on-street parking was very helpful. Good value, definitely better than an over priced boston hotel. Only about a ten minute drive to cambridge.

Even though we didn't meet them in person, the hosts were very fast to respond and organise the key pickup.  The apartment was on a perfect location, very new and cosy, so both the hosts and the accomodation get highest marks.

Perfect location! Easy access to the T, in a beautiful neighborhood, close to MGH. The apartment was easy to find and there was guest street parking available a couple of short blocks away. Very clean and homey. Checking in/out was seamless and Christian was very easy to get in touch with.

Wonderful location in Beacon Hill. Close to restaurants and a short walk to the State House, Boston Common and one of the stops for the hop on hop off tourist bus route. Quiet but friendly and helpful host. Comfortable room and bed.  Apartment clean, tidy and quiet on the third floor so you need to be comfortable with stairs.
We would definitely stay with Lev again.

Helen made my daughter and I feel very welcome.  She was very good at keeping in touch before and during the visit to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed.  We loved the studio at the top of Helen's gorgeous house.  It was spotlessly clean and the breakfast food provided was lovely especially the homemade granola and the warm baked goods that appeared every morning.
Excellent location and wonderful hosts.  All your home away from home needs.  Very clean and comfortable.  Dale and Liz are more than helpful.  Would stay again and recommend to others.

My wife and I spent a week in Gene's apartment. We found everything we needed to feel well, the apt is quiet and fully equipped. The surrounding is absolutely picturesque and an ideal basis for a Boston visit. All kinds of services (laundry etc.) and restaurants available. Gene kept close contact and did everything to ensure uncomplicated check-in and check-out. A good experience!

Lev was great stay in your apt and you are an amazing host. thank you i hope i will get back to boston soon and definetly will stay in your penthouse....I will travel lighter this time.
thanks for all 
Emilia

Our stay in Boston was fantastic. Great communication from Linda leading up to our stay. Found the place easy, and instructions to get inside were clear and easy to follow. The place was beautiful, tidy, and clean. Handy to the metro and an easy and scenic walk down the Charles River into town as well. Very handy to Fenway Park, the Fine Arts Museum, and shopping on Newbury Street (great little coffee shop there called Barrington Roasters). Wouldn't hesitate to recommend Linda and her place in Boston.

I have been working in Waltham and Tia's place was perfect for me. She was the perfect host and made me very comfortable from the minute I walked in the door. The room was perfect for my needs. I was expecting the room to be a little bit on the small side,a s I am 6ft3, but it was perfect. Bed was comfortable, a very comfortable computer desk with wifi included. ....Yep...I will definitely be returning to visit Tia very soon !

Juan was very acommodating and helped us.
The apartment is iddeally located and very comfortable.
Great experience. Thanks Juan!!

Was a beautiful first airbnb-experience - the house is huge, well taken care of and pretty easy to get to via train. 
We were warmly welcomed and would have loved to be able to stay longer and be able to spend a little more time with Bruce and Barry!

Katie and Andrew were awesome hosts. I arrived really late and they arranged it so that I could get in without any problems. The guest area is super comfortable and very spacious. The rooms are kept really clean, and guests have all the privacy in the world. Pretty much all toiletries are provided for and K&A let you use the kitchen and their cutlery too. I would definitely recommend K&A, and would  stay with them again. And Sammy their dog is the calmest dog I've ever seen. She just wants you to pet her.

The hosts are very gracious.  The guest space occupies its own floor.  I found it quite private, attractive and airy.  The location allows easy access to much of Boston on public transit, and also to nearby natural areas at the Arnold Arboretum and Jamaica Pond.  I would enjoy staying here again.
Tiffany was a great host. Her place was very comfortable and perfectly located. Everything was well explained for the check in and check. We would recommend her place without hesitation.
This place is fantastic. She definitely knows how to treat her guests. Beautiful apartment with all the amenities you could want.

Staying at Jonathan's place was an amazing experience.

I visited Boston for a month. I needed to stay in a place nearby Longwood Medical Area (25 min walk, 18-20 min bus ride[Bus 66]) and I was lucky to find such a great place. It's also near a Metro/Subway/Train station and therefore you can visit Boston very easily.

Jonathan is a very warm host. He is always around when you need him, but also manages to give you privacy to concentrate in whatever you came to do. You usually meet other people who are staying in the house as well. I met approximately 4 different people, they where all very nice, helpful, quiet and clean.

The house and the room were impeccable. I stayed in a bedroom with a private bathroom, which was incredibly clean. You have your own desk, tv in your room and a comfortable sofa. To top it off there is fast wi-fi, washer and dryer and every kitchen appliance you will need.

Overall, Jonathan's house is the perfect place to stay. The host is very friendly and helpful. The roommates are very kind. The house and room is very neat and comfortable.

If you come to Boston, this is the place to stay.
Great spot! Key pick up is seamless, public transportation is close by, and Dave was super helpful and responsive.

We had a great stay here! We were accommodated when we needed to change our arrival time and were greeted by our host with a warm smile and a helping hand getting all our bags in the house. We sadly didn't have very much time to enjoy the house and the beautiful yard but we enjoyed our one night there just the same. This was a wonderful place to stay and Jez and Ken were great hosts. We would definitely stay again if we every get the opportunity.

Masha and Antoine were so accommodating with our last minute reservation request. They were constantly in contact and sent us tons of suggestions of what to eat and do in the area. Their beautiful home is even larger than it appears in pictures. Clean and stocked! Masha even left me some allergy pills :)  We loved playing with their cats, browsing through their books and records and finding the numerous hedgehogs they had around the home. Just a 20-30 minute trip from downtown Boston, and literally right across the street from the T, it was a perfect place to enjoy what it felt like to be a local. Thank you Masha & Antonie for providing us a lovely home for a wonderful weekend in Boston!

This is a fantastic apartment in a perfect location - within walking distance to all Boston center has to offer. Photos on website are very accurate. The view of Boston skyline at night is stunning. No complaints at all about Gualtiero's hosting - the communication was always clear, timely and very helpful.  He was organised, gave us a warm welcome and clearly cared about our experience. The apartment was very clean and we were provided with ample storage space. We stayed here for three weeks in the month of August. Some nights were challenging without AC, but there were plenty of fans.  I would love to come back here again sometime!

Perfect space and location for my recent weekend in Boston.  I was able to walk everywhere I needed to go and with Whole Foods being across the street, I even bought groceries and cooked a few meals in Lev’s kitchen. Between Lev’s hospitality, willingness to accommodate my early arrival time and his clean, comfortable apartment, I would definitely stay with Lev again.

Great spot and great host. Gene was very responsive and the apartment was just the right size for a single person or a couple. Nice and dark and quiet at night - I got the best sleep I've had in months. And you can't beat the north end for easy access to great restaurants.

My friends and I had such a great experience at Robert's place. When we arrived, he came to our door after we settled in and was so nice welcoming us into his home. He was very accommodating and even had food, snacks and beverages for us. The place was everything the website showed and more. We will definitely be back here again! Thank you Robert for contributing to such a wonderful birthday weekend! :)

We had a great visit. The flat was in a terrific location and just as advertised. Rachel was incredibly responsive and helpful. It was crazy hot in Boston that week and we really appreciated the AC! Only glitch for us was that I was recovering from a back injury so the third floor walk up aspect proved a bit challenging for me, but that's more about me than the place! Highly recommend.

The appartment was as described. It was really clean and comfy. We didn't met Helen but her husband Stuart welcomed us. We really felt like we were at home. It was really nice to have a breakfast and freshly baked muffins waiting for us in the morning.

The home was close to the metro station and I definitly would recommand this place to stay in Boston. We really enjoyed our time there. Thank you again !

We had the honor of being Jez & Ken's first guests with Airbnb! It was a wonderful experience. Their house is beautiful and the room was perfect – everything was perfect. They were wonderfully welcoming, helpful and thoughtful down to every last detail.  The neighborhood is very nice too, with a small beach just a couple of blocks away. It was the perfect bed and breakfast experience... adding a personal and a human touch to our stay that you will never find in a hotel. We enjoyed meeting their wonderful cats too. Generous, interesting, welcoming people in a beautiful, warm home situated in a charming, residential neighborhood.

We used two of Laura's apartments to put up short term contractors this fall/winter. Laura was very nice and easy to work with and always responded to my messages quickly. Both contractors enjoyed their stays and thought the apartments were in perfect condition and in a great location. I would absolutely work with Laura again!

Perfect location.  Quiet and yet so easy to walk around and enjoy the park, museums and restaurants.   Helen's tips (and snacks) made it even better.   We will try to book this place again when we are in town!

Perfect location in the North End. Complete quiet -- I didn't hear the slightest noise from the street or neighbors. Easy access to the front door key, even after my delayed flight got me there at 1:30 AM. Gene checked in on me to make sure everything was all right, which it was, in every detail.

As all the others reviews say, she is an incredible host. Texted me 2 days before asking what time id get there, in the day i got there she always wanted to make sure everything was according to the plans. when I actually got in her place, was introduced to the entire place, it all looked like new, really well organized, she is really neat, really friendly and warm. the room is exactly (or even better) as the picture. I had had only 7 hrs of sleep in the past 50 hours. so i all i wanted was a bed, with clean sheets and comfortable. What she had was exactly that. I slept for... 12 hours I think. Was really what I needed. In the other day i went to explore Boston, again she texted me asking if it was all good etc. when i got home we kept talking about random things, she is rly kind :D

about the facilities, bathroom perfect (sink was not working when i got there, so i needed to use downstairs, but the next morning the guy went there and fixed). bathroom was the cleanest ive seen in any airbnb place ive been. also was smelling good. she has a dog which i didnt even see, actually (stayed for 2 days). the dog kept in her room all the time, i think. for me wouldn't be a problem, i dont mind dogs, but even if you do, i dont think this is a problem.
oh! she also explained me all about how to go to the places i wanted to go, how to get back home using train or bus. btw, it's really close to the stops, 1min walking to a laundry place, 2min walking to a BK and other FF places...
if i ever come back to boston i dont even need to search for another place, this is where im staying (if possible lol). Totally recommend.

Paul was an excellent host!  Totally accommodating, considering we landed at 11 pm at night!  He even made us lasagna, which was amazing!  The apartment is wonderful!  And the neighborhood is so cute!  When we got in at 11, we headed right out to walk around.  Very safe place!  We highly recommend his place and can't wait to get back there again!!

This is the first time we rent a cottage on the site airbnb and we liked it very much. 
The cottage of Susan en Steve is a very nice place to stay and fully equipped. We stayed there from 18 till 22 June to visit our daughter in Boston. Susan en Steve are very hospitable and give us all the information that we needed for our visits in Boston. We highly recommend this place.

Thanks for everything!

Greetings from Corry en Henk from the Netherlands.

Julie's place was fantastic. A superb location where restaurants and the commercial centre are easily within walking distance. The apartment itself was beautiful - clean, a great size and very comfortable. Julie was also very responsive and a great host.

Kristin was a great host and we loved how quiet the neighborhood is and also how accessible it is to get to the heart of the city. Great views along the waterfront for a nice evening walk. Adorable condo and very comfortable. Would definitely recommend!!

We loved our time here! Arika's condo was just as described, except even MORE beautiful than the photos! She had even left us some fresh fruit to munch on for breakfast! We had a very late flight, so we didn't arrive at the condo until about 2:30am. Arika had left the lights on, which felt very welcoming and safe! We instantly felt at home. The condo was very clean, the bed super comfortable, and overall made us feel like we were really "experiencing" Boston! 

We enjoyed using the public transportation system, which was just a short walk down the road. We rented a car for this trip because some of our destinations were a little further away, but I think in the future, we'll just stick to the public transit!

Robert was very friendly and welcoming. Condo was as listed, 3 BR on 2nd & 3rd floor in Charlestown.  Large open living/ dining area. Nicely furnished, Keurig coffee maker, toiletries. About half mile walk over hill to get to/from Subway, which was fine for us and kids, but could be difficult for others. A few blocks from Bunker Hill & Constitution, walking distance to North End and fabulous Italian food. We had a great time with our 5 & 3 year olds.

Jonathon was an absolute pleasure; he is very welcoming and his home is a reflection of this. He was very responsive and accommodating.  If you are looking for a quiet place in the City to relax this is definitely it. The neighborhood is just a block away from the hustle and bustle so you can spend less time in transit. On street parking was a breeze too which is always a plus.

This listing was exactly as advertised, and beyond! Robert was a gracious and welcoming host and my three colleagues really enjoyed staying here. The apartment was extremely clean and Robert was a pleasure to work with.

I'm extremely happy with my first Airbnb experience. Janel answered any question I had quickly. The apartment is clean and very nice. It's in a great neighborhood and is a nice walk to a lot of historical places in Boston. I wouldn't hesitate to rent again or to recommend it to anyone who is going to Boston.

Had a wonderful stay at Laura's beautiful apartment. She was incredibly responsive and hospitable. The place was beautiful and Laura made the stay effortless.

I highly recommend Laura as a host, and wish her the absolute best.

Hi,

Ben' and Molly's house is a perfect solution for your trip in Boston. The house is comfortable, clean and quiet.
Molly helped us with some good ideas about the city attractions.
The house is very close to the airport subway station, and the neighborhood is very quiet and safe. 
Thanks for all :)))
Luciano & Antonella                                                       Sep 2013

We had an awesome stay at Pauls place in Boston. He has been exceptionally generous and was super helpful when giving us advice where to go and what to see in the city.

The place is exactly as described, very clean and in a great shape. The location is absolutely perfect to explore the city. The metro station is a quick 5min walk away and downtown Boston is just one stop away.

It was fantastic experience to stay in Elizabeth's suite. Elizabeth is a very kind and thoughtful lady who provided the completed travel reference docs for us in advance and as well as the health breakfast when we arrived. I do appreciate of her kindness and would like to recommend Elizabeth's amazing & comfortable suite to the friends who has the plan to Boston.

Our stay with Carol and her sons was great! The room was clean, warm and comfortable as advertised. The neighborhood is charming and fun with a lot of restaurants and bars with in walking distance. The green line is only a couple blocks away and is an easy ride in to downtown and to the airport. Carol was friendly, had great suggestions for things to see/do and was a great hostess! We would absolutely stay with her again and would recommend to anyone!

Michelle was an exceptional host! As other reviewers have stated, she met me at the train station and, very smartly, pointed out interesting landmarks on the 5-10 min walk to her house to help me remember my way. She showed me around the place and the bedroom (exactly as pictured), including the laundry, which yes it is in an old basement-- but it's laundry! Which is fantastic! It's coin operated ($1 per load each), but Michelle gave me enough quarters for a load to supplement what I had. There were two other gentlemen renting out rooms in this flat, which you share a bathroom with and both were very pleasant/kept to themselves. The public areas are well kept, with free coffee :) and lots of info on things to do in Boston. Michelle even made banana bread for the morning I was leaving so I had a snack on the way out! It was great :) 

Also, there are some cute cats outside that Michelle has been taming. They're fun to play with if you like cats, and if you don't, they can be pretty skiddish.

Thank you to Karen for accommodating my new hire who was relocating from Toronto.  He assured me that the apartment was spectacular, easy transitions in and out, and that it was well located for his commute and social activities.  

Big thanks to Karen for working with me on a longer stay and ensuring everything went smoothly with the multiple parties.
Staying at Lacey's place was a really nice experience. The place is very clean and very cozy and comfortable. Also Lacey is an extremely generous host.

Helen and Stuart's apartment was exactly like the pictures - spacious, clean and well decorated. They were also wonderful hosts, making sure that the kitchen was always well stocked for breakfast and bringing freshly baked goods every morning! We received a friendly service and lots of advice about our stay and onward trip. Highly recommended!

Lisa was an incredible host since the beginning. She made herself available and answered all my questions. The apartment is incredible, just like the pictures, and the location is great. My family had a wonderful time and we are looking forward to stay here again in the future.
Wonderful home and extremely warm and welcoming host

We felt so welcome and enjoyed our visit so much. Alex and her husband were super hospitable and made sure we were comfortable and entertained. The house was even better than the pictures suggested. The attic space used to be the master bedroom - it is big and well appointed with a roomy bathroom and tons of books and DVDs, and a nice TV. Super comfortable.

All in all one of our best AirBnB stays -- wished we were there longer than one night!

I highly recommend Jason's condo in Jamaica Plain. Jason is a great host: kind, considerate, and communicative. The condo is very pleasant.  He makes his bike available too, which is great because Boston is so bikeable. Jamaica Plain is a leafy, pretty, and hipster kind of area with a nice village feel. From Jason's you can walk to cafes, restaurants, and parks. Great access to the subway system as well. The alcove is a twin bed.

Thanks for your hospitality!  Your home is great and very comfortable.  Your roof is a little scary - I'm so glad Dale told us about the noises it can make, however, I forgot to tell my other friends and they really did think something was going on!  It was fun!!

Julie and Donna were incredibly accommodating, kind and happily welcomed us into their house. The room was spacious and comfortable, and they very generously left out food and coffee for breakfast every morning which was a wonderful surprise! Their dog was the happiest, most loving pup I've ever met and was also a wonderful addition to the experience. The house is close to the T into the city and an easy walk to the main street in JP with plenty of restaurants and shops nearby.

Very friendly host, reasonable rates, and fairly close to the Charles in a safe neighborhood.  The cute old home reminded me of the one I grew up in with steep staircases and creaking floors.

The host was kind enough to to pick me up upon my arrival and swing by a store for some supplies for a reasonable $15 fee.

Breakfast during the week was very light with pretty much just toast offered.  Apparently they have more on the weekend.  The cookies in the afternoon were tempting and lovely.

My family and I thoroughly enjoyed staying at Lisa's stunning South End apartment which meets the highest standards. It is conveniently located with restaurants and shops close by and public transport only a few blocks away. Lisa is an excellent communicator with impressive organizational skills. Even though she was on a trip and with us on the move Lisa organised for someone to meet us at her house to let us in and show us around. Lisa really thought of everything we could possibly need to get settled in and to make our stay as comfortable as possible. We would definitely consider staying at Lisa's very beautiful and spacious apartment again if our travels took us back to Boston.

Phil is a very friendly host and I felt safe and comfortable in Roslindale. It's a very quiet and nice neighbourhood. You have easy access to the commuter train station at Roslindale Village (if you don't mind walking appr. 15 minutes) - but especially on weekends there is only limited service (on Sundays even no service at all). But you can also take the T orange line to Forest Hill and take a bus (there are several lines). If you like to explore Boston during daytime and have quiet evenings and like walking it's worth a stay.

I live in Boston and my parents stayed at Edward's penthouse for 4 nights last may, when they came to visit me. Not only the house is amazing but also Edward was the most kind and helpful host ever. 

We had another reservation but the host cancelled it and then I contacted Edward for a "last minute" reservation. He was incredibly nice and made a great effort to work this out. Edward even kindly invited me to see the house before booking. The penthouse was still under construction works, as Edward was renovating it when I first got the chance to check it out, but he managed to have everything ready in just a few days, to make my parents' stay really comfortable.

Regarding the penthouse, the only thing I can say is that it is amazing!! It is in a great location really close to the main tourist areas in Boston (perfect for visitors) but conveniently located in a really quiet neighborhood. Edward has recently renovated it and the spaces he has generated have been designed with great detail and in a very creative way.
