Especially the atrium and how the rooms look toward it and get the light from its skylight is incredible!!!

As my references to my friends about how kind Edward is and how great the house is were so positive, now they all want to contact Edward for future stays of their families!! :) So... I would not recommend it to my friends or to anyone... I ALREADY DID RECOMMEND IT!!!!

Since we have family in East Boston, we're regulars, but have never stayed in this neighborhood before, always came over from the more touristy downtown. We enjoyed exploring "Eastie" - especially all the great neighborhood restaurants. We're vegans, and we ate everywhere without any difficulties.

The room was clean and peaceful, and hosts Ben and Molly were helpful with any questions. An added bonus is the close proximity to Piers Park, where we hung out in the afternoons. It's a hidden gem with spectacular views of the water and Boston skyline.
Kristin's home was wonderful and she was extremely accommodating! It was the perfect location to hop on the ferry and/or T and get anywhere in town. Great value! :-)

It was a really nice experience to stay in Shawn's place. The room is perfect, with a very clean and modern kitchen, living room, private washroom. The neighbourhood is quiet at night as well.  
We met the host by the day we left, and turning out that he was a really intelligent and nice person to talk to as well. Highly recommend!!

What a great stay! Very clean, new and nice apartment. It was a perfect location for me when visiting Boston. The host was prompt and helpful with the responses when I had questions. I would recommend this host to anyone looking to stay in that area. Thank you for making my stay pleasant and comfortable!

Very nice house!

So clean and so convenience for us. Huge TV Screen, laundry room, 2 parking car, we will live there again.

非常好的大house，非常整洁。地点很好很安静，设备齐全，厨房里所有需要的设备和调理都有，地下室有洗衣和烘干机，给我们安排了2个停车位。附件的湖景色非常好，还可以租船游览。

We had such a great experience staying in this room! The hosts were very responsive and accommodating to our arrival time. The house was gorgeous and clean and the room and bathroom were private, clean and modern with all of the amenities. They've thought of everything! We  would absolutely stay here again if we're in Boston. Better than a hotel.

Great location! Just a few blocks to the restaurants and shops. Such a charming cute place and neighborhood. Hayley was a great, left us Boston books and magazines for our stay, and she made us banana bread. Highly recommend!

Before we talk about  the property I want to tell you a litle bit about Nitzan :he is a great man ,I've no doubt ,with a big big Heart and a great Humanity .he has a very fluid comunication for your arrival and welcomes you with a large basket of fruit ,a bottle of wine ,fresh milk,orange juice ,etc He will go with you for a tour by the neighborhood just to tell you about the public transport you can get in this area ,some restaurants ,small stores ....Nitzan is a top 10 host ,no doubt .
About the apartment , first of all , I can say that often I go to Boston so many times I'll stay in it ...it's pèrfect !!!!!.
Everything is according to what you see in the pics ,the building is a rehabilitation of an old Factory into apartments but retaining all the charm of the old building ; public áreas are modern ,people of the neighborhood is very kind and polite ,the place is very quite ...a perfect place to live in...
The location is fantastic...near some  important sites of Boston.If you like to walk you can go to the city center by your own but if don't ,you have several options of public transport close to the place : bus,water-taxi(recommended just for fun...)  etc  .
Just around the corner there is a beautiful harborwalk  for walking ,running . playing  with the dogs ,bike riding. with children áreas ,or just relaxing with the fantastic view of the skyline of Boston, just in front of you, sitting on a bench looking the boats sailing !!!
The apartment has everything you may need for your stay,short or long,we 've been for a whole mounth and we haven't missed  anything in this time ...you will feel like in your own house but ..in Boston.
the place is cozy,all things are very new ,everything  works ..and works well,hot wáter is wonderful and instantly ,has a very powerful wifi not giving conection problems ,with several closets wher you will fit all your luggage,and if you have a car nitzan has a spot parking available for your use.
It's a nice, modern,bright,cozy,confortable,clean ,quiet place...the only sound you will hear in the mornings are seagulls hovering near it... I Ioved it!!!!
If you are thinking to rent this place ...do it!!! Everything you expect from it ,you won't feel disappointed and of course...you will win a new friend :NITZAN.
Great stay at ed's house - he is a very kind person and we really  enjoyed the days in Boston - especially the one night on the rooftop with ed, the other guests, a bottle of wine and a good talk...

Lyralen & Judy are excellent joyful hosts, they provided us with maps and useful information about Boston. They even had freshly baked banana bread for us. Their place is clean, comfortable, cozy, and within walking distance to the subway station. The neighborhood is quiet and safe.
We enjoyed our time there and highly recommend it.
We enjoyed our stay very much. We both agreed this is the most comfortable bed we have slept in our entire lives.
Jason was a wonderful host. Very accommodating. Exceeded all expectations and beyond.

Wonderful room in a very well kept house in Jamaica Plains. Easy access (3 min walk) to green line station. Tricia was an amazing hostess. Had everything clean and warm when I arrived. Very helpful if I needed anything. Bed is super comfortable! Felt like I was staying at a hotel!! Would definitely stay again.
Staying in boston for the weekend, couldn't have been better. I would highly recommend this apartment. Location is ideal, and very accomidating host.

First of all, prior to arrival Lisa sent us all the information we needed, so our trip was off to a good start! When we arrived, there was plenty of free parking on the street, and we were greeted by Brian (Lisa's Husband). He gave us a tour of the place, and explained all information. He was very friendly and made us feel comfortable and welcome. The room, had a couple of snacks, bottles of water and an information sheet with wifi code and other appreciated information...! The two public transportation cards were also available when we arrived (very fun to have!) The bus stop is right across the street! The bed is VERY comfortable.. (usually, I miss my bed, but I didn't this time!) The heating blanket, with controls on each side of the bed is AMAZING. We eventually got to meet Lisa, she was so friendly and happy , it put us in a good mood. They kindly let us play some of their board games ( an awesome selection) and even invited us to play with them later that evening but we were unfortunately busy! The place is very clean, and everything was great. Will be staying again when back in Boston! You won't regret your (website hidden): the breakfast offered is good and a really cool idea , loved it ! Especially the hot apple cider for the Kureg machine.... 

Enjoy your stay!

PS: if coming home late at night.. make sure you pay attention to what house your going into.. we were stupid enough to walk into the wrong house (the doors were unlocked , but I was under the illusion my keys were working on the other house). We had a good laugh!
Juliet was very accommodating with allowing us to check in and out when it was easiest for us. I would definitely recommend this house and Juliet as a host

Highly recommend this host and house.  From start to finish the communication was excellent, the home was fantastic and very generous hospitality that included breakfast.  We would stay here again if/when we visit Boston again.

Paul is a super nice person. His place is clean and trendy. Very inviting. I loved that he had air conditioning as the temps outside were 90 degrees during my visit. The area surrounding his apartment appears older and some places are rundown. Yet Paul's place is up to date and I felt quite safe.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about this loft and overall experience! Jeff was responsive and incredibly helpful from the beginning. The loft was even better than advertised- absolutely gorgeous and very close to the train/subway station. I would highly recommend this space if you are planning a trip to Boston! Thank you so much!

Ken and Jez run a first class establishment with all the fine touches that make a place special.  Not the least of which is their "over and above" offers to make getting in late in the evening finding your way to them (stand on the curb at departures, sweetheart, and Ken will pick you up in his green truck) to getting to the car rental place without getting lost in the tunnels.  Wonderful and gracious hosts, fun to converse with and share airbnb experiences, very comfy bed and all the trimmings.  Five stars you two !!

Our stay on Chris and Thierry's yacht was an fantastic experience!  From the minute Thierry collected us and walked us on board to a welcoming Chris, we completely enjoyed our time.  The yacht is beautifully appointed and pristine.  They had welcome snacks and beverages ready for us laid out with the flair of a fine hotel.  They treated us like old friends, chatting and visiting but retreating to allow private time to enjoy the deck and sun.  Our breakfast was ready when we woke, delicious and plentiful.  We can HIGHLY recommend this venue, you will remember this one!!

This AIRBNB was a perfect and easy experience.  The hosts were great and easy to deal with.  The train is within 2 blocks and makes traveling Boston a breeze.  The bed was super comfy (which is a huge requirement for me!) and the coffee was delicious!  I would 100% recommend them and stay there again.
This was a second stay at the Carriage House and it was as great as the first! Clean, comfortable and private with all sorts of nice touches like coffee and snacks. We love it here.

Alicia and Kostas are wonderful hosts. Their home is warm and inviting and serene. The room is cozy and comfortable. Everything is provided for an exceptional experience in Jamaica Plain. I highly recommend staying here and I will definitely return!

This modern Beacon Hill apartment was great! My boyfriend and I booked it for a weekend trip and it was in a really convenient location. Everything we needed was within walking distance nearby: Starbucks, Bars & Restaurants, Boston Commons, Cambridge. It was clean, well stocked, and had lots of natural light. Natasha was a really thoughtful host. We didn't get to meet her because of our flight times, but she checked in via email to make sure all was well. I would definitely rent from her again and would highly recommend staying in her place.

Jason and his wife have a fantastic place to stay if you are traveling to the Boston area! Their residence is cozy, clean, and convenient. It's located steps from the subway, which makes traveling around Boston easy. They have two beautiful cats that are well-behaved and sweet. My wife is allergic to cats but Jason provided antihistamines for my wife, and their two cats were sweet and well-behaved while we were there. Needless to say my wife never got sick! As a "welcome gift" they provided my wife and I an adult beverage from the local area, which we loved! Also, snacks, coffee, and Charlie cards (subway payment method) were provided free of charge. We will definitely consider staying at this residence in the future!

Highly recommended! The first experience at Airbnb didn't disappoint us. Carol is a very good and helpful host. We felt ourselves like at home. There is everything that you need and everything is in a great condition in the house. You will love your time spent there.

I arrived late, but the hosts had no problem with it. The room was very nice. I had access to wifi and the living room. The house is only a mile away from the nearest underground stop and very close to the airport. The hosts were very hospitable and I would highly recommend their place.

My daughter and her girl friend loved the room.  She said it was extremely clean and comfortable and they really enjoyed their stay with Am and Alan.  She adored Am and loved the small touches like a couple of meals in the freezer.  We would highly recommend this accommodation to anyone that is looking for great accommodation in a great location :)
This is a most comfortable and stylish home. I want to come back and hope I can stay here again!
Phil was a great host, accommodating and friendly without being intrusive. He provides a beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood steps from the arboretum. Great trip.

The apt was in the heart of little Italy, minutes from all the restaurants and bakeries, convenient for getting anywhere in the heart of Boston.  The room itself was quiet and clean... a good place to crash when visiting the city.

Rachel's place is fantastic! She is right near the main little strip in Jamaica Plain and it is a great and quiet part of Boston with so many good restaurants, cafes, shops, etc. It is super easy to get in and out of Boston proper on the T and you will be hard pressed to find a better deal in such a stellar apartment. Rachel is very communicative which makes the whole trip stress free.

Best hosts on airbnb I've stayed with so far. Bruce and Barry are extremely friendly and welcoming people. I highly recommend them as I have stayed with them multiple times. I go to school at umass boston and their house is walking distance from the university or the Savin hill T-station. Very convenient location! Great hosts!

Bruce and Bary we're great hosts and made our first AirBnB experience a great one.  Despite arriving early, they made us feel welcome and accommodated us.  The house and room was gorgeous and the neighborhood quiet.  Easy to get to and great access to the T.  Ours was a quick one night stay so we didn't get to hang around long past the nice breakfast Bruce cooked up for us.  Would definitely recommend to others!

We had a great time in Boston at Randall's place. He arranged for us to get in easily. When I put in the wrong address and ended up a couple of blocks away, he patiently took my call and talked me down the street and to his front door. He really knows his city and had great suggestions for restaurants and points of interest. He left us a list of ideas for meals and attractions like the flour cafe, the beehive, quincy market and the greenway art installation by Janet Echelman. He never steered us wrong. He is a great host and has a great place.
Michelle was lovely and so was her home! Friendly and very charismatic. Thank you for everything!!

Robert was a welcoming and helpful host.  The neighborhood was charming and very close to everything we wanted to do in both Charlestown and Boston.  The home was lovely, convenient, even better than described.  We fully enjoyed ourselves and would stay there again if we are back in the Boston area

It was just perfect! The flat is located in 'Little Italy' and you can reach almost everything by foot. The flat itself was very clean and high end furnished. The communication with Frank was very pleasant. He responded always very quick and was an excellent host. The arrival time was flexible due to a lock box, in which the key was placed.

Tia was very nice and accommodating.  I arrived a lot later than expected and she was more than forgiving.  Unfortunately wasn't able to meet, but room was very cozy.  
Thanks!
Joe

I had a wonderful stay! Joe and Catherine communicated well with me and they were flexible with my late checkout time. Beacon Hill is a neat and quiet neighborhood and their apartment is very clean and cute. Although I didn't meet them personally, they checked in with me via airbnb messages. I really appreciate their hosting and their place is definitely recommended to everyone!

We have stayed in Lyralen & Judy condo for few days renting 2 rooms with our 2 daughters and 1 night renting 1 room just for us.

Lyralen had call us ahead of time to help with getting to the place and finding the key and she was always available on the phone to answer few questions we had.

The condo is conveniently located close to were we needed to be in Boston. Parking is on the street right beside the condo. On the day of the street cleaning, we had easily found parking around the corner.

Condo has a lot of space, very clean and quiet. We kept windows open - our preference - and did not hear any noise outside.

Bedrooms are spacious, have a lot of light and air. Kitchen is well equipped and there were supplies guest could use, which was convenient and unexpected to us.

We had a chance to speak with our hosts on the last day and found them very warm and welcoming. We would definitely recommend them to friends or when need a place on Boston, would stay with them again.

I really enjoyed staying at Andrew’s and Katie’s place.  It was exactly as described –  quiet, private,  & clean with tons of space.   The bed was super comfortable and it was nice to have the den with Keurig coffee to start the morning.  The hosts are great, and Sammy did an excellent job checking in with me once a day for pets!  The condo is close to the convention center – an easy walk or frequent bus service. I hope to stay there again for my next conference.
Ray was great.  He took us to the local bar and we had a great night too.  We would definitely recommend staying with him. Nice place, nice location, clean and tidy.  Comfy bed too.

I had the BEST Airbnb experience ever :) My hosts are amazing people. They are always available to explain and give tips about Boston and America culture. The apartment is great, a brand new place, it is well localized and for free you will have an amazing Pier's view. The apartment is very close to a subway station, you can arrive the Maverick Station in just one minute.  [5 STARS]

Alice welcomed me. And it seems she is very used to hosting somebody in her house. With snacks and drinks she left in the room, and with the bath room only for me, I was really enjoying the stay relaxingly.
And her place is near to the grean line, so I also could enjoy going around Boston. I wouldn't hesitate to visit her again and her place is strongly recommended for those who are going to stay in Boston for reasonable cost.

Bruce was very accommodating, he let us drop off our bags ealy before check-in so we could explore. The house is incredible! The room was awesome and eclectic. The bed was soo comfortable. I wish we could have stayed longer.

Seth's home was even more amazing in real life. The photos are true representation, however being there in person was even better than expected. The home is meticulous and comfortable. The deck is to die for. Seth was very easy to communicate and coordinate checkin/checkout. I would recommend his place with no hesitation.
The apartment and location are perfect, with plenty of nearby shops and cafes. It's a perfect location to explore the entire city.

Our stay with Jez N Ken exceeded our expectations.  This was our first experience using Airbnb and our hosts made sure that we had a very pleasant stay. The accommodations were very comfortable with many extra touches.  The house was easy to find in a lovely neighborhood.  After this positive experience, we will not hesitate to use Airbnb again.
We had a very good sleep at the CarneyFamily's house. The room and bathrooms were very clean and comfortable. A good pleace to stay if you want to explore Boston.

The Carriage House was a great place to stay....An affordable alternative to downtown hotels with parking and a newly renovated kitchen- what more could you need?  Sarah and Tom were great hosts who made sure their guests had all the essentials for a comfortable stay, from toiletries to a wii.  We enjoyed exploring the the Jamaica Plains neighborhood as well as taking public transportation into the city, and would definitely recommend the Carriage House as a modern, tidy, and comfortable accommodation!

Our stay at Andrew and Katie's apartment was great. Communication and check-in was easy and effortless. Their home is definitely the right setup for hosting guests from AirBnB. The downstairs section of their home was completely for our use, which is large with it's own lounge area, bathroom and bedroom. We took the liberty of using their washer and dryer, which was such a help. The information booklet they put together was useful. Their home is in a neighbourhood in South Boston. While it is a residential area, it is a road or two away from restaurants, bars and public transportation (bus 7 and 9), so just a short bus trip away from South Station which gets you to downtown. Sammy, their dog, is adorable and so playful (but only when you initiate it). She is the only dog we have come across that does not bark and is just too sweet for words. Besides a good stay in their home, they were great hosts. We wish we had longer to stay and get to know them (over some beers) :)

Lyralen and Judy were excellent hosts.  They were kind and welcoming and made us feel right at home!   They were super helpful with any questions we had about the city.  Their place is conveniently located near the T in a quiet neighborhood.  I would definitely stay with these two again!

My boyfriend and I stayed at Bruce and Barry's house for 2 nights back in June, and it was amazing! They are the best hosts we've met - they know the area and can direct us to very cool places that "regular" tourists wouldn't even hear about. They are extremely friendly and accommodating, we even enjoyed a few treats (food!) on a few occasions! The house is very well located - near the T line (red line) - which goes directly downtown and even up to Harvard university. Definitely, when we go back to Boston, we will stay with Bruce and Barry. Now, let's plan our Tailgate party - go Pats go!! :-) Thanks again!!

Andrea was such a welcoming host. She meets you in the driveway and from the start to end of your stay everything she does is in such great detail. It was amazing sleeping in the loft on a cold night with the heat in and skylight open sleeping in the stars. It is in the city but it is so quiet. I heard nothing all night. I must say I had the most amazing hot shower!

Rebecca's appartment was even better than the photo's. There was enough space for the three of us, a huge balcony with a nice view, good public transport nearby, and all you could possibly wish for in the kitchen and the bathroom. 
Extremely clean and clear directions. 
Loved it.

Sarah's appartment is a fantastic place to stay in Boston. OUr week end was perect. We were 5 (4 adults and a 2 years kid) and really enjoyed.
The place is well located in a pleasant neighborhood, the appartment is really nice and clean. The view from the roof is just fantastic.
Sarah and Ben are well organized in regard with the logistics (pick up keys, rules in the appartment, cleanliness).
As french people, we love cooking and we had all the utilities to do so (except the oven).
Everything said about this appartment are 100% true and I highly recommend it for those who want to spend some time in Boston.

I really enjoyed my short stay at Lev's apartment!  He replied immediately via text to any questions I had and was sweet and made sure I was comfortable and had everything I needed.  The room and the apartment were immaculate and comfortable.  The neighborhood was charming and convenient too!  I will definitely be contacting Lev the next time I'm in Boston and highly recommend other visitors to stay at his place.
Jeff was amazing, and so was waldo. So kind and welcoming and the room is large and spacious as described. Will be keeping in touch.

Tom was great.  We were arriving to Boston late, so we arranged for him to drop off keys to my sister.  This apartment is clean and easily accessible.  It's right in the heart of the North End, which was so cool!  Walking distance to many of Boston's attractions including the aquarium, the waterfront, Haymarket, and tons of amazing bars and restaurants!

The place was great, Kaitlin was a great host. We had a perfect first Boston experience here. It was easy to get everywhere on the tram or with Uber. We liked several restaurants we found within a few minutes walk.  This is what we hope for in using Airbnb over a generic hotel.

Nitzan's apartment was superb, with great attention to detail. When I had trouble getting the oven to work, Nitzan came over and troubleshooted it for us.  The apartment was across the street from a shuttle stop to get into downtown Boston, or a short cab ride into the city. A lovely place, would stay here again.
Jez N Ken weren't there, but Shirley was a huge help. She is a sweetheart. She explained everything and was super nice. We felt very welcomed. Great hospitality.

I've stayed here several times, and hopefully several more are on my agenda.

The host is fantastic.  John is gracious and accommodating.  He is flexible and considerate.  

It is the best AirBnB property I've stayed in.

We had just two days in Boston. The apartment is an ideal location to explore Boston; virtually everything is in "walking" distance, even – if needed - the subway station (Back Bays). Tremont Street is pretty busy but the apartment is an ideal and very quiet retreat. We enjoyed easy going mornings with a coffee from nearby Starbucks, doing some reading, e-mails and research on what to do next in Boston. We instantly felt at home.  Danielle offered lots of information and amenities to get organized quickly. There are several places for breakfast, fine dining and even enjoying some late night live music just around the corner.

Beautiful home in a great location!  2 minute walk to the T, making it very easy to get around the city.  We did not have the pleasure of meeting Jason and Stephanie, but they were great with communication and making sure we had everything we needed for our stay.  It's the little things (like a fully stocked bathroom with any toiletries that you could need) that show they care about creating a wonderful experience for their guests.  Although it is not connected to your bedroom, guests do have a bathroom solely for their use.  Jason and Stephanie provide their guests with a list of restaurant recommendations for various neighborhoods in the city as well as those conveniently located to their home, which was really helpful.  I highly recommend staying here!
The apartment is clean and bright. The neighborhood is quiet and safe.

This was a GREAT experience. I needed to book a two-bedroom for a couple of days for clients coming in for a fundraiser at my company. Once booked, Dale and Liz were constantly in communication with me, they answered urgent questions immediately, were friendly, etc.

The clients were thrilled with the space, which was convenient to the subway and in a really sweet area of Jamaica Plain, Boston. Would definitely book this place again.

Jonathan master bedroom is absolutely great ! My week was amazing thanks to Jonathan who is the on of the best host in Boston !

Merci !

I stayed at Roberts place for a week. Robert is a very generous and personable host. On my first night he invited me to a dinner that he was hosting for some of his friends. He also invited me out to an event at the local Hibernian Hall and on the last day gave me a lift to the airport. Roberts house is spotless and all the equipment is high quality. Jamaica Plain is a lovely spot. It has a slightly hipster feel about it and the wooden clap board houses and tree lined streets give it a nice feel. There is also the two T line stations, which make getting into Boston centre really quick and easy, and the old converted brewery which is owned and run by Jamaica Plain Neighbourhood Development Corporation (a non profit). JPNDC have turned JP round in the last 20 years from a run down part of town to where it is now - property sells for $500 per sq ft.The converted brewery contains 40 or so businesses including a really great café and a restaurant. I met some of the locals and the owners of the restaurant on the last night and found them really friendly. 

5 star - well done Robert.

South Boston has a gem!  This place was very clean and exactly as described, beautiful and private.  We came and found exactly what the pictures show, a large second floor room with a private bath and (if there weren't 3 feet of snow on it) a nice outdoor deck.  The space was bright and spacious, and the bed was comfortable. We were busy with a trade show and weren't ever able to cross paths with Peter, but our directions were accurate and access was easy with the lock box for a hidden key.  Even with the horrible winter Boston has been through, we were able to park within one block both nights.  
Thanks and good luck Peter!

I lived with Robert and Rocco two months. Robert was always ready to give you the best recommendations. Rocco is cute and friendly. I love JP, there are many wonderful cafes and restaurants nearby, 7 Pond is my favorite. Robert told me he wanted 5 stars, definitely, he deserves it, super 5 stars.

Charming house in a charming neighborhood. Bruce and Barry are the most hospitable hosts. My brother and I had a wonderful stay even though it was a very short stay just overnight. Bruce was thoughtful enough to set up an extra air bed for him in the room since there was only one bed. Would like to stay again in the future and maybe stay for longer.
We loved staying with the Carneys!  We had a beautiful, updated room, with a view of the bay, and a quick walk to the train for our day trips into Boston.

Ellie was a great host! She provided my husband and I a list of restaurants with maps to get there. She lives in a nice neighborhood that is very walkable, and it was convenient to the convention center for work. I would highly recommend Ellie's hospitality!

We love our stay at Jack's place! His apartment is newly furnished, bright and very clean, literally spotless. The neighborhood is fun with a lot of good restaurants and interesting shops. On top of all, Jack is an amazing host. He responded quickly, prepared everything we needed and made us feel very welcome and at home (there was a scented candle light in the room when we arrived!) We are moving into a new apartment soon and Jack was very nice to offer a lot of helpful suggestions for furniture and moving.  Overall we had a very pleasant stay, would definitely recommend this place to anyone.

Jazz was a wonderful host - she had everything prepared and ready for me.  She also gave me a whole bunch of pointers for things to see and places to go in Boston.  

The place is spotless and spacious. It's a short walk to Chinatown.  City transport was also very accessible.
Phyllis's place was really great. I loved the house and how welcome she made me feel. She has a lot of extras that make the place really exceptional.

Was very nice and welcoming -- accommodated my trip on short notice. The place is beautiful with great mid-century inspired furnishing and original accents. Extremely clean and well cared for. Bedroom, bathroom and living space was all very well cared for. Hotel quality!

Coming from the airport is easy with Joes’ instructions. House is in perfect condition. Everything is tidy and clean. He left some suprise to us as a welcome gift. Connecting to the main metro lines is easy. We feel like we were at home. We came here to attend congress at Hynes. Transportation is fast and easy to the congress center. 
Thanks for this kind, welcoming and dear homeowner.

Bruce and Barry were great hosts. The house was clean and cozy.  I felt at ease from our initial interaction.  I stayed for 5 days in a beautiful room.  The bed was  very comfrotable.  The neighborhood was safe and quiet.  Being at walking distance from the T was a treat.  I had a lovely stay.  I enjoyed the night when they invited me to join them for dinner with another housemate.  Thank you for a great first experience with AirBnB.
It was a lot of fun to stay at Joanne's house. She is a lovely woman and made me feel welcome. The breakfast was yummy including the coffee! I plan to stay there again.

Mark was ready to greet us at the designated time.  His apartment is just as his listing discribes it to be.  The location is wonderful.  You can walk to both the C and D trians on the green line for easy access to the city.  It is a short walk to Dunkin Donuts, CVS, and a few resturants. Beautiful, quiet neigborhood. 
We were in Boston with my daughter and granddaughter for a family event and needed a baby friendly space.  The apartment has a high chair, changing table and a crib. The crib ended up being a youth bed so we had to go buy a pack and play, not really a problem.  We would stay here again!

This accommodation is in a great location, directly across from the Hynes Convention Center, Prudential Tower, etc.  It is air conditioned and amazingly quiet despite its central location. Checking in and out was a breeze and no issues with coming and going as needed.  Julie is an excellent host quick to point out surrounding amenities.  There is a Trader Joe's downstairs and excellent eating establishments close by.
I enjoyed my time here and would not hesitate to stay again.
One note, if you are not ready to climb four flights of stairs to get to the room, this is not the place for you.  Worked great for me after eating too much almost every night though!

Although we didn't get to meet in person and had to book the house in the last minute, Jay was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with, and made it very easy for us. Everything was exactly as described - it is a beautiful space in a wonderful neighborhood, and a lot of great locations are within walking distance. Would absolutely recommend!

Andy and Ben were terrific hosts. Their condo is beautiful, the private room and bathroom are exquisitely cared for and exceptionally well appointed, more so in fact than many 4- and 5-star hotels. They were also very accommodating, as my flight didn't arrive until quite late, which meant waiting up for me until well past midnight.  Andy did so without a hint of complaint and was gracious from the moment I arrived. Even their two dogs greeted me enthusiastically -- like I was just another member of the extended family!

The South End location of their condo is convenient for bus access into town. The T is about a 15-minute walk, which has the benefit of being on West Broadway, now a more bustling street with shops and cafés.  Andy was forthcoming with plenty of tips and guidance to help me navigate the neighborhood. 

Considering the going rate at Boston hotels these days, this was an outstanding bargain, especially given the price-to-comfort ratio. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again, and I'm grateful to guys like Andy and Ben who make airBnb the outstanding value that I've come to associate with integral aspect of its brand.

Nathan was a great host--all his instructions were clear and detailed, and he went out of his way to think of everything that a guest might want.  The Treehouse is a fun and bohemian space, with a lot of character and quirks, while also being comfortable and cozy.  The large and thriving house plants all around the space are impressive.  And the view from the roof deck is even more spectacular than it looks in the pictures.  My colleague who stayed here was so pleased with the accommodations.  Highly recommended!
The host provided all of the information required to use the apartment. The listing is accurate. Handy combination locks mean no hassle with keys and need to have multiple keys for multiple guests.

The trip begins with Robert,super responsive and incredibly helpful. The location is just wonderful.

The house itself - just fantastic - attention to detail,extremely clean and wonderful bedding.

You can not pick a better accommodation.

This is a superlative abode.  It was everything as advertised.  Sammy was an amazing host-hound in addition.  The apartment is tasteful, comfortable and in a quiet neighborhood.  Easy to get to.  Everything was clean and neat.  Katie and Andrew were welcoming and helpful.  A fine experience.
Amazing place! Great location, excellent accommodations, and very hospitable owners. Exactly as advertised; would definitely stay here again.

Christopher was very accommodating and communicative.  
His place is really a sanctuary.  I opened the skylight and could hear the crickets chirping at night and yet it sits right in the heart of the Harvard campus area.  
Clean, with a comfortable bed and cozy/charming.  
Walking through the back patio to get to the cottage is a wee bit dark at night, but I felt very safe.  
Didn’t do any cooking because Darwin’s Coffee Shop is gooooood and right around the corner and Clover Food Lab is a 10 minute walk.  I will definitely try to stay here again!

Robin was a very gracioius and friendly host.  She went out of her way to make sure we had what we needed for a great stay!

The suite she has made available was very comfortable and gave us a spot to rest, as well as a great location from which to explor Boston and Brookline.

Our stay with Bruce was above and beyond all expectations. Mom and I came into town one night before I left the country to do some quick wedding dress shopping. (Something that shouldn't usually be done quickly, but I know what I like and found it in one morning.) 

Anyway - we got in late because we were out to dinner w/ an old friend, and we were welcomed in. The room was spotless and the house is absolutely gorgeous. We had lemon water brought to our room for the evening.

In the morning we got a spread of juice, tea, and coffee to start the dress-shopping day. Then a good healthy US American breakfast (bacon and eggs...and pluots?) with Bruce over really nice conversation. I only wish we didn't have to leave so soon to make an appointment! I would recommend this location to anyone.

This place was 5 star.  Modern, comfortable, great views over the city. Outstanding night views and close to the Northend and freedom trail. It's right next to the station so getting around is easy. Canal street has great place for breakfast across the road, liquor store close by. Can't recommend it highly enough. Richard was great to deal with.  We'd definitely stay next time we return
Really nice house and room located very close to Boston City centre and the surrounding areas. Super close to the streetcar so finding your way around is a breeze! Would definitely stay here again!

This lovely retreat is nestled in a quiet Somerville neighborhood. The picture does not display the mini-frig that now sits beside the writing table. The room has its own entrance and enchanting sitting area right outside the door that is completely private and illuminated with soft lighting at night. It is within walking distance to major transportation, including buses and trains into the city. We took advantage of both. Our hosts were warm, welcoming, present, but respected our privacy as we tried to respect theirs. They were incredibly accommodating with linens, towels, robes, and even Charley Cards (for riding mass transit).

We had a great experience at Stephen and Megan's. The apartment was very spacious, clean and comfortable. It is on a quiet street very close to the Subway and a block away from the supermarket. Very convenient!
The hosts left everything necessary incluiding towels, soap, shampoo, conditioner, coffee.... The kitchen is fully equiped. 
Stephen was very helpful and gave us great tips to Enjoy The city. We  definitely recommend staying here. We have usted airbnb several times and this is one of the best apartments we've stayed at.

This was the first time i ever used airbnb and i couldn't have been more satisfied. The place was spotless, all accomodations that we needed were there, and they even gave us a bottle of wine. The couple were super friendly, helpful, and quick to respond; when I mentioned that the living room was a little hot, they immediately went out and got an air conditioner and installed it. 

In short, the best hosts anyone could ask for.

Joe and Catherine were very professional throughout the process.  They were very helpful and had suggestions for local activities laid out upon our arrival.  They even had a bottle of wine waiting on the kitchen table for us!!!

The location is convieniently located, making a walkable city even more enjoyable.  The highlight of the apartment is the rooftop.  Highly recommend watching the sunset.  

Overall, we would rate the location and the hosts a 10 out of 10!

Bob was the best host! Lots of information and brochures were awaiting us and Bob was happy to help in any way he could. Bob's place is very close to the train line. It is very clean and beautifully styled. The room was great and has a very comfy bed! I can't recommend Bob's place enough, he was an amazing host, so welcoming and helpful, and made our visit to Boston very enjoyable.

The only issue I had with the place, was that I wasn't able to stay longer.  It is a cozy little spot with modern comforts and perfect for my stay.  I didn't get to enjoy it as much as I should've as I was only home to sleep and shower.  Gene kept perfect contact with me and was so accommodating to all my needs as well.  This was my first time using Air BnB and it was such a success! Can't wait to try it out in other cities and visit Gene's Downtown Designer Digs on my next visit to Boston! Nothing better than strolling through the North End, feeling like your waltzing through the streets of Florence but right here in the US! Thanks for everything Gene!!

Salman and Nabihah were great hosts, very kind and helpful and Toto is an amazing little dog! The place was very clean, welcoming and confortable and the neighborhood very quiet and peaceful. Subway is a 5 min walk. We would definitely recommend this place to friends visiting Boston or come back ourselves and this time we won’t forget to bring belgian chocolate for our hosts!
Deborah's place was spacious and comfy, and Deborah was great to work with - responsive and accommodating. Very positive experience!

We had great experience staying at Jonathan's place. The suite was very clean and nicely looking. Great location, close to subway and to the city center. Jonathan was very welcoming and helping.

We'll stay with him our next time in Boston.

We had a great stay at Perla's apartment. The apartment is beautiful, has a great view from the balcony and super easy to get to from the airport. The info booklet Perla provided was perfect, everything we needed to know was in there. If there would have been anything else we could have reached Perla easily on her phone.

Kevin and Julia were the perfect hosts for our stay in Boston. Their home was very clean and modern. I'd highly recommend staying here. Thanks for your great hospitality guys.

Simon and Jenny

Adam's home's location is absolutely perfect us since our plan was to hang around town to do the Freedom Trail as well as watch the 4th of July fireworks.  More importantly, Adam is a very hospitable and personable host.  He made us feel very welcomed as soon as we arrived.  Everything in the apartment and the rooftop is exactly as displayed in the photos.  I would definitely stay at Adam's if I were to visit Boston again.  :)

This was our first experience with airbnb and we absolutely loved it! Philip was a great host and made us feel very welcomed. He answered any questions we had and even recommended places for us to check out in the city. The apartment is well furnished, clean and conveniently located to restaurants, shops, Fenway Park, and public transportation. Overall we had an extremely positive experience.

Isa and her apartment were wonderful! Very nice, clean room with everything I would have needed. She was incredibly friendly, funny, and welcoming. Despite two other people living in the apartment, it felt like I had the place to myself and was very private. People say less than positive things about Dorchester but Isa's place was in the nice part of town.

Luisa was very accommodating and was a very welcoming host! Her home was a spacious middle level unit in a three story building near Assembly/Sullivan Square.  There are some great restaurants/bars within a few minutes drive, and highways were very accessible. Luisa made us feel at home - we thoroughly enjoyed our stay!

We just spent 5 nights in Boston with Bruce and Barry and loved it. They are warm and friendly, have a charming and comfortable home in a nice quiet neighborhood. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom sharing was no problem and clean when we used it, and it was just 2 blocks from the T station.

Even more fun was the interaction with others in the house. While we were there several graduate students from US and other countries were staying and one lively evening around the dining table was a real treat. We'd definitely stay there again when in Boston.

Lovely friendly welcome.  Margaret met us at the door and showed us where things were in the apartment, including some delicious extras in the fridge.  The apartment was clean, bright, pleasant, spacious, well equipped kitchen, lovely linens - everything we needed to be more-than-comfortable.  No AC but (though it was in high 80's) the fans kept us comfy and windows let in cooler air in the evenings.  It was about a 20 min. walk to the  trains but a delightful neighbourhood to walk through and worth the walk (if only not to have to take a car into Boston!).  The walk added to our enjoyment of the area.  This was Airbnb at it's best.  Lovely hosts, lovely home, lovely stay.  THANK YOU.
we had a fantastic stay at jason's apartment.  he was a gracious host, who was responsive and available.  we will be staying here every time we come to boston!

We had a great visit and really enjoyed staying in Brittany's lovely home. It was cozy and comfortable and right in the center of everything. Being in the North End, we ate very well and Brittany provided fantastic recommendations. Everything went smoothly, from picking up the key to checking out, and there were a number of nice touches. Thanks for sharing your space with us, we'd love to come back!

Wow! Nicole and Jason were great in communicating ahead of time. Jason was there to greet us as we arrived. The apartment is even nicer than in the photos. And there is an elevator! They have put together an excellent guide to places to eat and see and do by neighborhood in Boston. Thanks to the guide we discovered a cool jazz club and spent a really enjoyable evening there. Thanks Jason.

Ray's place was the perfect thing for a last minute trip to Boston. Plenty of space, a beautiful apartment, and a very convenient location. Not to mention Ray was extremely accommodating and communicative throughout the entire experience. If you are looking for a place in the Boston area, do not hesitate to stay with him.

Our stay was just perfect. The house is even more beautiful than what is shown in the pictures. We had everything we needed and Jared made sure we were provided with everything (bedding, towels, kitchen utensils, bathing products, and so on). He kept in touch and checked on us every once in a while and respected our privacy. I am definitely staying in this wonderful house again whenever I am back to Boston. The location of the house, right in front of Jamaica Pond is absolutely gorgeous.

Jeff was very responsive and flexible before, during and after the visit, making sure the place was a good fit for my expectations and arranging access despite his workday schedule. Jeff's space has a generous loft layout, is tastefully decorated and is very convenient for a Boston visit. Just as described in the listing. I'd stay here again in a heartbeat.

This is a GREAT property. Very clean, lots of good equipment and lovely soft towels. Good area. Easy to get to restaurants, groceries and transport. Would definitely stay here again and would highly recommend.

We had a great time at Damons place! The appartment was exactly as described, very cozy, clean and spacious. Damon was very helpful and easy going and made our stay a plesant. We highly recommend a stay here!!

Chris was a great host.  He was very communicative both before and during the stay.  He was always willing to help out with any requests, etc.

The apartment itself is incredibly nice -- just as described in the pictures.  I was also blown away by the artwork in the apartment.  I want to hire Chris to select art for my place!  

The one potential drawback (it was a meaningful drawback for my girlfriend):  the neighborhood is definitely still gentrifying and it felt a bit sketchy at first.  In the end, it was completely fine, but not a quintessential Boston neighborhood as one might imagine.  

In the end, I would absolutely recommend the apartment for anyone visiting Boston who is open to staying outside of the more traditional neighborhoods (e.g., Back Bay, Beacon Hill, etc.).

Everything was as advertised with this unit.  Our host was extremely responsive and met us at exactly the time we said we would arrive.  The neighborhood is safe, very walkable and there is much to do within walking distance.  Public transportation is just a few minute walk as well.

The unit was clean and modern.  It was easy to feel at home.  The second bed is very small, so more appropriate for two smaller persons but the master bedroom has a queen bed.

We would stay there again in a heart beat.

Thank you David
We had a great time in Boston
Your apartment was so nice and clean.
 We enjoyed our stay and you were very available and flexible
the neighborhood was very pleasant and quiet.
Sincerely
Patricia

I stayed at John's condo for three nights on a business trip.  The condo itself was immaculate and in a great location!  It has a great view of the harbor and the room was very comfortable.  John was very accommodating and helpful.  He is a great source of knowledge on things to do, places to eat, etc.  (Not to mention, an interesting guy to talk to).  I highly recommend John and his condo, and will definitely consider staying there again in the future should my travels bring me back to Boston.

Great apartment in a great location. Clean and homely.
Lev is really friendly and makes sure you get all the information you need in advance, including where to get good local tacos (useful information if you're jet lagged).
Lev also goes out of his way to make you feel at home. Recommended.
We had a great time at Damon's place. He was really helpful and accommodating. As we stayed an entire month we got to know him and his daughter and felt like we were home.

It was one of the best my airbnb experiences. Karin was sweet! The room is nice, the kitchen is very well furnished (was happy to use Greek ibrik for making coffee every morning), the district is safe and beautiful (hills are good for running). I made my 'last-minute' booking and was delighted with that choice. And Karin's cats are super cool!

This place was incredible! Stayed here with 2 other people for a business trip and felt at home and extremely relaxed. So close to a wonderful running trail around the water. The rooms and living space looked even better in person than in the pictures. Robert was extremely accommodating and we had no issues picking up keys and getting in. He even let me know where I should park to avoid getting towed! Would absolutely stay here on my next trip.

This was my first time using AirBNB.  The place was perfect.  The location is ideal if you want to see Boston, but also, to live: the T the grocery are on the block, and the movies, shopping and historical monuments are a few blocks away.  

Chris and Kelly were ideal hosts.  Their place was as comfortable as any top end hotel, and cooler than any of them.  for a downtown apartment, it was quiet and felt safe.  Would love to come back.

I had great time staying at Adam's place for a week.

The apartment was extremely clean, and had a very modern interior which I enjoyed. Perfect location - only a couple minutes walk to the Green Line.

Although I did not get to interact with Adam that much, I got to hang out his roommate who was very friendly and polite. 

Definitely recommended!

John's apartment is very nice, clean and very well located.
He was a very helpful host and I can recommend this place very much.
Thank you John.

This was a great place with great hosts. Pratap and Tam were welcoming, very friendly, and always responded quickly and clearly to questions. The location is ideal, a quiet street surrounded by nearby stores, restaurants and services, not to mention a T stop a short walk away. The apartment is comfortable and clean. Kitchen and bathroom need some upgrading but all basic amenities are there. During our stay we had a couple of technical glitches but our hosts made every effort to get them fixed quickly. Thanks, Pratap and Tam, for making our stay so great.

The location of the apartment is amazing. The place is very new. The beds and pillows are comfortable, the bathroom was clean, the kitchen has everything you need. The apartment is small but the amenities, location, and the level of cleanliness makes up for that. The only bad thing about our stay was that we were able to check in pretty late at around 5pm since the apartment was not cleaned and ready for us at the time we aggressive on, 3pm.

I was due to visit Jacklyn's place with three friends as part of a trip. Unfortunately, I had to return home early, so wasn't able to make it, but my friends still stayed there. They absolutely loved it and said it was the best place they stayed on our trip

Robert was a welcoming host and the room and bath in his home are lovely.  This is a very convenient location, an easy walk to the main shopping/restaurant street in Jamaica Plain and also an easy walk to the T for public transportation into Boston.

Shawn and Nik were great hosts!
They had a really nice house, were great to talk to and extremely helpful in giving tips about Boston. 
At the same time they were also respectful about my privacy.

Great place to stay and Jazz was really flexible with arrival time and when I came and went.  She even saved me since it was raining like crazy when I arrived and she hooked me up with a jacket and umbrella.  She definitely bent over backwards to try and make sure I had a nice stay.

I enjoyed my stay in this room. I went for a business trip so didn't really need much. Chris was really friendly and helpful. He was readily available via text and very accommodating to my schedule. I liked the neighborhood. It was really quiet.

Our stay with Ben and Molly was wonderful. Since the enormous sympathy and affection with which they treated us to the incredible room and breakfest they provided. Oh, and their kitten, Maya, is super nice too! The apartment is in a quiet and safe neighborhood, really close to the airport subway station and another station that served us. In short, our stay with them was the best and we certainly would choose their home again.

It was stylish, comfortable and exactly the same as described. The location is also great, right in the heart of shopping areas. Restaurants, parks, sightseeing spots are all in walking distance. As a person who went to school in Boston for years, I highly recommended it for its classical style and convenient location.
Fantastic condo in a fantastic location. No WiFi, but used the free service in a coffee shop across the street. Byron was a wonderful host. Overall, couldn't have been happier.

Place was vibrant and very artistic. Good sized bedroom with a smaller bed upstairs. Clear instructions for around the unit. Location was easy to get to and from with a beautiful view on the upstairs patio.

What a find--the perfect  location to stay in Boston! 
Nicole and Jason's place is great for exploring the city, and the apartment itself couldn't be any nicer--super cozy with amazing amenities. Beautiful place, well arranged with attention to every detail, lovely decor, just as it appears in the photos. Hope to return again soon!

We had a wonderful time staying with Antoinette and Louis in there beautiful home. We found them very warm and welcoming. Our room on the third was very airy, spacious and bright. We were able to have a lovely breakfast in the kitchen every morning. We were able to use the washer too, which was handy. They are a wealth of information on what to see and do in Boston. Their house is located in Jamica Plain, on the Orange T line & No. 39 bus route.
Their are lots of resturants, bars & shops on the Main Street. Handy if you want to eat local. We would highly recommend anyone to stay here.

Joe's place is incredible. Everything from the basic amenities (fast Wifi--for those on work trips this is a must!) to the finishing touches, it has everything you need. I wasn't able to meet Joe but the ease with which he communicated things to me and the nice welcome touches in the apartment were more than cordial. His place is well-kept, the location is near the Green Line C and D, and if you've got tickets to a Sox game this location is hard to beat. Excellent stay, and now feeling extremely lucky that I managed to snag these few days in what I am sure is a popular spot.

Thank you so much. Your apartment was perfect. I appreciate you letting me stay there. I loved the granola and the coffee:)
Kelly

What a great place to stay! Charming neighborhood and the home is lovely -- nicely decorated, bright and airy, and we loved the back balcony as a place to unwind in the evening.  Andrew could not have been more helpful -- very quick to respond to our initial inquiry and to all questions thereafter; plus he gave us good recommendations for some places to eat.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend it.  I hope to go back again sometime. In fact, I threatened to move in and never leave, I liked it so much.

There was good communication prior to and during stay. Host was nice and helpful . The apartment is clean and nicely decorated with a well equipped kitchen. Bedroom is quiet and very comfortable. The location is superb, close to restaurants, cafes and amenities. Overall, a very pleasant stay.

We loved our time at Andrew's house. Not only is it a lovely place - the bedroom and bathroom are ideal - but he was the perfect host. He was so friendly and generous and really made our Boston experience. All his recommendations - sightseeing, restaurants, wine and music - were spot on. Couldn't have been a better way to spend our time in Boston - thanks again Andrew!

We experienced an excellent two nights  in the appartment of Glenn. The appartment is very spacious and nicely decorated. All items like towels, hairdryer and kitchen supplies are available in the appartment. 

The neighborhood has a nice atmosphere and is located quite convenient. Public transportation is nearby. 

We arrived late, but this was no problem at all. The associate of Glenn,  Vivian was available to welcomed us. When we asked for a place to store our luggage after check out, this was also arranged for us. Thank you so much for a great service!

Craig was very welcoming and even took the time to walk us to a local restaurant when we arrived a little late in the evening. He was a mine of helpful information about the area and places to go. The townhouse is exactly as described and as the other reviewers have said. It was a 2 minute walk for me to get to the Harvard Graduate School of Education and only very slightly further to the T stop in Harvard Square. The house was well equipped clean and comfortable. It was lovely to have the air-conditioning as it was hot and humid. If we return to the area, Craig will definitely be our first choice. We thoroughly recommend this property.

We had a wonderful stay with Ella & Will. From the start they were incredibly accommodating, particularly when we had some travel plans change. There apt was exactly as advertised.  We had sufficient room for ourselves and 2 little ones under 3 and it was lovely to be able to spend some time downstairs in the kitchen/living area while the kids slept.   The area is just a block away from Roslindale Village and Ella & Will had a large book describing places to go in the area.  We had a lovely dinner at Sophia's Grotto and enjoyed a few trips to Fornax for coffee and baked goods.   They are only minutes from the commuter train and we were able to get into the city for the afternoon without trouble (and headed back in time to enjoy a wonderful Farmer's market in town on Saturday afternoon).   It was a lovely trip and we're looking forward to visiting Boston again soon!
Great location close to Harvard Sq and Central Station. Bedroom and ensuite were very nice. We were accommodated by the hosts flat mates as he was out of town, everything went smoothly. Thanks

I've never been to Boston so I was extremely excited to visit. We checked in smoothly and we're delighted when we stepped into jeremiah's place. Beautifully decorated, very clean and oh so quiet! The bed was very comfortable and we slept like babies. Jeremiah was so sweet and left us a 6 pack of their local brew. The location was perfect. An easy stroll to all the bars and restaurants. The area is so gorgeous and my only complaint was that we only stayed 3 nights! We will definitely be back and will absolutely stay at jeremiah's place again.

Friends and I stayed at Sarah' during the weekend of New Years Eve.  The location is lovely, quiet and quaint with great restaurants, bars and cafe' all within walking distance. We felt very cozy and at home. I can see a small family having a wonderful time in their space.  Sarah was very accommodating and checked in with us over the weekend to see how our stay was going!   Would love to come back in the summertime to make use of their roof deck with great views of the city!

Location of the apartment was great, lovely neighborhood, close to the metro station, walking distance to the center.
Everything was as described, warm, new and clean apartment. Paul was an excellent host; he provided everything we needed and even more. 
I totally recommend Paul’s place to anyone visiting Boston
Lev was a great host! He was friendly and accommodating. He allowed us to check in early and check out late due to our travel schedule, was a great help!

Bruce and Larry are the true hosts of boston! In their fantastic house ,closer to a huge mansion actually, they received my wife and I with warmth and generosity. The room is spacious and features an extra hammock space plus interesting personal stuff. The three bathrooms are shared. What we really enjoyed was that we could participate in the day to day life of the household that also included some truly sympathetic post doc students. But at the same time it was very private if we needed it. The subway is a few minutes walk from the house and therefore an excellent base to explore the city. Last but not least we were lucky to experience that Bruce really is an excellent chef indeed! We know where to return to when in Boston. Tot ziens!
I cannot imagine a more charming place to stay in Boston: A gracious host, a lovely carriage house, and a quiet, charming neighborhood.

The neighborhood is lovely, quiet and peaceful.
Chris is the most terrific host; really what Airbnb is about. He creates such a warm, comfortable and welcoming environment.  It was a pleasure to be in his home. After spending all day in a stuffy hotel conference room, it was so nice to be able to walk outside and then enjoy hospitality and great conversation. One of my very best experiences!

Just stayed at Richards place with three coworkers/friends and thoroughly enjoyed the apt. It was very clean and comfortable. The location was great with T stops within steps of the building but also walking distance to many sites and neighborhoods. Check-in was a breeze. We picked the self-clean option and it wasn't much work at all. Richard was great to communicate with prior to our arrival and was very quick to respond which I really appreciated. I would absolutely recommend staying here.

Our stay with Jez and Ken was fantastic. They were both SO kind and eager to help us with all our travelling needs. We thoroughly enjoyed visiting with them and found them to be perfect hosts. We stayed with them at the end of a three week trip, so we were a bit tired and they seemed to know what we needed and we felt pampered. Ken works in the travel industry and knows exactly how to help his guests.... he even took us and our mound of luggage to the airport, which was just great. Our accomadations were fantastic, actually, even nicer than the photo's, so I highly recommend their home to others. Thanks so much Ken and Jez for everything - it was a real pleasure to meet you.

Terry has a beautiful apartment in the South End of Boston that was a pleasure to stay at. We stayed for the Boston Marathon, and Terry helped us get oriented with the city and was very helpful and friendly. We enjoyed staying here immensely. The apartment is in a perfect area to walk around the city and to restaurants/bars, and super close to the subway as well. Highly recommended.

Great neighborhood, very nice place, well kept with upgraded furnishings and appliances and comfy.

thank you Lacey!

We stayed about 1 month in this cute apartment. The apartment is in the third floor and has a private entry. It is well-situated, very close to the subway (orange line) and bus station.  Helen and Stuart were always very warm and helpful. They responded our needs and requests promptly without exception.

My first experience with AirBnB, and it was a great one!  I was originally looking at hotels near the center of Boston because I thought we'd save money on transportation.  This room was a bit outside the city, but came with Charlie Cards, which made getting around totally stress free, with the bonus of being in a nice quieter neighborhood.  

I enjoyed the self-serve breakfasts, as I have stayed in traditional b&bs before, and not needing to report to breakfast at a specific time made it easier to plan out the rest of our day.
The room was great! Beautiful and very clean! good location!

Great apartment in a very handy location to the Boston conference centre (we walked there in 15-20 mins easily). The apartment is immaculate and incredibly well-equiped. Everything we needed was right at hand. 

Lacey even went out of her way to order extra coffee pods for us when we thought we'd run out (tip for next visitor: extra pods are in the amazon boxes in the pantry). 

Quiet neighbourhood and lovely deck outside for coffee in the morning. Plenty of eateries/bars around the corner and even more if you walk down past the conference centre to the waterfront. Easy to get taxis at night from the conference centre/hotel back to the apartment (the neighbourhood around the apartment seems safe at night but between the edge of this area and the conference centre there are a couple of blocks of warehouses etc).

Finally, if you've got an extra person (as we did) and were worried about the blow-up bed, don't be: it is the most deluxe airbed we'd ever seen. 

Overall I rate this place very highly and would stay there again if I was coming to Boston for a conference. Thanks Lacey!

We loved Mark's apartment - beautifully decorated, well stocked, great neighborhood.  It was spacious and it was great to have an additional room (3rd bedroom set up as an office) in which to put our baby's travel cot. We would definitely stay again.

We had the best experience at Helder's family's home!  His wife greeted us when we arrived and was so helpful and accommodating.  The room was very comfortable and clean... perfect.  And the morning coffee... delicious!  I had the chance to chat with Helder over coffee in their cozy kitchen... what a great guy!  :-) I can't express how nice our stay was... phenomenal!

Akiko's apartment is located in a quiet neighborhood with many transportation options nearby. Akiko was a very hospitable host, providing me with essentially everything I needed during the stay. She was also very helpful with recommendations for things to do and places to eat. I would definitely recommend booking here!

Bob is an awesome house and made me feel very welcome at his great Duplex apartment.  He was very responsive on all our communications prior to (and after) my stay.   I was visiting Boston for a wedding and the location was perfect, just 10 minutes walk to the reception.  Bob welcomes me with bottled water and made me feel right at home.  Great host, great place!

Staying here was really a 5-star experience. Nicole and Jason were great hosts - welcoming and accomodating and Nicole's book of personal Boston recommendations is wonderful.
The apartment is centrally located, in a great neighborhood, in a beautiful, elegant building. The apt. itself is even more beautiful than in the photos and very clean! It is rather small, but very well planned and organised with tons of storage space, so that even a family of four (like us) can feel comfortable. 
To sum it all up - we loved it and wholeheartedly recommend staying at Nicole and Jason's apt.

We had a wonderful time in this apartment. Molly and Ben are wonderful hosts, extremely nice and helpful. 
The location of the apartment is very convenient, only 1 subway stop from downtown Boston.
The place is very nicely decorated and having our own bathroom was a huge plus!
We would definitely stay there again and highly recommend it!
Jez is a very nice guy. And the room is very clean and nice.

We didn't see much of Maria, but she still managed to make us feel very welcome, leaving us a simple but delicious breakfast each morning. The house is lovely, the bedroom is large and very cosy, the shower in the private bathroom is a delight! Lots of useful information on Boston in the room for guests. Buses, metro and cycle hire all very close so travelling around the city is very easy. There was ample street parking outside for our car, and many lovely restaurants near by for dinner. Highly recommended.

This was a perfect spot to stay in Boston!  Moshen has am excellent host and super friendly. The place is right next to the T and easy to get to all the spots all over town in 30 mins or less.  Definitely a place I would stay in again.  Thank you, Moshen!!!
Debbie went out of her way on very short notice to make this a memorable week. Good communication before and during the stay. Great host, gorgeous brownstone.

This place was above and beyond all expectations.  Couldn't ask for anything more.  Better than any hotel experience you could have.  The price was great for what you get.  Chris and Kelly were great.  They were very hospitable, making sure we had anything and everything we could need.

This was our first experience using Airbnb and it was great! 

The home was exactly as it was depicted in the listing; situated in a lovely quiet neighbourhood that was so much fun to explore. 
There was easy/walk-able access to the transit lines which was a huge help in getting us to and from the city. 

The home had all the amenities we required, the WiFi was great and the beds we comfortable! 

Pratap & Tam were such great hosts, they were accommodating when we had a late arrival time on Friday and even offered for us to rent their parking space from them to avoid being troubled with re-feeding the parking meter every couple of hours. 

We would definitely recommend this spot!

We had a wonderful time at Rays. Jamaica Plain is an area full of character, which matches Ray exactly. The room was clean, spacious and comfortable, and Ray proved to be the consumate host. If he hadn't recommended The Galway Bar, it was the sort of place you would have walked right past.....quickly! But inside it was good beer, good food and good company both sides of the bar. All that was missing from our visit was a chance to watch Ray and his class practising their Yoga. The area is full of good cafes,shops and interesting places to see. If your are visiting Boston, then Rays place is the place to be.
Bruce and Barry's place was a wonderful experience!  Super friendly and helpful.  Perfect location, just a 10-15 min subway ride to downtown.  Would highly recommend!

What a fantastic first Airbnb experience! The apartment was easy to find and Marie personally welcomed us when we arrived. She had all sorts of information ready for us and answered any questions we had about getting around town. The apartment itself is in a beautiful, safe, quiet neighborhood within a mile or two from the north end and downtown (about a 25 minute walk). It's also only a few blocks from the Bunker Hill Monument, one of the coolest landmarks in Boston.

The apartment was also incredibly clean and well-decorated. Needless to say, we felt very well taken care of.

If you're on the fence at all about staying at this place, just go for it. You won't be disappointed.

My wife and me stayed at Robert's for a week, having a really good thanks to all the attentions of our host.  At our arrival it was raining and  he  came and pick us up at the T train station! It was fun having a chat or two using words in Italian,  Portuguese, French and English all mixed up. Rocco, the dog, is a peaceful,  good boy. We had a bathroom all for ourselves and sharing the kitchen with Robert was never a problem.
We were the problem, as a matter of fact, always cooking full meals! For all the rest we cannot but confirm what the other guests have written in their reports.
All in all an accommodation to be recommended to anyone.
I had a great stay at Paul's place.  Great location, very clean, and super convenient.  Paul was very accomodating and made my visit easy.

This room is fantastic! Huge, with its own bathroom, clean and recently decorated and in the entire upper floor of a beautiful 120 year old house. Alex and Matt are kind, generous people and went so far beyond to help that they make wonderful hosts. They are genuine and obviously really enjoy people. Thank you for everything.
Everything was great. All communication from very beginning clear and prompt. The loft was ideal. Very comfortable and spacious. Would and will stay again. a 10 out of 10.

Natasha's apartment was perfect!  The location was great and it had tons of natural light!  Natasha was also a great hostess.  The apartment was very clean and Natasha had thought of everything we'd need (including toiletries, a hairdryer, and even a few Boston guidebooks).  Natasha's communication was also excellent throughout!  We would definitely stay here again!

Linda was a great host. It was our first time using Airbnb and she made it a pleasant experience. She went above and beyond providing us with breakfast every morning. She was also a great help making suggestion and navigating the city of Boston for us. Highly recommend!

Great apartment in an awesome, convenient location. We had a comfortable stay throughout and would recommend Jay's place to anyone looking for Boston lodging that's just a quick walk from the Charles/MGH red line T stop, with a nice little grocery (not to mention CVS) around the corner. Jay was a responsive host throughout, and we really liked that the bathroom came stocked with toiletries galore - not always true of other AirBnB experiences!

Maria was a great host, and her home was clean and cozy! The house was close to lots of wonderful shops and restaurants (check out Ten Tables if you want a romantic dinner) and the T or subway. Driving in Boston is a nightmare so it was nice to take the T everywhere. And it's cheap, only 18$ for a 7 day pass. She even recommended that we go to Cape Cod/Chatham beach which was only 1.5 hours drive and a gorgeous little spot. It was a great time and I'd definitely recommend it. 
Thanks again Maria!

Manika was more of a hostess than just a "landlord". She met us at the apartment early as we had just gotten off a cruise ship and needed to get in early. She showed us around and let us know the lay of the land, including a rooftop one can go to to see the city, and eat a meal. Her place was clean and she had those extra touches like coffee, tea and snacks. The bed was extremely comfortable and fresh towels were there for us to use. The location is stellar as its a stones throw from the common, and the trolleys. Next door are two wonderful restaurants. Along with a wonderful attitude of Manika's it was a sweet little find on airbnb.

The apartment was definitely true to the photos and to it's write-up.  It was clean and well-appointed although we didn't take advantage of the kitchen facilities.  There are so many places to eat out in Boston, we didn't bother with trying to feed ourselves.
The location was great.  There are bus lines and subway stations very close by and the neighbourhood was comfortable to walk around with a coffee shop just steps away.
The host was very helpful and solicitous to our needs and responded quickly to questions before our arrival.  We did not meet her but the instructions for getting into the apartment and for the use of facilities in the apartment were clear.
I would recommend this accommodation with no qualms.  I slept in the foldout "chair" in the office space for 5 nights--very comfortable it was.

We had a great visit to Boston.  Wonderful neighborhood, easy to get around the city, and Adam is a friendly and helpful host.  The room was very clean and larger than we expected!  Would definitely stay there again for future visits.
Chris was a welcoming host, very generous with her home. I hope to stay there again soon! The house is very convenient to Curry College.
Everything as announced! An excellent person and very helpfull! I recommend!

This could be the 8th Wonder of the World.  In fact, move over Taj Mahal and make this quiet little hideaway #7.  Great location, great amenities, great host.  Everything about this gem exceeded my expectations.
Great location in Boston, just few minute walk to subway , common park and chinatown. Room very clean and comfortable. Lev is very friendly and super helpful host.

We had to arrive late in the evening and we were made to feel so welcome. Our host had a basket of snacks ready and offered us beverages as well. The room was perfect and bed very comfortable. We also had a very flight out of Logan the next morning and really appreciated the coffee and breakfast set up. Perfect location is you are coming and going through Logan. Only wish we could have had a longer stay.
The apartment is in a great location - very close to everything on Hanover Street and Salem Street.  It's also very clean and comfortable. We had a great time and highly recommend Gene's apartment!
Natasha proved to be a responsive, welcoming, flexible host.  Her Beacon Hill apartment is immaculate, inviting, and incredibly well located in the city.

First of all, Chirstian is a stand-up guy. He was very communicative the whole time, and even though I never met him, he seems to be an incredibly nice person. The apartment is very cozy with all the amenities; perfect for 1-2 people. It's in the best location in Boston; Beacon Hill is a beautiful neighborhood. Also it's one block from the T which was very convenient!

A lovely apartment - bright, clean, spacious, in a good area and only a few minutes walk from the 'T'. Alison was a great host, very communicative and answered our queries really quickly.
