Charles met us to on our arrival to give us the keys. His place was exactly as pictured... incredible views and location. We thought about renting a car, but didn't need one at all. Everything is within walking, short taxi or bus rides. It was indeed like staying in a luxury hotel and we will definitely make a return visit.

Bruce's place was exactly as described.  Breakfast was wonderful  He and Barry were absolutely superb hosts!  They were very kind and gracious as they gave us tips on places to go and see.  Every travel recommendation was spot on!  We loved sitting and chatting with them over breakfast and at night when we arrived back in....would liked to have had more time to do this!  They were a such a pleasure to get to know! I would recommend, without reservation, this listing to anyone wanting to visit this area!

We had a wonderful stay at the Carney family's house. Mary and Barney are great hosts and they provided us with great information about the area and the possibilities of sightseeing. The communication before the stay was perfect. We received detailed information. Our room and the bathroom were very clean. The location of the house is perfect with the metro station near by. I definitely recommend the Carney familiy to other airbnb travelers!

We had a wonderful stay at Alicia and Kostas' place. The house is beautiful, welcoming and hospitable. The hosts are wonderful people, we felt like we've met old friends. We had morning coffee with them and shared our life stories in the beautiful yard under a grapevine canopy. The entire neighborhood is charming, close to the train and lots of good restaurants. We walked back from watching the 4th of July fireworks at midnight and felt safe. 
 Thank you very much, Alicia and Kostas for the great place to stay and the best memories.

Robin was a fantastic host. I needed a quiet place close to BU to get some work done while in town. It happened to snow heavily while I was there, which changed my work plans. Robin was very accommodating, including making me breakfast one morning when the snow was particularly daunting! I had all the quiet I needed, and the place was very close to the train stop. A very positive experience!

This was our first time using Air BNB and it was better than anything we could have expected. Our host was vey accommodating about us checking in early since we were traveling thru the night. The condo was in a great neighborhood and the pictures didn't do it justice. Zach provided detailed instructions that made our stay hassle free and very enjoyable. When we return to Boston in the future we will try and use them again for sure.

We stayed here while visiting Boston for a quick weekend tour.  We had a wonderful time and were awed by the spaciousness, luxury and cleanliness of Seth’s apartment.  This is perfectly located for easy walking distance to all the major sights in north Boston or just a quick stroll to the ferry or subway to get further afield.  Apartment is close to a number of local restaurants or enjoy the gorgeous kitchen and rooftop to relax and appreciate the city from above.  Seth was wonderful to deal with and even the neighbors were friendly! Certainly hope to stay again on our next trip to Boston . Many thanks , Victor

Alice was a great host and the accommodations fit exactly what I needed for my week-long trip. Alice's beautiful Victorian home is conveniently located steps away from the green T line, which made it easy to get to the design conference I was attending at the Hynes Convention Center. The private room/bathroom were clean and Alice kindly left snacks, yogurt, fruit, and juice in the in-room fridge. The room was a good size (perfect for 1-2 people) and the bed was really comfortable. If you're looking for a charming place to stay, this is it! I look forward to my next trip to Boston, where I hope to stay at Alice's again!
We had a quick night here with a late check-in and an early check-out. The place was in top condition and I would happily recommend anyone staying here.

Robin was a great host. She answered my questions quickly and made last minute changes to my reservation without a fuss. Instructions for getting in and out of the house were easy to follow and the house was clean. The Roost was exactly what we needed for a girls getaway weekend in Boston. The house allowed for our group of 8 to play games and eat in one space but yet still gave us individual space and private time. In addition, the closeness to the green line (literally outside the door) made transport into Boston quick and easy. The Brookline neighborhood also had many interesting restaurants and eateries that I wish we would have had time to try out. This was my first Airbnb experience and it exceeded my expectations.

Some friends and I stayed at Rachel's condo while we were in town for the Boston Marathon and it was fantastic!  Her place is in a great location in relation to the subway, restaurants, shopping and everything related to the Marathon.  The space is beautiful and we all thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  I would definitely recommend Rachel's place for anyone who's planning on visiting Boston.

Our stay was amazing! The apartment is even better than in the pictures! It's perfect and Richard has thought of everything! It's a great location and I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a place to stay in Boston! We'll definitely be back!

Thank you for everything and making our stay so great!
This was my first time using AirBNB. It was terrific across the board. Robert was great in getting us into the place and giving us recommendations on places to eat and go I the neighborhood.

We booked this for three nights at the end of our American Road Trip and what a way to end it.  Fabulous!  The cottage itself is charming, comfortable and cheerful with everything one could want and email communication was outstanding. Susan and Steve are welcoming, friendly, gracious and  eager to assist without being intrusive.  We felt at ease immediately.  There were  lots of suggestions and advice which was very helpful and an abundance of literature with which to research the area.  The cottage is in a very pleasant suburb about half an hour away from the city centre.  Using the 'bus is very convenient and easy and it was nice to have a rest from driving!  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and our only regret is that we could not have stayed longer.

Chris and Kelly were outstanding hosts, making us feel welcomed and comfortable for our stay.  Their lovely home was beautiful and extraordinarily well-maintained, and it was a fantastic base for our family to use to explore Boston.  We will definitely stay again!

We were welcomed by Matt and Ashley like friends from out of town. They were very flexible with our arrival time and allowed us to come by early in the morning to drop off our bags. Their charming loft was just as it appears in the photos. Everything was very clean and ready for our visit. If you decide to eat at home the kitchen is fully stocked and the patio is a great place to relax right in the heart of the city. The location is fantastic! We were just a couple of minutes to the Back Bay T station (orange line) and just a couple minutes further was the Copley T station (green line). We purchased a three day transit pass and this worked out great for us to see the sites. It's a short walk to Newbery Street, Boston Commons, Copley Square, Public Library, Boston Ballet, and Tremont Street is right around the corner. Fenway Park is not far away either, we went to a game and walked home in about 20-25 minutes. On Sunday we went to the South End Open Market @ SOWA. It was about a 15 minutes walk and a cool way to act like a local. They have areas dedicated to a farmer's market, crafts, vintage goods, and food trucks. Allow a good half day for this great activity. All in all, you should feel very fortunate if you can schedule some time in Matt and Ashley's wonderful home.
Great place, nice hosts, extremely accommodating to things like airplane delays and such. Would recommend to anyone!

Our stay with Kevin and Julia was great! The apartment was very clean and in a great location. They gave us a bunch of suggestions about places to eat and things to do. They are both very pleasant people and make you feel at home. I would highly recommend staying with them if you are headed to Boston!

We enjoyed staying in Elle's house in Boston.  Everything went as smooth as it could be. All instructions on accommodation where very precise and useful. 
The house, though not located in the heart of Boston, was quite close to the city center. We never took a bus or metro to get to the South station. It took about 40 minutes of slow walking.
While walking from her house to the center and back we enjoyed the atmosphere of old america on East Broadway.
The apartments were clean and comfy. Also we liked Cowboy, the Elle's dog.

It's a lovely apt! And Jason is a nice person. He provided a clean and comfortable environment for us. Only has one bedroom so I slept on the sofa cause my dad used bedroom. There are many restaurants and shops near the apt. It's very convenient and just need to walk a few mins can arrived at underground station. This is a nice experience:)

Thanks to Luis for helping to make our stay in Boston great! The six days flew by and were filled with activity so it was a relief to have such a convenient location to come back to each night. The apartment is a short walk to the nearest T station, grocery market, Fenway Park, and the restaurants/bars surrounding the park. Luis was very flexible with the check-in and check-out times too which was helpful as our flights were at odd times.

Diana was extremely helpful and flexible as we had been let down by another host and needed accommodation at very short notice.
The condo is well placed for Harvard Square and many restaurants and bars.  It feels very safe and I was comfortable walking back there late at night.
The condo is spacious and well equipped, it was very clean and tidy.
Diana and Kevin were there to greet us and show us around and then left us to enjoy our stay.  They were there to say goodbye to us when we left mid to late afternoon.  We left our luggage in the condo as our flight was not until 9.30 pm and that made life a lot easier.
I thoroughly enjoyed staying and would do so again.  I have recommended the condo to other Harvard parents!

Helen was a fantastic host!  She and and her husband were very hospitable. I was pleasantly surprised with the accomodations.  The pictures do not serve Helen's apartment justice.  I strongly recommend staying with Helen!  She even provided us with delicious treats in the morning!

Our trip was just perfect! We really enjoyed staying at Marie and Gerard ' s home. The apartment was the perfect size for my husband and I along with our two little girls. It's wonderful to be able to come "home" for the night out of the major part of the city and enjoy the amenities of a kitchen and laundry, close to wholefoods. The neighborhood was so adorable! The apartment was lovely. Thank you for having us!

My friend and I had decided only two weeks ago to go to Boston, and only a week ago to bring our wives. Looking at all the options available, Frank's place was the perfect location at a great price. It's a 3-story walk-up with the second and third-stories being the apartment. We were on a road trip up there from Atlanta, and were caught in a huge thunderstorm on the way. I almost thought that our reservation had been cancelled, but Frank pulled through at the last minute and allowed us to stay. If you saw the pictures of the place, they don't really do justice. The place was immaculately clean. They left us fresh towels and soap. The private parking area with gated lock was also great for leaving the car without worry. My only regret is not being able to stay longer. If you're looking for a great place that's close to Boston, the airport, that's clean, comfortable and relaxed, then definitely hit up Frank's place!

A nice spacious property situated in a good location with easy access to local shops, close to bustling Coolidge Corner and a convenient commute to down town Boston. We stayed for 3 nights and found the property had plenty of room for 5 adults and a toddler and everything we required.

We spent 4 nights in this huge and beautiful house. Carney family is very friendly and answered all our questions about Boston. The location is great, the rooms/bathrooms are very spacious and clean and breakfast delicious. We have a  very pleasant stay. Thank you!

Charlestown may seem a little out of the way if you're looking at a guidebook but this was a great location.  There are shops and restaurants within a few minutes walk, and a subway station 10 mins walk away.

After the first couple of nights we moved to the other suite in the building (http://www.airbnb.com/rooms/29765) because there had been a cancellation.  It swapped a washing machine and balcony for a well-appointed kitchen, which suited us better.  Both were gorgeous and confortable, though :-)

Elizabeth was charming, kind and helpful, and we'd be happy to stay there again if we come back to Boston/Cambridge.

We stayed at Nicole and Jason's Back Bay apartment for a week in February 2015. The apartment was really special. Not only is it very well appointed as in the photographs, with great heating and comfortable furnishings, but there is a lovely view to the Charles river from the bedroom and living room windows. 
The location is perfect for exploring Boston, near enough to walk to everything and in a very pretty neighbourhood. We really enjoyed the stroll down Comm Ave and through the Public Garden before heading out to dinner each evening.
This was by no means our first time in Boston, however definitely the best place we have stayed and would certainly stay here again.
Nicole and Jason were away at the time of our stay, however we met one of their lovely friends who waited for us after our train had been delayed over 2 hours to meet with the keys and show us around the apartment.
Great place and great people. Definitely recommend this one if you love Boston!

Jez N Ken were great! The location was awesome and their home perfect. 
Stephen & Sharon
Jazz was an excellent host. The description was accurate and I felt at ease at the apartment. The neighborhood and location was great.

Jay was great at communicating and responded quickly via email or phone. He made sure we needed everything for our stay and helped us handle the snags that came up.

The apartment itself is nice. It's spacious and up to date. Location is great; very close to Centre Street in Jamaica Plain, the Arnold Arboretum, and Jamaica Pond.

Only downside is that it is easy to hear the neighbors. It's nothing out of the ordinary, and the neighbors I met were very nice, but it's something to be aware of.

Joseph was a great host.  We had the chance to speak twice, he was friendly and had suggestions on things to do in the area.
The flat was spacious and quite nice.  There was coffee, cream, soda and bottled water, as well as fruit and snacks, which was quite thoughtful.  It is 1/2 mile from the subway, and 1/2 mile from the ocean, which was a great place for a morning or evening walk.
I had a great stay, and will certainly stay again the next time I find myself in Boston.

I really enjoyed my stay at Scott's! The room was very clean and comfy. It has a nice view to the nearby park and is conveniently located close to the Brookline Village T stop. I walked almost every day to Kenmore Square via the pathway next to the little stream and loved the area. The ambient sound level in the room was a bit higher than what I am used to, but that was not significant enough to prevent me from relaxing or to affect my sleep pattern. Scott is a great host, eager to provide all kinds of helpful tips and directions. All in all, I would definitely recommend staying at Scott's.

Really enjoyed our stay in Charlestown. The apartment was spacious, and had everything we needed and more. It was very comfortable. The bed was superb.
The apartment is on a very quiet street, and two mins walk to main bus route to city. We also walked to City, yo do the tourist walk.
Also a couple of blocks from good supermarket and nice casual eating places.
Gerad was very hospitable and friendly. Gave us some great ideas for local sightseeing and further afield.
Fiola's place is great! It has everything you could need and is close to attractions. I'd recommend!

Kevin was an excellent host with a fabulous South Boston condo.  He made sure we arrived ok and had a welcome basket waiting on the coffee table.  In this, he highlighted parking areas and made recommendations on places to eat and things to do.  The neighborhood is lively on Saturday and Sunday mornings with breakfast spots and a beach about two blocks away.  The condo is even better in person.  The bedroom and bathroom are both much bigger and more comfortable then they appear in the pictures.

Robert is a true host-generous, helpful and gracious. The apartment is lovely. One feels immediately at ease in the space; the decor is both minimal and warm. The bedrooms are spacious with very comfortable beds. The neighborhood is quiet, yet bustling with day to day activity.  Without hesitation we recommend Robert as a host, the digs, location and host- for a seamless visit in the greater Boston area.
Mark's condo was ideal for us - spacious, well- kept, comfortably hip, conveniently located to  Brookline parks, shops, restaurants, and  (most importantly) to our new grandson. We shall return!

Our 2nd ever airbnb experience & first in Boston! What a lovely home Jason & Stephanie have! The minute we stepped in (tho some difficulty lugging up a luggage on the narrow staircase up) we were so impressed with the cosy decor of the living room etc. And warmly greeted by their 2 adorable cats!! Our room was super cosy with the most comfy bed! We really appreciated all the little thoughtful extras they provided incl candies, chocolates, wine, coffee, water, maps, tourist brochures/books, earplugs (tho we didn't find any reason to use!) & even a Charlie card for the T! Room size is perfect for a couple tho bit tight with one luggage. There was an empty dresser to put stuff in if needed and TV with many channels! We had plush towels & even our own lovely bathroom to use all with toiletries provided. Basically we could use the whole house area incl kitchen even tho we didn't. Preble St is a quiet but quaint little area only minutes walk to the beach which sadly bad weather didn't permit when we were there. The Andrew T stop (redline) is practically 2 mins walk & gets us anywhere in Boston very conveniently. Tho we didn't get much chance to chat long with Jason & Stephanie, they are both very friendly & helpful. Overall we really enjoyed our stay & highly recommend this listing!

Susans cottage was perfect. It was far enough away from the hustle and bustle of the city that we found it relaxing but close enough that it was only a 5 mile drive to be back into the center of boston. She was a great host, there were packets of hot cocoa, oatmeal, and microwaveable popcorn available for us inside the cottage. She had a lot of resources including maps, recommendations, and even a two for one theater pass. She made sure that we had her sons, her husbands, hers, and the house phone number incase we had any questions or if we needed anything. If I make another trip back to the Boston area I will definitely try to book the cottage again!

Great stay in an apartment perfect for a couple.  Convenient location 2 minute walk from the subway and just a few blocks from Fenway.  Apartment is clean and updated, on the top floor of the building.  Communication during reservation process was clear and thorough.  I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to friends.
Niels was an excellent host. Very helpful and friendly! The location is great - within 15 mins walking distance to Boston Common, Newburt St, Prudential Centre, Boylston etc. Great value for money!
Lisa is very helpful and made our stay comfortable. The apartment located in Forrest Hill where is the end station of the Orange line. Would recommend to friends who want to visit Boston.

Everything went perfect with check in and out.  The unit is very large for boston and the balcony is also a huge bonus.  The location is great in beacon hill and I would highly recommend for anyone looking to have a real boston living experience.  Thanks!

My stay at Gerard and Marie's place was everything that was promised and everything I needed.  The place was comfy and inviting and Gerard and Marie were so understanding when a flight delay brought me in later than anticipated.  I will definitely return!

This was such a perfect room for the type of trip we were taking! We really only needed a place to crash, and Josef's room was more than adequate (even if we had needed to spend more time there it would have been great). It was nicely decorated, the bed was super comfortable with a nice big TV and the wifi was super fast. Another huge perk is that this room has its own private door to enter and exit out of, so you don't ever need to go through the main door if you don't feel like it. The bathroom is shared with Josef's roommate but it's a big  (well lit, for the ladies) bathroom and we were never in each others way. The neighborhood was very centrally located, which made it extremely convenient to get on the train or bus to get anywhere in the city. I will definitely stay here again the next time I'm in Boston.

Andrew and Katie couldn't have been nicer or more accommodating. The rooms were a great surprise, spanking clean, fresh paint, and large; everything felt new and very cared for. Great location as we were attending Boston Convention Center.

Mike and Tim were great hosts. Extremely friendly and knowledgable about the area. Their place is great if you want to be able to easily get around the city. 

The place was kept nice and clean and I definitely felt welcome and at home while I was there.
Wonderful hosts, the room is exactly as described with plenty of parking. I will stay at their house again, and highly recommend anyone looking in the neighborhood.

my girlfriend and i had a wonderful time. we were only there for very long but our stay was short and sweet! the bed and pillows are as a comfortable as it gets and elizabeth leaves all the ingredients for a nice breakfast.all the moroccan stylings piqued our curiosity and added to general feeling of "awesomeness" and luxury already present. additionally, there are plenty of places to eat in the neighborhood, as well as a small shopping center nearby to get whatever you need. the walk to and from the T train (orange line) is very short, and that same line will get to a bunch of points of interest (prudential center, south station, etc.).

cliff's notes: the suite is sweet and elizabeth is a very personable and personable host. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

We enjoyed our 2 night stay with Liz. She greeted us with a warm welcome and helped us upstairs to her lovely condo.  The room we stayed in was perfect for 2 and was very comfortable.   Liz has a warm, open personality and we enjoyed sitting and chatting with her.  She  had a lot of info and brochures on things to do and was very helpful giving directions on the best way to get around Boston.  We were greeted the next morning with a wonderful breakfast. 

Thank Liz for a wonderful experience.

Helen was a pleasure to deal with and her apartment was perfect for us. The location was great, we could easily walk to the subway or into Boston Common. Helen was lovely and offered some great suggestions for our time in Boston.

The stay in Carine's apt. couldn't be more comfortable.
Although Carine was out of the town during the period, she prepared everything beforehand, and her parents greeted us cordially. 

The location is nice. T stop (Englewood Ave.) right in front of the building. Bubble tea (my favorite) within 5-min walk. Many delicious delis are also in nearby. I sincerely recommend Carine's place!

My previous host cancelled my listing very last minute so I needed to find another place. Katrina was very fast and responsive and made sure we both know all the details about what we need in terms of check-in and check out time and other stuff.
Both Alan and Katrina were very welcoming and their little dog become my buddy very quick. The bedroom and the apartment in general was very clean and nice. I loved the AC in the bedroom and the bed was pretty comfortable. 
The best feature of the apartment is the location! This apartment is very close to Liberty hotel if you're into bars and lounges. (highly recommend it) It's also close to really nice restaurants (check out Figs for pizzas) and most importantly super close to T-station. I had a lovely time and will be back for sure!

My husband and I had an amazing stay in Brookline at Carol's house.  The room was just as pictured, the location is perfect--located right off the T and in walking distance to great restaurants and more--and Carol was an incredible host!  She made sure we had everything we need, answered all our questions before and during our stay, and was wonderful with communication.  Overall, a fantastic AirBnB experience and we highly recommend Carol's place for a trip to the area!
It's amazing. The room was prepared very clean, tidy, and comfortable. Bob is nice guy who just let us have private room to spend all night. Great experience. Thanks.

Ed's home is so lovely.  I had a wonderful stay in "the penthouse".  The room was comfortable and clean.   The home is very well located on a lovely street in the south end.  My key thing was that the house was so close to my brother's place on East Brookline.  So I was shopping for a place to stay while visiting family.  I highly recommend it.
Robin is warm, wonderful, helpful and understanding of last minute travel changes. I highly recommend her to everyone Boston-bound!

Joanna's and Caleb's house is wonderful. It's beautifully furnished and very cosy and we felt very much at home.
We had two options: with or without cat. We chose the cat and don't regret it, Finn is a super friendly cat.
We agree fully with the other reviews - we enjoyed our stay and recommend it to anybody.

Our room was comfortable and immaculately clean. Ken and Jez have a beautiful, spotless home and property that they share with pride. They are kind, fascinating, generous, respectful hosts with in-depth knowledge of Boston's delights. Their advice made getting around town on public transportation a breeze. Top notch airbnb. You will definitely enjoy your stay.

It was wonderful! The room was clean and tidy, nicely furnished with closet, hangers, shelves, flat screen TV, a mini fridge, etc. They even prepared clean towels. Bathroom is nearly private, I love the shower head!!!!! Andy and Ben were great host, super friendly and so are the dogs (soooo cute and barely bark at all)! I would definitely recommend this place to anybody who needs an bnb in boston :)

Andy and Ben - 
We had a great time and hope that we will see you soon again in Boston!

-Alison and Yves

It was a very pleasant stay in the apartment: everything needed (and some things more) were there, and the location was very convenient. There is a good bus connection to the center of Boston, and a station of the Red Line is a 10-minute walk away. Several shops are nearby, too.
The apartment itself is very nice and clean. Even if there is a little bit noise from the street, it didn't disturbed me at all. Especially, I liked sitting on the deck belonging to the apartment.
Jason is a great host - if you need him, then he will respond immediately.

The Carneys gave thorough directions and instructions prior to our arrival, and their home was easy to find, not far off the main route to downtown Boston.  We enjoyed the quiet neighborhood, birds singing in the trees. Our room very clean, with comfortable beds.  We enjoyed our stay!

Linda was a wonderful host! She has everything so delightfully organized in
 such a way that you feel very welcome in her home. She is close enough to downtown to make it easily accessible to everything and far enough that you can park on the street with no problem and feel safe. This home is just how a airbnb should be. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Adam met us on arrival and took the time to answer all our queries. Adam and Sarah's home is exactly as described and was clean and spacious. Their back deck is a welcome retreat from the hustle and bustle of downtown Boston. 
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Jamica Plains.

This is a great place. Very clean, ideal location close by to downtown and the new Boston Convention Center, comfortable bed, clean linens, WiFi, plus a wonderful host. I would strongly recommend it to any fellow traveler.

Very cute place. It's not big, but it's designed with a really clever use of space. There's a lot of light with big windows and a nice kitchen with everything you need. Great neighborhood too. Would definitely stay there again.
Glenn was responsive immediately and accommodated us on very short notice. His apartment is in a great location in the South End. We would definitely stay at Glenn's apartment again.

My boyfriend and I visited Boston for a wedding, and Tessa's studio was a perfect base of operations. It's convenient to two T lines, though most of the time we just walked or biked. 

South End is charming, and there are lots of bars and restaurants nearby. We especially liked DavidsTea on Tremont. I liked feeling tucked away in the neighborhood, but being a short bike/T ride from downtown. 

Tessa was a wonderful host and made the process very straightforward. We  would definitely stay there again!

Seth's place is fabulous! It is large and well appointed, yet it feels intimate and friendly. The location on Monument Square, is an easy walk to the North End or drive into Cambridge or Somerville. This was our second stay and Seth has been easy to reach and communicate with. At this point he feels like a friend to us. He has dropped the keys off at my parents condo a block away, allowing us to arrive at a convenient time for us. He has a roof top deck providing great views of the area and a relaxing place to sit and have a beer with friends and family. We will try and stay with Seth whenever we are in Boston.

Great place to stay in JP. The house is very well located, just a 3 mins walk from the 39 bus stop, 12 mins walk from orange T. The neighbourhood is very nice and convenient : a lot of restaurants and shops of all kind are available and accessible by walking. The room was very spacious, clean and private with our own bathroom (all the third floor for ourselves). Also all the amenities a traveler needs is included. Maria is an excellent and absolutely wonderful host.  We enjoyed her warm hospitality tremendously! Would totally recommend !!

Our stay with Jez and Ken was above and beyond expectations.  The moment we arrived we sat down to a delicious Easter lunch and they were incredibly helpful.  Ken's private tours of Winthrop is not to be missed!  He even took Dylan to his barber for a haircut!  Their house is very clean and welcoming, and we felt very comfortable coming and going. Great snack selection! We had some great conversation over meals :) Great location to explore Boston from and it is always nice to stay with locals.

We had a great first experience using airbnb!  Maria was a helpful, knowledgeable host who made us feel at home.  The third floor room is large with a comfortable bed.  The bathroom is sunny and large. The location was great - we took the bus or "T" everywhere (and I do mean everywhere!) with ease.  The neighborhood is lovely.

Gene was great connecting with us.  After we had some difficulty in getting the keys, he met us right away.  He was very responsive to any questions we might have.

The location is ideal right in the heart of the North End a block away from Hanover.  Within walking distance to Fauneil Hall and the T.  

The apartment is clean and well kept.  It was perfect for our stay.  I would request to stay here on our next trip back.

what a great place to stay at when in Boston! Ed is the nicest of hosts, very helpful (both before arriving and during the stay), quick to answer questions, always ready for a chat. I didn't think the house could possibly be as nice as the pictures suggest, but it was! the room is spacious, clean, the bathroom is perfect and the roof deck is a wonderful place to relax or work. 
The south end is a great neighbourhood to discover Boston: it is central with easy access to public transport, it has lots of nice restaurants and it has a friendly, relaxed vibe. 
enjoy your stay!!!

The apartment was great and Jason was terrific.  The place was everything it was advertised to be--looked great, very comfortable and homey, great location and have everything we needed for a great stay in boston.  Jason met us on arrival, provided us with cookies and a bottle of wine and went out of his way to be helpful.
Joseph's apartment is amazing! It's in a great, central location and it's super clean and cosy :) I would definitely recommend staying here for your trip to Boston!

Jez and Ken were wonderful hosts. They went out of their way to accomodate us, picked us up from the airport and made sure we had everything we needed. We enjoyed our stay very much and loved the room and the location. It's very convenient to get to Boston, Logan International Airport, and enjoy the nice Winthrop neighborhood. Simply excellent!

This room was just what we needed; quiet, close to where we needed to be, accommodating hosts, clean and comfortable.

Would definitely go there again.
It was a very nice experience! Location was fabulous! Deborah was very nice and friendly! Awesome place to stay and explore Boston!

Megan and Stephen were incredibly generous, flexible with arrival time, and they even followed up to ask about the century ride that brought me to town! They were the perfect hosts! The location was also extremely convenient.

It was really a pleasant stay. Ms. Bella is very warm, friendly, welcoming and courteous . She made me feel at home within few hours of meeting and took effort to show me the neighborhood, shops, eating places for my day to day needs. The room was also very nice, neat and clean with all the necessary amenities . She has guided me throughout my stay and  even took effort to drop me at the airport on the day of leaving.. 
The apartment is very neat and clean, highly secured and in prime location of Boston, rather in the campus of MGH and next to Charles/MGH ''T'' station. So, the place is convenient from all aspects.
Overall, I had great stay and sweet memories from Boston..
Thank You, Ms. Bella for everything. You are a great host. Wish you a very happy and healthy life ahead..
Thanks  Team Airbnb.

Joseph's apartment was a great place to stay while on my brief trip to Boston. It was extremely clean, cozy, and in a fabulous part of the city! 

The communication between myself and Joseph was so easy and quick, which made planning this trip, along with getting in and out of the apartment a breeze. 

I strongly recommend this apartment to anyone who is interested in staying in the Back Bay area!

I planned this trip to Boston as a surprise for my boyfriend's birthday and Christian's apartment was absolutely perfect for us! The location is so convenient to everything.  We had two events to attend at TD Garden and we were able to walk over there in only  about 10-15 minutes.  To get anywhere else we jumped on the T just up the street from the apartment which made things so easy.  
As for the apartment itself, it was very cozy and gave us the feel of what it would be like to live in the city.  We have no complaints whatsoever although, I do feel it's worth noting that the staircase in the building is narrow and steep and the bathroom is also very small since the building is old.  We found the historical feel of the building cool but neither of us is particularly big/tall so it may not be as comfortable for someone of larger stature. That being said, we found the apartment to be phenomenal.  We would definitely love to stay there again.
Not only was the place great, Christian was also the ideal host.  We didn't get to meet him in person but he was so pleasant through all our communication, was quick to respond to any questions I had, and even went the extra mile by offering us detailed recommendations for his favorite spots near the apt and around Boston.  
Thank you Christian for being so accommodating and making our first Airbnb experience a great one!!
I extremely recommend Carney's house,clean and cozy!Mr Carney is really a nice person who cooked muffins and answered every questions patiently,I must be stay in his house if I come back someday!

My husband and three-year-old and I had a great 5-week stay at Will and Ella's place in Roslindale. We enjoyed the neighborhood and found it easy to get around using public transportation.

The apt. feels clean and brand new and we enjoyed using the small backyard for eating and playing.

Diana

Kevin made us feel very welcome. He was very accommodating with our checkin/out schedule. The apartment is extremely clean and we loved being near the water in a young and vibrant neighborhood. The location was perfect - a short uber ride to South/North end. I definitely want to stay here again!

Melissa's home is close to everything in JP and yet feels unlike a busy city neighborhood. We felt completely comfortable in the space and lots of privacy. It was especially nice to have Acacia (the dog) to keep us from missing our dog. Thanks for being so flexible and kind, Melissa!

I had a great time with Scott!
He was very welcoming and helpful with everything. The house was clean and everything in the room was perfect. Besides, the location was very convenient. Definitely a place to stay if you go to Boston!
This apartment worked very well to home some of my out of town colleagues who were in Boston for a team retreat.  Dorothy was very accommodating and the apartment was clean, neat and easy to stay in.

Looking for a chance to experience historic Cambridge at its best?  By staying with a gracious host and her welcoming teenage son in a lovely, art-filled home?  You'll find no better lodging alternative near Harvard Square than this.  It was a joy each morning to wake up and look out through the trees surrounding my second-floor room.  An adjacent office (with window) provided a comfortable place to work.  When not sitting outside on a private, landscaped terrace.  I'm eagerly anticipating my next visit:  THIS is the real deal.

Jay's place is well place in between all the great sights and night spots the city has to offer.
The place is immaculate and comfortable. I would def recommend staying here.
As for Jay, he was attentive and was there to answer any questions.
It was a great stay.

We enjoyed our stay at the cottage which was cheerful and comfortable. We especially appreciated the good bed,  good lighting for reading, wifi and the extra amenities in the kitchen which made settling in very easy. Susan checked in on us regularly to see if we needed anything. We would stay at the cottage again on our next visit to Boston.  Eileen and Jon

Jared was a very welcoming and attentive host. The place was located in a nice neighborhood and the house was well cared for.  We really enjoyed our time there with our family and would stay there again if we have another family reunion in Boston.

Daniel was a warm, charming and helpful host. The unit was larger than we anticipated, spotlessly clean and 100% ready for our arrival.
We rented for 7 weeks  to be near our daughter who about to have our first grandchild.  Daniel welcomed us with a lovely bottle of wine and
the unit was so well equipped there was nothing more we could have asked for.

First time using Airbnb and WOW is my response to the experience.  Location was fantastic, walking distance to many options for entertainment, food and drink.  Close to the water to catch glimpses of ships and activity in the harbor.  Bus line close by and subway station a short walk away. Found it to be an ideal spot.   Christina was a most gracious hostess, very flexible, warm and inviting. The apartment was very clean, fresh feel, crisp linens, fluffy towels, comfy bed and all of the amenities one would need. She made it feel like home away from home.  Let me put it this way, when I go back to Boston, that's where I want to stay!

Me and my girlfriend stayed at Ray's house just for one night and it was an amazing experience.
Is a very beautiful and clean house, the neighborhood is awesome, very close to the train station, about 20 minutes from downtown by train.
Ray is a nice person, very helpful, great host . I hope to see him again.

Short stay in Boston has turned into an amazing experience thanks to Ben and Andy. The rooms were furnished very nicely and it is very guest friendly - I had my own key and entrance + private room + clean bathroom. Very quite neighbourhood and close to the airport and the convention centre. Ben and Andy are both friendly people, and their two dogs Jack and Cody were both very adorable and well behaved! I guarantee any guests will have an amazing experience in Boston staying at this place.

My mom and I were staying in another apartment, which was a great place! We loved having our own bathroom, and we enjoyed the quiet neighborhood. It was not that far from downtown Boston; it took around 13min to go Back Bay by car. With Uber it was like 7 dollar something.

Carol was an awesome host. Her condo was really well stocked. Clean and comfy with a fireplace. The location was fantastic. We pretty much could walk to most of downtown Boston. Overall, 5/5. Really enjoyed my stay.  : )

Heather was very accommodating and helpful. My wife and I really enjoyed meeting her. 

This was our first Airbnb stay so we felt a little uncomfortable. However, Heather made us feel very welcome. She left an information sheet for us with info about the apartment, store locations, transit access, and restaurant recommendations. Her restaurant recommendations were excellent. She even checked in (via text) part way through our stay to make sure everything was well and we were able to use her futon (used as an extra double bed). 

The apartment is on the third floor accessed via stairs only. It is obvious that Heather has done a lot to make the apartment homey and comfortable. It is airy with large ceiling fans and functioning windows. Heather has pets, which went with her for our stay. We were very comfortable there.

The apartment is located in a young/college neighborhood with easy access to transit, the airport, local universities, and good restaurants. 

We both enjoyed our stay, would stay there again, and would gladly recommend Heather's place to friends.

Very nice stay at Ray's. Everything worked as planned. He brings back the true spirit of Airbnb. The location is a little off the city center but a very dynamic neighborhood by itself. Public transportation from there will take you to any place in the city in no time. Ray. Take for this stay and your good restaurant advices.  Rgds

Great location, excellent welcome pack, one small room but so worth it.... We loved walking around the neighbourhood and heard some great music in the park..... The service that dealt with key handover etc was good. We would definitely stay here again.

We had a lovely 9-day stay at Karuna and Nicole's place. The house is situated  less than 10 mins walk from Stonybrook station which is convenient to go downtown. Walking through a lovely well-lit park to get home from the station was very safe even late at night. There is also a bus on Centre Street which takes you to the city. It's about a 15 min walk to Centre Street but it's great fun walking by the colourful and quaint-looking historical houses in this neighbourhood. Centre street also had many stores, restaurants and J.P. Licks where we had their amazing waffle, icecream and coffee for breakfast. The house itself is old but the interior has been nicely renovated. Karina and Nicole have furnished the house in a lovely way as well. The room was spacious and the bed was comfortable (though the pillows were too soft). In the morning, it felt like waking up in a big cubby house as there was a lot of greenery outside the windows. It felt great waking up in this room each morning. The bathroom was cute and the water pressure was good. The house is great and clean. Karuna is a most accommodating and friendly host and prompt with communicating . She is a foodie and gave us excellent recommendations of places around Boston. She was so fun to have a conversation with late into the night - although I should've been more mindful of her having classes the next day. Thanks to Karuna's hospitality, we enjoyed our Boston stay way more than expected. Come visit us in Singapore!

Pratap & Tam are very friendly and warm. They have prepared almost everything you will need. They even helped me to use the washing machine at evening. And the neighborhood is quiet and beautiful and near the T stop. It is a very memorable experience staying in the Heart of Brookline.

I stayed for a weekend at Bruces and Barrys House. It was wonderful. Both of them are extremly helpful. They had a lot of suggestions  for me to go and they invited me to join dinner with them. It was delicious. Bruce is a wonderful cook. On Saturday Bruce invited me to go with him and two other guests to the Christmastree Lightning. Although I was travelling alone I feel never lonly at these beautiful place. My room was really nice, I enjoyed the view over the see. I will come back. Warmly recommended!

My husband and I really enjoyed our stay at Gerard and Marie's place!!  Marie happily greeted us and was really flexible with our check in time!  The apartment looks even better than the pictures online.  Location was just perfect for us.  Charlestown is a really quiet neighborhood and realy enjoyed our stay.   The apartment is fully equipped with washer/dryer, TV, internet worked perfectly!  Overall, our stay was wonderful and Marie  & Gerard were lovely hosts.  One thing that should be noted,  that this apartment is ground level of a residence which was not a problem for us but something to be aware of.  Thank you again Marie &Gerard!

Wonderful stay, with two very warm and caring guys, who took most excellent care of us during our three day stay in Boston. Nothing was too much trouble for Ken and Jez, including a collection from the airport and delivery to the cruise terminal, which were so welcome after an exhausting incoming trip and subsequent daunting outgoing disembarkation with all the baggage. Very comfortable accommodation, with all the facilities that we required at the time. Thanks again, guys. Look forward to seeing you again, whenever we are next in Boston...Peter and Jennifer

Rachel was an excellent host.  The information about the condo was clear and accurate.  Rachel was solicitous about our settling in, responded right away to our questions and was otherwise unobtrusive.  The condo itself is lovely, comfortable, relaxing, with lots of natural light and a well equipped kitchen.  The location is great.  Charming, convenient shops and restaurants a short walk away and a MTA subway stop close by for going farther afield.
It was a very nice experience to stay by CarneyFamily. The rooms are very clean and comfortable. We would stay again!!  Thank you!

Dan was a great host. Very hospitable and friendly. He provided excellent recommendations for restaurants in the area. We had a short, but very pleasant stay. There is not a better location to stay at if you are coming to town to catch a Red Sox game.

I chose to stay with Tricia based on other reviews and the location. Just as so many others, this was a great stay. I had a nightmare trip - cancellations, delays, layovers - and Tricia was kind enough to pick me up from the train stop so I didn't have to drag all my luggage up the hilly streets of Boston.

Everything was exactly as described, the room was clean and bright, Tricia was welcoming and helpful and just a pleasure. There was fresh fruit and coffee and orange juice for breakfast; I am very happy I chose to stay here.

I live in JP but don't have enough room in my small apartment, so we needed a nearby place for my dad to stay while he was in town. My dad had a wonderful experience at the Carriage House. It was clean, quiet, private and beautiful. Sarah also left us a bottle of wine and a few beers in the fridge. We couldn't have had a better experience. I definitely recommend this to anyone looking to stay in the JP/Boston area. We hope to use it next time my parents or in laws are in town.

Elizabeth provide an amazing place to stay that really helped to make our vacation special.

We would love to come back and have nothing but wonderful things to say about the Moroccan suite.

Heather made me feel very comfortable while staying at her apartment. The apartment was very clean and welcoming. The pictures on the site are very accurate. I also loved the convenience of the on-street parking right outside the place. I would definitely recommend this place!
We felt very welcome and loved our upstairs room.  The neighborhood is quiet and close to the town center.  We truly enjoyed our stay in their lovely home.

This appartment is really nice, spotless, lots of space, cozy, bahtroom very clean, kitchen equiped with all you need, livingroom very comfortable, the bed is outstanding. Jamaica Plain is a very recommandable area,    everything you need is just around the corner. Subway is just a 7 min walk from here and take you downtown in just 15 min.
Ray, thank you very much for being a great, kind and helpfull host. We had a wonderfull stay in your place.

My husband and I and our 9-year-old son just got back from a great 4-night stay at Ella & Wills sweet little flat. It was the perfect size to kick back in after a day of touring the sights, with everything we needed to prepare our own meals (complete with the tea, coffee, and milk that was provided for us). The bed upstairs was very comfortable, as was the air mattress that our son slept on. We had no problems finding on-street parking at the end of the day, and the neighbourhood was nice and quiet. The flat is only a short walk away from the centre of Roslindale village where we found several great restaurants, a grocery store, and more. The commuter train into Boston was also only a 5-minute walk away and took us 25 minutes to get downtown during the week. Ella & Will were also the perfect hosts - very prompt responses to all of our questions, and provided great information to us when we arrived on how to get around. We would highly recommend Ella & Wills place to anyone looking to travel to, or stay in Boston!
Ray rocks!  His apartment is in a great location. The bed is super comfy and the apartment is immaculate. The only thing missing during my stay was Ray!

非常愉悦的一次居住体验，房子很干净整洁，房东也很热心，屋里家电齐全，非常温馨。
My family and I really enjoyed the stay. Dale and Liz are very thoughtful.   The house is cute and clean. Highly recommend!
Julie's apartment was perfect for our brief visit to Boston. It was perfectly located, it was charming, and it was as advertised. We hope to stay there on our next trip to Boston if at all possible.

Everything was great, just as described! The location was convenient to restaurants and Fenway Park and easy walking distance to the Commons, even with a 7 year old.  The neighborhood was very nice and quiet and Jason was very hospitable.  His directions for getting into the apartment were well spelled out and he was very accommodating for our early arrival.  We would not hesitate to rent one of his properties again.

My daughter and I stayed in this suite for four nights and were very pleased with our stay.  Due to a flight delay, we did not arrive until very late at night and to our pleasant surprise she was at the door to greet us and welcome us and make sure that we were comfortable.  She was prompt with replies whenever I called to obtain more information. The bed was comfortable and the neighborhood was quiet. There were some good restraunts just a few blocks away. I would be happy to stay  at this location again if I needed to be in the Boston area in the future.

We loved staying at Janel's place. It was a complete Bostonian experience. The location is perfect, right on the Freedom Trail. Easy access to everywhere. Charlestown, the neighborhood, is beautiful. English style architecture. Her place is charming, comfortable, clean and cozy, with good taste for decoration. 100% recommendable.
Awesome stay. The place looked exactly like the photos and everything was incredibly accessible. I would stay here again if available.

Lev's apartment was really clean, comfortable, cosy and furnished with all the needed stuff (hairdryer, kitchen tools…). And it's well located. We enjoyed our stay in his apartment.
Lev was a very nice and helpful host. 
We would not hesitate to stay again in his apartment if we would go back to Boston.

We loved staying at Jez n Ken's place! Their mom Shirley welcomed us home when  our late flight finally arrived after being delayed, then showed us around the house and told us to sleep until we felt rested. The next morning we enjoyed a nice cup of coffee and yogurt with granola before heading off to the city. Shirley guided us in to the city on the T and then offered to be available to call or text if we needed anything at all. It was a wonderfully experience for our first airbnb and we will be back to visit. Thank you so much for the AMAZING hospitality!!!

Jeffs communication leading up to our amazing weekend stay in Boston was top notch. Jeff met us at the loft, gave us a quick tour, showed us how to use everything and answered any questions we had.

4 longtime friends traveling from all over the east coast is not an easy thing to plan...especially trying to find space. Jeffs space was more than ample enough for us guys to relax in a luxury loft in the center of Boston. The roof deck was the highlight of our trip. The work Jeff did on this loft space is some of the best renovation I have ever seen.

Steps from South Station, we easily walked to the North End, Boston Common, Back Bay and to a game at Fenway Park.

The kitchen and bathrooms are top notch. Ample space to nap/sleep on beds, reclining chairs, couch or the floor depending on how firm you like your surface ;) 

I hope to rent this space again this year .... anyone who can get this rental is lucky beyond words. Such a great experience in a very unique space.
best airbnb I've stayed at! Best price! Great location! great room and house..had everything I needed

Tai's place was awesome. We coordinated ahead of time and she made checking into the apartment extremely easy. The apartment is exactly as pictured and very neat/clean. She left us a list of things to do and places to eat in the city and gave clear instructions of what to do before checking out. We couldn't have asked for a better night in the city. I would 100% stay here again. The location is perfect and Tai was super accommodating. I would recommend this to anyone!

We had a good stay here. The apartment was spacious and clean. Its location is great, with much of Boston walkable. We are a couple with a young child, just like Jason and his family, so the apartment was set up perfectly for us.

Jason was easy to deal with, answered queries promptly, and provided us with clear information about both the appartment and the local facilites.

Note that when we stayed, the second bedroom had a choice of a cot or a good quality airbed. If this matters to you, confirm the current arrangements before booking; I'd expect things will change as Jason's family grows up.
I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here! It felt like my home away from home, peaceful quiet and very comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.

We enjoyed our stay at Mark's condo in Brookline.  It is in a great location with the Emerald Necklace right out the front door and convenient "T" stops.  There is everything you need (and more) in the kitchen.  There was plenty of room (square footage) for the 3 of us.  Mark's representative, Marilyn, met us as planned, explained the workings of the condo, suggested restaurants nearby and checked in to be sure all was going well during our stay.   The great communication was comforting as this was our first Air BnB experience/booking and we wondered exactly how the process would work.  We would definitely return to Mark's condo.

Jason and Stephanie were thoughtful and accommodating hosts. Their home is beautiful, the room is so comfortable, and (at least to me) it seems there's nothing one might need that they haven't anticipated. Every expectation I had was met, if not exceeded. I definitely recommend staying with them!

A good experience overall. The room was very clean and well-lit, and a ceiling fan provided good ventilation. The bathroom was also clean and well-supplied. The location was in a decent neighborhood, conveniently close to several nearby eateries and the Jackson Square station, which was only a few stops away from downtown Boston.

My parents were visiting from outside the U.S. and stayed at Nicole's place for 2 nights. They loved the charming area, the beautifully decorated rooms and the immaculate living space. Although the house seems old from outside, Nicole has a very charming apartment space and everything is well organized and well kept. My parents were checking in late and I was helping them by keeping in touch with Nicole and she always responded immediately to my questions and inquiries! The place is exactly as depicted and made even better with Nicole being present there to help her guests and make them feel welcome. They had a lovely time staying at Nicole's!
I had a wonderful experience, they were very accommodating. The rooms were awesome, clean and warm. I had no issues and I'd love to stay with them again.

Becky is awesome! She was super laid-back and very trusting, which I appreciated (i.e. "i promise to clean up", and she was cool with that). She responded to all of my messages promptly and kept in touch. She even met with me before I rented the place to show me around.

The apartment is awesome and made me want to move to JP! :-)

I had a great time staying at their place! Mary and Barney are two wonderful hosts who are dedicated to help you and make you have a great experience in Boston. The house and the location are beautiful and very close to the subway and the room is very cozy and inviting. I would definitely stay with them again!

Our stay could not have been anymore comfortable! Best Air BnB experience yet. Sarah's place was homely, convenient and well thought out for guests.
Sarah was also very quick to respond to our questions. And, understanding when we accidentally lost our key!

This was fantastic experience i had in Boston . Eleanor is very kind, polite, friendly, interesting and educated person i really loved those small conversations i had a chance to run with her. The room Is much bigger than in a photo.. also the apt itself is very spacious and amazingly clean, last Flr in very Calm place ..  care and kindness around You like at home. Good public transportation. Not far from Apt You have a beach so You can enjoy sun and water. Strongly recomend !

Gerard and Marie provided clean, comfortable, and homey accommodations for us during our visit to Boston. Having a full kitchen made meals easier and morning coffee convenient, and the apartment provided plenty of room for two children to get away from each other when needed, an amenity we all value!  We found the neighborhood charming to walk through and conveniently close to the start of the freedom trail and a stop on the orange line. 

Thank you for a comfortable stay in a charming home.
Cute apartment nice area. Galen was very responsive and helpful

Bob and Izzy’s home is well decorated, comfortable and welcoming.  They are great hosts and it felt like visiting old friends and catching up.  They are helpful with places to go and know the city well, we really liked the restaurant they recommended. The next time I stay in Boston their home would be my first choice. Brunch the first morning they recommended was my favorite meal of the trip.  This was my first Air BNB stay and they have set high expectations.

My parents were visiting from India, and I couldn't have chosen better hosts during their stay in Boston. Alicia and Kostas were extremely warm and friendly, and made my parents feel at home. They had a great time during their visit, especially as they were very comfortable at this beautiful JP home. 

P.S. Alicia makes delicious pizza.

Robert is a great host. He immediately made us feel like home and recommended places to go in the neighborhood. He also went out of his way to help us with moving into our own place in JP. The room and bathroom were exactly as advertised and the house was always kept tidy and clean. The house is located in a beautiful and very quiet part of JP very close to central JP with all its ammenities, restaurants etc. I highly recommend staying with Robert if you want to stay in a great place in a beautiful neighborhood of Boston!

I stayed at Paul's for a week in late June 2015, and I couldn't have been happier. Paul's flat is very conveniently located, within 5 min. walk to Blue line and 5 min. ride to downtown Boston, and it's very close to the airport (but you won't hear much air traffic noise as planes come in from east, and south east)  The neighbourhood is quiet, there's a shop and a laundry just across the road, as well as a pizza place and a nice pie shop within 5-10 min. walk. Paul is a great host and made me feel very comfortable.
The apartment was very cozy and clean. Great location with 5 min walk from the train station.
Edward has been a great host for our three day stay in Boston. We truly enjoyed his advice and felt at home in his superb appartment. Outstanding location.

Our stay in Boston was fantastic. Nathaniel was very accessible and met all of our needs throughout our stay. The cozy apartment and neighborhood were as advertised so feel confident booking if you like what you read. Will consider staying again for my return trip to Boston.

My mom and I had such an amazing time in Boston, most of which can be attributed to the location of Joe's place and his helpfulness. The apartment was very clean and had all of the essentials for us to enjoy our stay. There are plenty of restaurants nearby and grocery stores too. We walked to Fenway (which was super close) and over to Newbury street for some shopping too. The apartment was very centrally located and Joe's helpfulness was much appreciated. He was easy to get in contact with and made himself available whenever we needed him. I would highly recommend staying here!!

Awesome appartment! Perfectly spotted in an area we didn't know about in Boston! Jamaica Plain is great for a couple days in the city! The appartment is cute and there's anything there to feel like home! Perfect for a young couple like us just as for one person. Nice little balcony, great neighbourhood! Susie make our stay easier! Make sure you meet her as soon as you can because she knows a lot about the city! She'll make you comfortable and secure for sure! Thanks for everything!

Our experience at Marys Ocean view was excellent! Mary and Barney were always so helpful, open, and accomodating. We had trouble arriving on time due to public transportation repairs, but even then the Carneys left everything set for us. We felt we could really count on them for assistance or anything we could need while staying at their place. The place was great, very clean (all parts of the house, specially bathroom), the neighborhood was nice and quiet. The distance to the Red Line T station is easily walkable. We would definitely come back when staying in Boston, and we strongly recommend to anyone.

This is one of the best airbnb experiences I have had--and all of my airbnb experiences have been excellent. Everything was super clean, the bed was amazingly comfortable, and Jennifer was a kind, prompt, and friendly host. She accommodated my early arrival and provided tips for local places to eat and ways to travel when I asked. The breakfast sandwich and coffee were fantastic. (Thanks, F!) :) I also appreciated being invited to share wine and tv my first night there. Her puppy was adorable and super well-behaved. Seriously, this was like staying at a nice hotel, but better--I highly recommend Jennifer's place.

What a delightful experience staying at Bruce and Berry's home. I found the experience to be everything they said. They were warm and welcoming, got me situated in the house, made sure the temperature in my room was cool enough during the hot summer day. The room itself was beautiful and the house was unique and enjoyable. 
In the morning I was able to meet other people who were staying there as well as have a nice conversation with Berry. The neighborhood seemed very safe and it was a short walk from the T station.
Overall- a very lovely experience!

Absolutely incredible airbnb. If you you're visiting Boston and the weather is nice, you NEED a roof deck--and this place has a great one. The apartment is very clean and well kept, host responded quickly--everything was as described. The apartment is in a great area, highly recommend staying here.

The place was amazing and we loved it... really like a home away from home.  Functional, comfortable, well decorated, and well-lit (high hats & natural sun).  Best location - close proximity to F&B, sites, roadways, etc.  Will definitely book again next time in Boston.  Jason's hands off approach works well and allowed us to enjoy the place as if it were our own.  The rental guide & instructions are very helpful in getting acclimated to the apartment and neighborhood.  Great trip.
We really enjoyed our stay at Ray's place.  Very clean and comfortable, great location near transportation, restaurants, and local shops.  Ray is the perfect host.  We plan to stay there again!
I had a wonderful time at Danielle's.  She was very gracious and helpful - from the booking thru to my departure.

Kim is reallllllly an awesome host!
Easy and very pleasant to deal with!
Very accessible before and during the stay!
She's very proactive and everything from the reservation to the "getting into the apartment" was easy! very solution oriented!!
Her apartment is very charming and super clean! We felt at home right away!! Verrrry well located!
Too bad we couldn't stay more then a long weekend!!

Super Kim.....a big THANK YOU for making our Boston experience so exceptional!!!

see you next time!!
Val and Pat
;-) xox

Great location for a Boston visit. Very clean, cute place with hardwood floors and granite tops in the kitchen. We had a late arrival but Keith left a key in the lock box. He was very accommodating as we'd only made reservations a few hours before we arrived. It was exactly what we needed for quick one-night stay

My first time using airbnb, great experience. Jay is an excellent host. Great apartment while in Boston. Convenient location, across the street from Mass Gen, close to everything. Beautiful, clean apartment.

I had a great time during my stay (4 weeks) at Joleen's and Todd's apartment - the room was quite spacious, had tons of light during the day, and was super comfortable (I stayed in the other one with the big windows). Joleen and Todd were very easy-going, easy to communicate with and very helpful in all kinds of ways. It is just a short walk to Broadway, which has lots of options in terms of restaurants, convenience stores, and a big supermarket is also nearby. I would definitely recommend staying at Joleen's and Todd's apartment!

We had a great time with Ray. His apartment is nice and clean. The vintage lamps and chairs in the living room made us take a lot pictures. Ray is a wonderful host, he cares for his guests in every little way. We would definitely choose him if we visited Boston again. Plus, running beside the Jamaica Pond, which was only three-minutes walk, would be one the best experience for a jogger!

My family and I stayed at Adam's condo for a weekend and had a wonderful time. Adam and his wife Sarah were lovely and accommodating hosts. They were responsive to all of our questions and worked to get us the keys in a way that was most convenient to us. The condo is clean, modern, comfortable and convenient. We would definitely stay here again when visiting Boston.

We met Marie and appreciated the way she welcomed us
The house is very nice and the first floor of the family house is the place we stayed
The appartement is quite convenient in a nice suburb 15 minutes away from the city center
Excellent experience.  Hosts were very nice, hospitable & accommodating.  They provided excellent dining suggestions close by and the location was an easy walk to my conference.

I only saw Julia during our stay in Boston. She was a perfect host, with good advice about the city and the communication was really easy.

The flat itself is great : very convenient localisation in a nice neighborhood, very clean and tidy. The room is air conditioned, and. 

Boston is not cheap...so if you can afford to stay here, I really advice to pay the price to stay here.
I had a pleasant and easy stay at this charming apartment. Tania was very helpful and nice. Location is excellent. I hope to be back!

Pamela was a fantastic host who got in touch with on the phone prior to our arrival.  Super nice!  And what a cool house in a cool neighborhood!  Much bigger than I expected!  And not too far from downtown Boston.  We did not use the kitchen because of prior commitments but that would have been a nice feature for a family.  Thanks Pamela!

This place was very nice, clean and looks just like the pics! The host, Jeff, was incredibly helpful and even did a walk-through beforehand. The loft is in a great location and had more than enough space (and beds) to accommodate my family.

Eva is one of the kindest, highly educated individuals I have ever met! We had wonderful conversations while she poured wine and cooked me food! I seriously could not get that kind of host at a high-end hotel! The apartment is in a perfect location right across from MFA. The unit is very clean with comfortable design and decor. I honestly felt right at home. Thank you for such a wonderful stay Eva! You are awesome!

My boyfriend and I only stayed at Stephen and Megan's place for 1 night, but they were really kind, friendly and willing to offer help! They made us at home once we got there. The house was really clean and they provided anything possible! even the guide about what to do in Boston. They were kind to allow us to store our luggage in their house even after we checked out. The neighborhood was safe and clean. I would recommend this place to anyone who wanna visit Boston.

I stayed at Phyllis's house for two nights, she is very nice and hospitable. She picked me up at the airport at night and helped me settle down. The house is very artistic and elegant, and though the room is tiny, it is well-equipped and comfortable. Definitely perfect for one!

Cindy was an exceptional host and went out of her way to make our stay pleasant. She definitely lives up to her Superhost status!  The apartment was lovely, and is in the heart of the very beautiful Beacon Hill.  Pick this if you want to have a nice stay in Boston!!

Our stay at Sara's and Merrick's house was more than awesome!  We had the best time there and felt like home! We had our own room, she surprised us even with breakfast in the morning which was so sweet of her! Sara and her husband are such wonderful people and I would recommend this accomodation to everybody! They gave us even a ride to the train station when we were leaving the city and helped us to find everything. Sara and Merrick thank you for the amazing time and hope to see you again next year!!

Salman and Nabihah have a wonderful townhome in Brookline.  I am very happy that I stayed there during the Boston Marathon weekend.  I found it a great place to retreat to during this busy weekend.  Their charming neighborhood has restaurants and a Trader Joe's within walking distance.  It is a short T ride away from the city's center.  Their home has all the comforts.  The church view from the guest bedroom and living room provides a unique and quiet backdrop.  Nabihah was always very prompt in her communications and made sure I had all I needed.  Check in and check out were easy.  Salman and Nabihah were out of town during my stay, but they had a house sitter visiting who was very attentive and helpful.  Their home is an excellent choice for any Boston visit.

Very welcoming!  Our stay was brief as our primary purpose was to find a place close to the airport. It was super convenient. 

I wouldn't prefer to share the bathroom with the hosts or have such close quarters.  In addition, I didn't know there were cats, which my husband is allergic to.  In all fairness I am new to airbnb so I probably didn't read all the finer details...

In summary, this was a gracious and clean comfy convenient stay but I wouldnt go back for the above reasons.

An amazing home in an amazing part of Boston. Beautiful views over the city and in a really pleasant neighbourhood too. There are also grocery stores nearby, as well as restaurants and a T-station, making it really easy to get around the city.

Perla is a fantastic host - we were made to feel very welcome, the apartment was in perfect condition and she's really quick with answers to any questions too.

Highly recommended - I loved my stay and hope it won't be too long until I return!

Emily was a great host and her apartment was exactly what we needed to explore and get to see Boston. The apartment is beautiful with everything you could possibly need and very quiet sleeping. It is much better in person! Thanks for everything and we will definitely stay with you again next time we come to Boston!

Angela and Marco are really friendly, helpful and amazing people! They made me feel like home, and gave me lots of tips about things to the in Boston and around it. The room is exactly like it shows on the pictures, very comfortable (the bed is really good), with a lot of space to put my stuff and the little fridge makes it even more complete. The house is very clean and comfortable, and very close to the train/bus station. I had an amazing time during this month I spent there, and I'll definitely go back there if someday I return to Boston.

My daughter and I stayed here for a long vacation during the summer. Our host was great to deal with and made everything extremely easy before we arrived. Once there, any question I had was answered easily in the house manual or by email from the host. This is a perfect spot to explore the south end with it's many restaurants, shops and historic beauty. It was always a pleasure to return at the end of our day out enjoy Boston. We especially enjoyed the roof deck. It is a very comfortable and relaxing space. I would 100% recommend this to my friends and family.
Carol's description made it easy to find the keys and parking space. The apartment was clean and cozy. The neighborhood was fantastic - there is a market, liquor store, and bus stop within one block!

I had a wonderful stay!

The room was perfectly prepared, just as advertised.  Even better, it is in a beautiful home in a wonderful neighborhood.  The location is extremely convenient to BC as well as the Green Line.  Prepared for every contingency, Carol provided everything I needed and more.  I was warmly greeted when I arrived and my hosts were available to answer questions at any time during my stay.  

I highly recommend staying with Carol if planning to be in or around Boston!

Jeff is s superior host.  He kept me frequently updated, offered good advice about the neighborhood and even arranged for an extra bed to be left in the apartment to accommodate my group.  He arranged to meet me personally to hand off the key and to show me around, as well.  When I had a question over the weekend I texted him, and his reply came back in minutes. The home was spotlessly clean and it's absolutely beautiful.  It is larger than in the  pictures, full of light, spacious and with a sense of quiet and order that is delightful after a day of handling the noise of Boston.  The kitchen is to die for.  My guests and I decided it could serve as our model home - really beautiful design. It really is steps to South Station, and also to lots of restaurants, Chinatown and within walking distance to the tourists sites  near Fanueil Hall, as well.  HIGHLY recommend!!
The apartment was beautiful, just like what it looks like in the photos. Mohsen was super nice, and very considerate. The neighborhood was amazing too! Just an awesome experience overall.

Brian and Lisa were goods hosts, very helpful.

They have many tips for visiting Boston.

The monthly Pass for public transfer is really good.

I came to Boston for two weeks with my girlfriend and the appartment couldn't have been better. It was cozy and very comfortable, it has an small kitchen where we coocked daily and the building was very quite.
The neighbourhood was beautiful and safety with quiet restaurants. The subway (green line) was a 10 min walk but most days we just went walking as Boston is very easy to go walking everywhere.
Walter was very nice with us, he gave us some recomendations and was very attentive to out needs so we definetly recommend this appartment.

After a hectic tour of New England, we arrived in Boston exhausted. Stepping into Ed’s penthouse was like entering a beautiful, elegant oasis in this historical district of Victorian homes. Ed’s home is filled with art and books and is equipped with every modern convenient. The spacious bedroom and bath are filled with light. As an owner of ski property in Park City, Utah, I appreciated the attention to detail that made the suite so user friendly. Great lighting, mirrors, loads of storage and outlets everywhere.

Ed is a gracious host who made us feel welcome and comfortable. He provided useful information on how to see Boston by walking and by using mass transit. His place has a great central location within walking distance of the Museum of Fine Arts and the Gardner Museum. For the downtown Historical sights we could walk to the end of block to catch the bus or walk another minute to Starbucks.

As retired teachers used to traditional hotels, we were a little apprehensive about trying Airbnb. However, my son who recently used Airbnb in New York assured me this is the way for modern travel – and he was absolutely right. I will definitely stay here on my next trip to Boston. Airbnb and a great host like Ed allow luxury travel with a personal touch at an amazing price. 

Jen and Lin

What a delight to stay in this charming apartment in Beacon Hill!  Jason was a helpful, gracious host keen on making sure our stay was perfect.  He provided detailed check-in instructions which included not only specifics about the apartment, but also great tips on enjoying the neighborhood restaurants.
