Helen was extremely respectful and let us enjoy our privacy, however it was easy to communicate with her before and during our stay. Each day in the morning, she kindly brought up some delicious bakery, fruit, juice and dairy.

As for the apartment, it is upstairs in a house which is located in a quiet neighborhood at about 30 minutes by subway from Downtown Boston, not far from restaurants and shops on foot. It is luminous, fresh, cool, colourful, very well decorated with taste. The kitchen has all the amenities anyone might need (microwave, toaster, cutlery, oven...) and much space. Thanks to the fan in the kitchen and the A/C in the bedroom, it was easy to stay fresh during our stay. The bed and linen were comfortable so we could sleep well.

I strongly recommend this choice in Boston!

I've been in Boston for just two days. 
I was in the house just for a little bit. They were very nice and helpful but the space was smaller than expected.

We had a great time in Alex' loft appartement. It's pretty easy to reach by public transport: just a 10-15 minutes walk to the train at Fairmount. The location is nice and quiet and Alex and her husband are very pleasant and helpful.

Sweet spot, great neighborhood, laid back host. I am a low-needs traveler and this was perfect: clean, comfortable, friendly. The 2 nice dogs and a nice cat were a pleasant addition for this animal lover.

This was an absolute wonderful stay.  Sean and Bernadine made us a fall incredibly at home and very welcomed.  The neighborhood was just what we were looking for and the way Sean and Bernadine described their AirBnB was very on point.  We'd definitely come back.
We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was exactly as advertised. It is a great location. Easy walk to T stop and various Brookline locations.

Lev's place was the perfect place to stay in Boston. Couldn't have asked for a better experience. Totally accommodating, great place and always quick with responding to questions. It made for a great vacation. Can't thank him enough.
Wonderful stay! Barney was very helpful and we were very well catered for. Beautiful house and facilities and a handy location to the city. Highly recommend!

Really great first stay through Airbnb!

Thoughtful hosts!  Friendly, considerate, and easy to communicate with through the whole process.  They thought through the details, and left great notes about the apartment and neighborhood.

Room is spacious and comfortable, and the rest of the place is a fun place to hang out.  Location is ideal if you're wanting to move about town-- so close to transit and popular neighborhoods!
Great host, very attentive with email.  Apartment is lovely, in a great neighborhood and looks exactly like the images posted.
Great location.  Fantastic decor and lots of space. Will book again

Eleanor has a very nice and quiet apartment in South Boston. It is cozy and charming. We had a great time there. We only saw Ellie twice during our weekend. Cowboy is adorable! The accommodation for our arrival was very easy.

This place truly is a gem! Gina was wonderful, responsive and full of great recommendations! We could not have asked for a better location. So much was within walking distance and the local restaurants were divine! I highly recommend this Northside gem to anyone looking for a great place in Boston!

This attractive apartment in Charlestown, Boston was perfectly located for 2 days exploring the City.  It is a short walk from the Bunker Hill Monument and a few minutes further on to the pick up for the tour bus routes, although this is not essential as much of the main parts are within walking distance.  

Gerard met us on our first night to check everything was ok and was extremely nice giving us some excellent advice about what to see in Boston.  He recommended the commuter ferry which was well worth the $3 per head to travel to Downtown Boston where there was lots to see.  We would highly recommend Quincy food Market near Faneuil Hall but do be prepared to come out a few lbs heavier!

We had a lovely stay in a very comfortable apartment which was only 10 minutes taxi ride to the airport.  We would definitely look to stay here again if returning to Boston.

Lacey's appartment was wonderful! Very spacious! The beds and linens are very confortable. The king size bed in the master bedroom was very appreciated. Also we enjoyed having private bathrooms. We liked that the neighboorhood was quiet and grocery store close enough to walk to. We we're gone most of the time and ate at restaurants so we didn't get to test the kitchen and the BBQ/patio but it looked like it had everything for every occasion. Everything was very clean. Metro was also not too far away. Cable tv, internet, and very cool ipod station for music all around the appartement! We definitly recommend it! Reservation was fast and Lacey gave lots of information for parking and also suggested to make reservation for restaurants in advance for us! She also gave lots of options on how to reach her in case we had any questions. 
Thanks again!! 
- Joelle and her 5 friends

If you are looking for the perfect room in Boston, this one is for you! We spent 3 nights at Jez and Ken's place which is just fabulous. The room is quiet, clean, big and the bed so comfy...The room has everything you need! Our hosts provided fresh and soft towels, shampoo and soap which were very pleasant to use in a modern and clean Italian shower!
They provided breakfast every morning with Tea, coffee, orange juice, yogurts, chocolate bars, snacks, dry cramberries...
We could use the laudry and the kitchen and we really feel like home. 
Jez and Ken's house is modern, very beautiful and is located in a very beautiful area with a nice market, bars and restaurants. For running lovers, this is the ideal location: a wonderful running area along the sea with a Boston skyline view...
The house is ideally located to go downtown: a 20 minutes walk and a 5 minutes ride with the subway!
Jez and Ken are the ideal host: excellent communication, Ken came and picked us up at the subway at night when we arrived and Jez took us to the subway at 6 in the morning when we left! The are adorable and helpful (and they have 2 amazing cats!).
We have a lot BnB experiences and this one is the best ever! We will come back to Ken and Jez's house in the future qnd we will recommend this place to our friends and family...

Gidget and Kyle were wonderful and friendly host. Kyle immediately greeted me upon entry and gave me a tour of the space and the roof deck. Although the space is shared, the host respected the upstairs space as if it were a private space. But they always made sure that I was taken cared off.

The space is as beautiful as pictured. The living room is very spacious and comfortable, as is the room. The roof deck was my favorite part of the listing, where I could hang out after a long day of work, gazing into the Boston Skyline.

Lastly, the location is prime! In Back Bay, it's walking distance from everything you ever need.
Richard's apartment was so fantastic and comfortable that I extended my stay by a week. Highly recommend! Plus Richard is highly responsive.

Christine was incredibly helpful and generous. She provided a lot of helpful information before I had even left home, and then called me to be sure I had reached her apartment safely. The neighborhood was lovely and the apartment just as described. It was very clean, comfortable, and charming, with all the amenities. She checked in during my stay to be sure everything was going well, and even let me leave my bags there on my last day. I highly recommend her as a host, and would be happy to stay in her place again next time I visit Boston.

We loved staying at Alicia&Kosta's place. 
As you can guess from the pictures the apartment is beautiful.
There is really nothing to complain about.
Sharing the bathroom was no problem at all (in fact I didn't even really notice it was a shared bathroom).
We didn't expect breakfast, but there was breakfast and it was very nice: toast, jam, almond butter and Alicia even made coffee for us every morning. :)
She helped us planning our trips and came up with some very good ideas. 
When she took the dog ('Babe': cute, funny, full of power t hesitate to lend an umbrella to us.

All in all:
I could not imagine a better place to stay at in Boston!
Best stay ever! Her place is beautiful and so comfortable!

Me and my boyfriend hadn't used airbnb before so we were slightly nervous, but there was no need. The apartment was huge, with everything you could possibly need. Big comfy bed, modern bathroom & kitchen, living area with a huge cable TV. The apartment block was safe and quiet, and in an amazing location just seconds from North Station to get the train anywhere, but also in walking distance of nearly everything. Richard had provided things like fluffy white towels, a hairdryer, bathrobes, just like a five star hotel, but for half the price, along with an info pack with instructions on how to use things in the apartment, maps, and suggestions of where to go and eat around the area! So helpful. Overall, a luxurious, hassle-free, beautiful apartment that was our haven to relax after sightseeing in Boston all day. Book this apartment!!!

Great location based on my needs (Convention Center), cozy space with private room and living room. All very clean. We also took advantage of the washing machine + dryer. Good groceries stores around, restaurants, etc. Last but not least, Andrew, Katie and even their dog really make you feel @home. Had a great time in Boston and without doubt, this is definitely a place I would stay again in my next visit! Thanks!

I decided to take a last minute trip to Boston while on the East Coast- I ended up staying at Jez and Ken's and I am so glad I did! They are both exceptional hosts and really go the extra mile. This really is a bed and breakfast- complete with snacks, coffee, breakfast, and two sweet kitty cats! Jez was there when I arrived in the evening and he made me feel right at home. He had great suggestions and information on life in the Boston area. I got to meet Ken briefly and he is terrific too! Their home is quiet and comfy the sheets on the bed are the softest ever! The area is lovely and the trip to Boston is quick and easy!
This place is a wonderful base for exploring Boston. Beacon Hill is wonderful and Cindy really makes her place a home away from home.

This listing was very clean and well laid out. Very comfortable for the 3 of us. The neighborhood had everything in abundance within short walking distance. New stair runners installed for the stairs leading up to the apartment which made the walk up much easier.

We had an amazing stay with Gerard and Marie in Charlestown. Communication was fantastic and the apartment is perfect - completely accurate as listed.
The location is great - full of history, but also relatively central with an easy 30 minute walk across the bridge and into central Boston. It's also handy to North Station for anyone wanting to do a day-trip up to Salem (also recommended). I will definitely be looking this place up again next time I'm in Boston.

I had a great stay in Boston at Cindy’s apartment. And I must say that Cindy played a big part in that. She is such a nice and helpful host and she made me feel so welcome.
At arrival she was so considerate in leaving bread, eggs, coffee, tea, milk -  she event made some peanut butter for me to enjoy, which tasted wonderful!. 
My flight out of Boston was unfortunately delayed for several hours, but Cindy helped me out by letting me stay in the apartment after the supposed checkout. She really made my life a whole lot easier, which I highly appreciate.
The apartment is real clean, nice and cozy in a quiet area in Boston
I cannot recommend her place highly enough and I would definitely stay there again another time!

Alicia and Kostas are some of the kindest and most generous people, staying with them was wonderful. They helped me with anything I needed, and went above and beyond what is expected of a host! Their house and dogs too are brilliant and I really wished I could have stayed longer! A great area in addition to everything else, I would recommend them and their home to anyone! I'm sure we'll stay friends for many years to come! 100% the best place to stay in Boston!
Chris was flexible kind and helpful. I enjoyed talking to him and his recommendations to do in the city. The Cottage was great and less than 5 minutes from my class. Such a great stay.

thanks Susan for your warming welcome
Monique and I have really appreciate your recommandations and help

Dan's apartment was perfect for my time in Boston. Walkable to everything and close to the subway. The apartment itself was really beautiful and the bed was super cozy. The balcony and roofdeck were nice too to have some outdoor space.  Dan was quick with answers when I needed them and made the stay nice and simple. He also provided shampoo and basic toiletries in the bathroom which was a nice touch! If I need a place to stay in Boston I will definitely look to stay here again!

Alex was traveling when we arrived in Boston, but it didn't stop him from being an excellent host. He made sure we had everything we needed, including a local contact just in case. Communication was excellent, Alex was very responsive, and we found the place without problem. They even left a detailed sheet including instructions for the apartment and some local recommendations.

The place is in an excellent central location in the South End (I think it could also qualify as Back Bay), a couple of blocks from the Prudential Center. You can even see it from the bedroom windows. We loved the location as a jumping off point to quickly get to Copley, The Boston Commons/Gardens, and Fenway. We walked everywhere we went, including the North End and the Harbor. We didn't even need the T (which is conveniently located), and only finally took a quick Uber to the airport for $20.

My favorite part was probably the local spots within a quick stroll of the apartment that I'd never seen before, despite spending a lot of time in Boston previously. We loved the Salty Pig and Five Horses, as well as Cafe Madeleine in the morning. And I could throw a rock from the place and hit Giacomo's, so one night was spent in a food coma after excellent Italian.

The girls gushed over how well the place was decorated and enjoyed seeing the remnants of Alex & wife's previous travels. 

My only drawback on this place is that it is located on a semi-busy street and there is a good amount of ambient noise from sidewalk activity that runs pretty much all hours of the night. We all got to witness a pretty epic fight between a man and his scorned girlfriend, and it wasn't uncommon to hear activity in the early AM hours. If you're an extremely light sleeper, this might not be the place for you.  To me, it's the price you pay for such a great central location.

Caroline was an excellent hostess! We had great communication prior to our visit and it was very nice meeting her in person - welcoming, friendly and gracious. She took the time to explain the neighborhood to us, give us recommendations to go out to eat and some top sights to see in Boston. The listing description was very accurate and it was exactly what we were expecting. The neighborhood was lively with lots of shops and restaurants. It was great that the Hubway was right across the street to be able to rent bikes as well! The view of Fenway and the Citgo sign was also great.
Perfect location. Lovely host. Very easy check in and check out. Had a lovely stay.

I stayed in Cindy's apartment for 3 nights and it was perfect. It is a good size for a couple and the location is amazing. The neighborhood and her place are both so charming. She was extremely accommodating and helpful; great communication. I highly recommend this listing. Cindy is an excellent host.  It is clear that she enjoys hosting and she is great at it.

My son and I enjoyed our stay at Carol's lovely home thorougly. The house is a lovely victorian, even more beautiful than on the photo, very elegantly furnished. Our room was cozy, bright and the bed was really comfortable. It is large, has got 2 cupboards and is therefore perfect for two people. The whole house is well organized and very clean. Its just a few minutes to the train station and the walk along the beautiful street with other victorian houses is really nice. 
Brookline itself is worth visiting. Nice houses, a lot of good cafés, restaurants, small shops and an international community.
Carol  has been so warmhearted and welcoming. Even though she had a lot of work to do during this weekend, she was always there to help us out whenever we had any questions. We were encouraged to make use of her kitchen which was great especially for breakfast.
I would definetely like to stay again at Carol's house whenever I come back to Boston!

Best location in Boston for sure. I don't think we had over a 15 minute walk to anywhere we wanted to go. Tiffany's place was exactly as advertised. The rooftop patio was the highlight of the place day and night for us. It was easy to check in and out and my girlfriend and I had everything we needed for a very memorable trip to Boston. I highly recommend Tiffany's place to anyone who wants to be centrally located to all of downtown Boston.

Because of the blizzard last week we ended up staying at my friend's house (so we can see each other more), so I didn't spend a lot of time at the apartment.  But we did check in and spent some time there and the place is just as advertised, clean, light and beautiful.  The hosts were very friendly and available.  I especially loved the binder that the host created with all the pertinent information including their favorite nearby places to eat.

Location, location, location.  Chris provided a lovely space in which I could come and go to classes at Harvard - one block away!  The cottage is a great retreat for anyone who wants to be alone, but also supported as a visitor. The bird songs in the morning are what I will remember best.

My stay at Susan and Steve's cottage was incredibly positive.  Despite the fact that at the time of the stay there was snow storm, the cottage itself had everything my girlfriend and I needed.  From a SMART TV to a spacious bed to a cozy kitchen, we were able to keep ourselves occupied.  Not to mention, when we did feel like bracing the storm we were in walking distance to a number of restaurants.  At the same time, Susan and Steve made us feel at home.  They had a number of recommendations of things to do (both electronic and written).  Given the snow, our car was covered, but Steve was kind enough to help me shovel it out.  Overall, anyone would be lucky to have Susan and Steve as this hosts.

Julie's place was fantastic.  She had wine, coffee and chocolates waiting for me on my arrival.  Clean doesn't cover how spotless her place was...better than any 5 star hotel I have stayed in.  Her part of Jamaica Plains is fantastic...kind of a hipper area.  Plenty of cool restaurants nearby within walking distance and the T is only about a 10-15 minute walk.  Street is very quiet and neighbors didn't make a peep.  Would definitely stay again.

I would like to share my first experience using Airbnb and the unforgotten wonderful experience to let my family stay in the treehouse during one week journey in Boston. 
I graduated from Boston University in May and ordered this treehouse as the apartment that my parents and grandma will live in during the vacation in Boston. I came to treehouse one day before my family arrived and pretended to re-load the fridge and to have a look at the treehouse. Nathan was already there and was doing the cleaning work. He was really a nice host and had considered about what you would need when you would live here. Sometimes I was amazed by his comprehensive ideas which help to solve many problems.

Traffic? Pefect. The house is right near the T-line (Actually Green-line B), which is part of the transportation system in Boston. You just need to have a 5 min walk then you can arrive at the station and with in 15 mins you can get to the downtown of Boston.
Balcony? Perfect. The balcony is decorated what is exactly shown in the pictures. Nathan really decorate a beautiful balcony, making everyone who's living there feel wonderful.
Inside the room? Perfect. You can get all you need in the treehouse, the grocery store is about 8 min walk from the apartment, you can get anything you would like to have.

Actually as a foreign student living in Boston for two years, I found that there will be a lot of things to handle with when I choose to rent a apartment from Native Host, but Nathan is such a nice guy that he helped me consider all I need to do. When he was coming to get ready for the room, he even took Maine Lobsters, cooked by himself and share them with us, which made my family feel like home. Really thank you, sir!

Perfect place to choose, you won't miss it if you plan for a visit to Boston.

Marie and Gerard provided a perfect Charlestown experience for us.  The apartment was scrupulously clean and had everything that we could have needed and more.  We were visiting our children for a family occasion and could come and go as we needed.  Marie provided wonderful guidance in writing on some places to eat, where to find groceries, etc.  Since we spend a lot of time in Charlestown, we knew that her recommendations were spot on.  We were there on Halloween - there is a wonderful Bunker Hill Halloween outdoor party that is family friendly, great fun and safe.  This part of Charlestown is wonderful and we felt perfectly comfortable walking through the neighborhood at night.  All and all, this was a wonderful experience.  It was our first airbnb adventure and because of it, we will be sure to try airbnb again.  In fact, we will look to Marie and Gerard if they are available for staying for future family gatherings!  It was wonderful!

Me and my husband stayed with Bruce and Barry for four nights over the Easter, during the Boston marathon.

They made us feel just like home and did everything they could to make our stay with them memorable. The house is lovely and the room we got was very nice. The house is just a walking distance from the T line so you are just few minutes to go down town.

I give Bruce and Barry my highest recomendation, they are very lovely and warm persons and I want stay with anyone else when I visit Boston again :-)

Katarzyna was a very good host . Her and her boyfriend made it very easy to get settled in. The place is very clean, cute and comfortable. The neighbourhood is nice and quiet. I would definitely stay there again .

I was in Boston for business for 2 weeks and was looking for a place to stay that wouldn't break the (company's) bank and would also provide a more interesting experience than a hotel. I am so pleased to have found such a great place! Jill was a wonderful host - interesting, kind, generous, and not intrusive in the least. The 2 dogs and cat were so friendly and I loved coming home to them. Jill was usually already gone in the morning when I got up, but we saw each other a few of the evenings. She is an extremely interesting person to talk to and knows a lot about Boston and the area. I immediately felt right at home in my room and in the rest of the place as well. It's a bit of a walk to the T, but I always felt safe and it's a lovely neighborhood to walk through. There are plenty of places to pick up groceries or grab a bite to eat nearby. I was sad to leave, and would definitely go back the next time I'm in town!
Bandita was very gracious and accommodating. She answered all my questions promptly.

In all the airbnbs I've been in, this one would have to be ranked right at the top. Not just because the place is conveniently located, comfortable and private but mainly because of the host Alice. We loved that the room had a fridge stocked full of fruits, snacks and beverages. Our entire stay showered us with rain but Alice was kind enough to have an umbrella ready for us without being asked. She also provided us with extra blankets and comforters for the unexpected drop in temperatures. The private bathroom was also stocked with all the toiletry necessities not usually provided in most other airbnbs. We will not hesitate to stay here again.
The apartment was in a great location and central to everything. Our flight arrived very early, and Nicole was nice enough to let us into the apartment early.

Awesome and beautiful condo near Boston downtown. It's in a LEED Platinum building, that's just awesome, it's beautiful inside-out and it's a corner appartment, so plenty of windows in here.

His roommate is super friendly and helped us out to find places to go out and Daniel even met us when we were eating downtown to make sure everything was alright.

A+++ experience here!

Danielle was amazing. Everything was exactly as it was described in the listing. Danielle was super helpful and gave us so many recommendations for stuff to do and restaurants. Such a convenient location and a wonderful experience.

I had the most amazing time!!! Susan is so kind and accommodating. I felt like I lived there for a week. The cottage is cozy (especially the bed!! I had the best nights sleep there!) And very well kept. The yard is amazing as well! I saw squirrels every morning, a chipmunk, Cardinals, and bunnies. I would move in in a heartbeat!! :-)
Host is great and was able to accommodate all of our requests. Neighborhood is nice and house is clean and pretty. Looks like on photos. Highly recommend.

Our stay with these 2 gentlemen was wonderful, they were both most gracious and let us have the run of their home. And what a lovely home they have!
Winthrop is on the other side of the bay so public transport will be your main access into Boston itself, however the train & bus service is good, once that station closest to the home is completed. All in all i would thoroughly recommend this AirBnB accommodation. PnD
Jazz is a very warm host. Although she had just got out of hospital, she was upbeat and very helpful. Her loft is in a great location. Certainly recommend friends visiting Boston to stay with her.

Andrew & Katie were very welcoming and their place is very nice. Their dog Sammy is adorable. They were not there the day I arrived, but they gave me very clear instructions so I could get in with no problem. The room was comfortable, they provided the bed sheets, the bathroom towels, the shower, and the shampoo. They also let me use their washer and dryer. The place is located in a quiet area with grocery stores and several restaurants. I recommend this place for people looking a place to stay in Boston.

Jesse was flexible with check in and a very welcoming host. The room was as expected-comfortable, clean, and quiet. It was fantastic to have that private, outdoor space. Interactions with the household were minimal but pleasant. I would stay there again today.

5 stars. Laura's place is lovely, tasteful, spacious and homey. The location is great, her recommendations were great, and communication was perfect. I only regret I didn't get to meet her, as she was away on holiday (in an Airbnb, of course). I guess it will have to be next time, and I really hope there will be a next time. Thanks Laura!

Lia was extremely accommodating and easy to communicate with- she responded to all of my questions/comments within the day, usually within a couple of hours. For my first time using Airbnb, I found the perfect hostess! My boyfriend and I found the space cozy, as it was well equipped with a TV, full kitchenette to make pancakes, and such a dreamy bed. The best part was the Beacon Hill neighborhood, which was quite charming ; we felt safe and it was a quick walk to the Boston Commons and Park Street T-stop, so we had Boston at our fingertips. Overall, a great choice!

Terrific apartment, in a perfect location near to the Common, shops, markets and restaurants.

The apartment itself is just as you can see in the photos, spacious and clean. 

Nicole was very friendly with us and help us anytime we needed it.

Easy to check in, very easy to check out. 

thanks

A comfortable, quiet and lovely apartment, with a fantastic roof deck. Joe and Catherine were away but everything worked out seamlessly - checking in and out were simple. The location is perfect for exploring the Boston area, in charming Beacon Hill but with excellent access to public transport.

What an awesome stay, and such a gracious host!  Jason met me with a bottle of wine when I arrived in the evening, how sweet is that?!  He also made his parking space behind the townhouse available to me for a small fee, which was super-generous of him (otherwise parking in the area can be stressful).  The unit was gorgeous, brand-new interior with shiny hardwood floors, big windows and high ceilings.  The bed was super-comfy, with 800+ thread sheets and a fluffy down comforter.  It turned chilly while I was there, and Jason turned the heat on for the whole building, plus brought up a space heater in case I needed it.  The building is quiet with lots of privacy, but Jason made it clear that he was right there if I needed anything.  The location is perfect, right off Mass Ave and a quick walk/bike to MIT.  All in all, a wonderful visit to my old neighborhood from my Boston days.  I'll look forward to visiting Jason again and staying in his lovely apartment.

The neighborhood is great and Bruce and Barrie were great! They offered help and assistance readily. We loved the room, and the breakfast in bed was super! I highly recommend this b&b. The hosts and interaction with other guests was great.

This was a wonderful suite very near downtown Boston and only minutes from the T.  We loved our stay as it included not only a beautiful bedroom with an amazingly large and comfy bed, it also had a beautiful living area and bathroom.  The balcony was great and nice and sunny in September!  Elizabeth is very friendly and even provided us with coffee and fresh pastries in the suite each morning!  There is a washer/dryer in the bathroom too and although we did not use it, it is helpful to know that next time we can save on baggage fees and pack a little lighter if we feeling like doing wash.

Only suggestion to people is that if you plan to go back and relax in the evening make sure, if you want it, to buy your wine or any beer while still in downtown as the convenience store across the street does not sell alcohol and there are no other places to buy any alcohol after 9 pm it seems. (except for the restaurants and bars of course!)  All and all this was 100 percent worth the money and much better than a hotel!  Also we used a cab to get to and from the airport and it will run you between 25 and 30 dollars with tip each way and definitely is worth saving time with your luggage and not using the T for that as the T is a maze in itself and takes some time to figure out!  Thanks!  Chris and Jen

My daughters and I had a wonderful stay at Paul's place.  The apartment was exactly as described, very clean and my daughters report it was the most comfortable sofa bed they had ever slept on.  The location in Boston is excellent---safe and charming neighborhood, just a couple of blocks from the subway and only a block from a Whole Foods.  We would definitely stay here again!

It was very easy to get to this wonderful suite, especially with Robin's great directions and help before getting there. She made me feel very welcome when I was there, while also giving me my own space. The suite was very roomy, bed comfortable with a very nice tv, and the bathroom was very nice with a great big shower and bathtub. The location was very convenient for me as I was interviewing at a Harvard-affiliated hospital which was only a 15 min walk away. Thank you so much!!
Everything was as the Jeffery stated and the home and neighborhood was very nice.
Absolutely wonderful space, and Christopher was a fantastic host. He really made sure we had everything we needed, and we had a great time. I'd definitely stay here again!
I've stayed here before, and as like the last time it was lovely. Stanley and Sue are quick to respond and the apartment is comfortable and conveniently located near downtown.

Great to be in the North End. The apartment is perfectly located and ticked off everything we needed. Gina is a wonderful host who made sure the trip become a great experience. We will definitely come back

Stuart takes good care of us during our stay, from caring message for check in, organic food, guidance for baseball game, recommendation sites surrounding. We do really have good time there. Really appreciate and enjoy our first AirBnB experience.

Sarah was a great host. The apartment was comfortable and clean, the rooftop patio had a wonderful view of Boston, and the location was perfect. Everything was exactly as advertised. I'd absolutely stay here again.

Dillon and Jamie are wonderful hosts and made me feel very welcome and at home during my stay with them. The room is spacious, nicely decorated and clean. The pictures and description are accurate. It's located near T and Bus stops, that will bring you downtown in -/+ 20-25 min.
I would definitely recommend this place to others looking for a nice and affordable place to stay. I would definitely come back if I ever need a place to stay again in Boston.

It was very easy to get in touch with the host and we were able to book last minute!  The apartment was exactly as described, clean, and easily accessible.  Easy to get to the T and lovely restaurants right near by.  We would definitely stay here again!

This is a great place to stay!   Our trip to Boston was to tour colleges with our teenage daughter and Lacey's place was perfect for us.   We had separate bedrooms/baths and the condo was spotless and in like new condition.   We loved South Boston and the location is a very easy walk to the T or short drive to major highways and downtown Boston.   Super convenient.   Parking in any Boston neighborhood can be challenging, but there were municipal lots within two blocks and if you plan ahead, you can use Visitor Parking overnight.    We would certainly stay here again, great location and experience!

We loved to stay at Jez and Ken´s place.Both were very welcoming, the room was nice and they even had a little food and drink supply for us in the fridge. Ken took us to the subway. It is easy to get to the city and back ( the bus leaves right when you step out of the subway and stops very close to their house).We will definetly stay there again. 
Für Deutsche: Haus ist sehr nah am Flughafen, nur 10 Minuten Fahrt. Man kann das Auto taqgsüber dort lassen und mit der Ubahn in die Stadt fahren ( Parken in Boston ist unheimlich teuer).
Die Gastgeber sind sehr nett und hilfreich. Unterkunft ist sehr zu empfehlen.

We were thrilled to find this gem of a place in Charlestown! Marie met us and gave us all the information we needed. The apartment was comfortably furnished, and even had a full size washer and dryer. We appreciated the convenient location-just 2 blocks from our daughter and son-in-law's condo. We will most definitely be taking advantage of this find next time we visit our grandson!
Best Airbnb apartment I have ever been living. It locates on a quiet district. Better one is free drinking in the fridge!

The room and bathroom are beautifully furnished and extremely comfortable. The hosts are very warm, welcoming, and helpful.  The T is five minutes walk (redline), as is Starbucks.  Perfect for attending a convention.  I will stay again next time I'm in Boston.
Description and photos are accurate. Host is gracious - it was like staying at a good friend's apt who wanted to be sure everything was right so you would have a good visit.
Stay was great. Place was clean and very quiet for sleeping

Jason is the perfect host and this apartment is perfect. We were fortunate to be the first renters in this apartment, which is perfectly located in the Newbury Street shopping and dining neighborhood. Jason is the perfect host, he met us upon arrival and was always there for us. In summary a great experience. Hope to come back some day.
Her place was excellent and clean. We highly recommend this spot. Close to everything!

Jay's place was very clean and exactly as pictured. Jay was in the apartment to welcome and give us an overview of the place. He was very accommodating and responsive. I highly recommend Jay's apartment and this is one of the best Airbnb experience I have had. Thank you, Jay!

Cindy was an excellent host...made arrangements for a very late check in which was appreciated, left food/coffee/treats in the unit, place was very clean and well appointed.

Her unit was directly across the street from a conference I was attending , so I suppose it couldn't have gotten any better for me. But for others, Beacon Hill is a nice part of Boston and great access to shops, restaurants, T, etc.

Hosts were welcoming and helpful. Room was lovely well appointed and as described. Bed was new and comfortable. Area is 20 minute walk to World Trade Centre. It is quiet . There are restaurants and some shops close by. Description is accurate!
This airbnb experience was great. The location was close to buses and the room was nice. Thanks Tia!

Bryan's apartment was just what we were looking for. Tidy, quiet, and just a couple blocks from Fenway Park. He was very accommodating when our train arrived over an hour later than expected. Easy and clear communication. Highly recommended!

Elizabeth's rental is matching its description:elegant, cozy, quiet, clean, conveniently located with an access to the subway and within walking distance of many touristic attractions. 
We enjoyed the light breakfast neatly stored in the fridge every morning and some personal touch earn the place top ratings from my husband and me!

Lisa and Brian have been grrat hosts! Very hospitable and kind. The room was perfect and we really enjoyed our stay. 

P.S. Lisa's banana bread is awesome!

The place is nice and quiet, full of modern amenities; the bedroom is very spacious and comfortable. Conveniently Located in a nice neighborhood, commuting to downtown is only 20 minutes away.
Shawn is very helpful and prompt with the requests.

It was a very nice room in a very nice apartment. Everything was immaculate. The neighborhood was quiet with adequate parking. It was reasonably convenient to Northeastern University where our son goes to college. 

Lyralen and Judy were excellent hosts.  They gave us great recommendations for Sunday brunch.

We would definitely stay there again.
Julie's advertised listing was spot on. It really is a stylish studio in the heart of the back back.   No complaints, just praise for Julie and her studio.
Susan continues to be one of my favorite hosts! Her place is beautiful and she is very accommodating and responsive.

We didn't  have te opportunity  to meet Suzan in person, but she was  very helpful via email and we had a great stay in her cottage. The location is perfect and the space was very clean and pleasant. She went the extra mile to make sure my girlfriend and I were well situated!!!!!! 
Thanks for everything ....
Very conveniently located, clean and comfortable. Host is exceptionally friendly and helpful, and excellent communication!

Jez and Ken are friendly, always very helpful and full of useful advice. Despite our poor English, they were always available to chat with us. The house completely respects the description.
The nearest underground station is closed until October, but the area is well served by buses that lead to alternative station. If at home, They are always ready to give a lift.
We highly recommend staying with Jez and Ken.

We stayed 3 nights with Andy (Ben was away working) and had a great time. The house was sparkling clean and beautifully furnished. Our room had a really comfortable bed. Andy was a great host, really helpful telling us about Boston - travel directions and places of interest.  He was very easy to chat to and joke with.  Their two really cute dogs Jack and Cody would sit with us on the balcony while we had breakfast. We could have used the kitchen to cook our own meals, but were too lazy and ate out. We were about 10 mins walk from the nearest red line station which took us into downtown Boston. We had a great stay. Thanks Andy!

What a great place to stay. We felt right at home from the minute we walked in. Our kids loved it; never a single minute of boredom. The area couldn't be better, plenty of restaurants and playgrounds nearby. Going anywhere else is only a matter of a short walk.
What really, really makes this place special is the balcony and the roof deck. Perfect spot to spend an evening chatting and enjoying a drink.
Sarah is a great host, responds extremely quickly and had plenty of good ideas and tips on the area.
Wouldn't hesitate to stay again!

West End 12th Floor was in a perfect location just a short walk to North Station for the Amtrak Downeaster, commuter rail, green and orange line.  The Red line was a few blocks in the opposite direction as well as the Blue line... Proximity to public transit couldn't be better.

If you prefer to walk... the condo is just blocks away from the Museum of Science, Duck Boats, Haymarket and the North End.

The condo was immaculately clean and very spacious which made our week long stay in Boston extremely comfortable.  Our host provided an ample supply of clean towels and comfortable bedding.

The WiFi worked perfectly and was easy to access.  

We will stay here again on our future visits to Boston... you should too!

Everything was perfect. Paul was an excellent host, giving tips and all information that we need to enjoy your stay, The apartment was great, it has every details that you need on vacations. The photographs represents exactly the reality and was very clean. The neighborhood is fantastic and charming, the location is perfect to go everywhere. The experiences was perfect! We recommended it!

Our hosts were so kind to let us leave our bags early so we could enjoy the day in Boston before our actual check in later.  When we arrived late and tired, voila!  .... our bags were in our luxurious suite.  The accommodations were PERFECT!   Comfy bed, lots of room, super lovely and a terrific kitchen..  My only regret is that we didn't get to spend enough time in our suite.  Thank you so much for a wonderful stay.  We LOVE Boston!!
Wonderful.  Fantastic place to stay, clean, beautifully kept and in a perfect location.  Host was fantastic in communication!

The stay in Jazz's apartment helped me enjoy Boston even more because of the feeling of returning home. The loft is amzing. Jazz is restless in making you feel at home and at ease around town. The bed gives you the proper rest.

Really nice renovated studio, perfect for a couple staying in Boston for the weekend. Loved having a full kitchen, even if we didn't end of using it for cooking. The bed was really comfortable and we really enjoyed the Netflix on our down time. 

We did have a few hiccups with respect to some work that needed to be done in the lower level (not in our space) and even though it was a bit disruptive, Sarah handled it well and was communicative and worked around our schedules. It was a inconvenience, but handled well and we could see it wasn't the norm. We would definitely stay here again when visiting the city.

Staying at this place was awesome!!!! We couldn't had ask for nothing better. We really loved everything from the beginning to end; the sanchez family though of providing us with everything; directions of how to get around, two Charlie bus cards, sandals, kitchen,deck  and laundry access. But the best part of staying here is
The privacy that you have here.
The hosts are very attentive and understandable, we'll definitely stay here again.

I booked Joe and Cathy's place last minute, and couldn't have been luckier to have found such an amazing place! Their place is central to everything in Boston. The apartment is perfect for two people, and is absolutely adorable - not to mention, there is a rooftop deck with an impressive view and a fabulous hammock for relaxing. Though Joe and Cathy were out of town when I was staying, they made communication super easy and answered any and all questions I had. Would definitely stay here again when I inevitably return to Boston!

It was a great experience to stay at Richard's place. It's super convenient, just locate in the center of the town. Only 5 min walk to the public garden, near China town and there are CVS and Walgreen nearby. Parking lot just right in front of the street. Richard's place just like a hotel, I had never stayed in such luxury place from Airbnb! Definitely recommend :)

Beautiful location and neighborhood.  Jason does a wonderful job of making this a warm and friendly place to stay.  Quick and easy access to the T....10 mins into Boston.  I  will go back anytime when I'm back in Boston.

I had a good experience with the Rustic room, which has a great bed with an electric blanket.  There are three other rooms for rent in the house, so guests share their own kitchen, which is stocked with cereal, muffins, eggs, coffee and tea.  There are two bathrooms for four rooms, so you share with one other room. Lisa was very nice and accommodating, and there is even free popcorn and Netflix in the living room.  Upstairs there is a dining room table with lots of pamphlets and some books about Boston and New England.  But I would say the best added value is the unlimited subway and bus pass that each guest receives, which saves you a bundle.  This makes the room an even better value.

My fiancé and I had a wonderful stay.  The apartment is in a great location in the North End of Boston.  It's surrounded by amazing restaurants and historical sites of interest.  The bed was amazing comfortable and the air conditioners offered much relief from the heat.  As the pictures show, the apartment is tastefully decorated.  We would definitely stay again on our next visit.
Galen was really helpful to show me around his apartment on advance. I rented it for my parents and they were very happy with it. It was confortable and practical for them.

I had a fantastic stay with Peter and his wife. They were perfect hosts, a wonderful room in a great location and I couldn't have asked for anything more. Thank you Peter if I come back to Boston I'd love to come and stay again.
It was really great to stay in Emily's flat. The place is lovely, and beacon Hill too. Emily is a really And convinient to do the Check in. Thank you again!

The house is really charming!
It is fully furnished and equipped with everything you might need. The kitchen is new, clean with all appliances: cooker, microwave, coffee-maker, dish-washer and a big refrigerator. The room has a new nice paint, mirror, chest of drawers, closet , A/C, and an additional drawer under the bed to keep it tidy and neat.
The neighborhood is safe, calm, surrounded by freshly-breezed forests, mini-markets, restaurants with a good transit all around to the downtown.
The host, Mr. Mohamed, is a very nice gentleman who takes a very good care of his house as well as his visitors without compromising their sense of privacy. 
Want a break from the city hassle? Go for this!

Barry and Bruce were excellent hosts!  They were friendly, very accommodating, and made sure you felt at home.  The house was gorgeous, clean, and the breakfast was just what we needed to get started with the day.  The house is an easy 8 minute walk from the Savin Hill T station.  We would certainly recommend Barry and Bruce to anyone else going to Boston.

Jez & Ken are extremely attentive, friendly and informative hosts. Ken was eager to share his impressive knowledge about his local area and Boston city. We were lucky enough to get a little tour of the town from Ken and even took us to a great lookout and a famous little seafood place on the beach! On occasion we would share stories and laughs; we felt like we we were staying with friends! The room itself was very clean, comfortable and warm. We had plenty of space and privacy, as well as a hot shower at the end of the day! Tea, coffee, a light breakfast and snacks were always available to us also. All in all, Ken and Jez are super friendly and very welcoming hosts, their house is well kept and in a great area and I would recommend anyone coming to stay in Boston to stay here! I will be back!

We loved staying at the carriage house. It was clean, new and modern. Exactly as the pictures show. We had all we need for our stay. It was close to the subway to get to all the places we wanted to see. We would highly recommend it to anyone who wants to see the best of Boston and surrounding area.  Thank you!

Sarah and Tom were wonderful hosts. Not only was the space clean, warm and inviting, but they made sure that we had all the necessities that we might need. Additionally, they offered to help acquaint us with the local neighborhood, which we really appreciated!

Thank you for a great stay!

Great place with comfortable beds.  We needed a place for 3 co-workers to stay when all the hotel rooms in boston were $700 a night.  This was perfect and we could walk to find food or a neighborhood bar.

Robert was a great host, letting us in, giving the tour and some suggestions on where to walk in the neighborhood.  Would certainly recommend to anyone who needs an easy stay experience.

Lovely cozy studio located in south Boston. The studio was neat, clean, tidy, and came with everything we needed. It was located a few blocks away from the red line.Most importantly, drew was very helpful as I considered canceling our reservation last minute because I wasn't feeling well. Drew was very accommodating when we finally decided to show up hours later than expected. I highly recommend staying here and will definitely stay here again if given the chance!

Great apartment, in a very modern and nice building. Perfectly located to explore Boston. We stayed for one week with two children. The apartment was perfect for the four of us. Everyone liked to pool, gym and BBQ. Chinatown is just next doors for meals and shopping. Pretty much all central Boston neighbourhoods can be reached on foot. Highly recommended.

Ray welcomed us and made us feel right at home on arrival.   He was helpful assisting us with information and suggestions for things to see in Boston, how to get there, and fun places to eat.  He is a great host, thoughtful, knowledgeable and fun to talk with.   He treated us like we had known each other for years and showed us his favorite local hangout.  It was great!   His home was clean, easily accessible to the subway, buses and close to downtown and the harbor.  Jamaica Plain was fun.  We would love to stay there again.

Katie is an incredibly kind, accommodating host!  She was flexible with both my check-in and check-out times.  The place itself is spacious and comfortable, I melted into the couch after each full day of walking around Boston.  The building is modern and safe, located steps away from the North Station “T” stop – which was really convenient.  A few minutes walking takes you into the heart of the North End, and more specifically the North End food!  Some of the best Italian food, lobster, and desserts you will ever eat.  Thank you Katie, and thank you Neptune Oyster!  Given the chance, I would stay here again for sure and highly recommend it!

Jays apartment in Beacon hill was brilliant- very clean, nice, and in a great location. Very handy for getting into downtown- either walk a bit, or get the red line T metro which is only a few block away. Jay was a very good host and I would definitely recommend him if you plan to stay in Boston!

Me and my family (2 teengers and my husband) have spent a fantastic time at James house. The house is exactly as shown. Really clean and confortable!. Beds were perfect, bathrooms news, towels, sheets,...look like if they were new...We have been 3 days at Boston and think that the location is perfect. After all day out we were happy to came back "home", go around the neigbourgh, running along the beach,....There are lots of stores and people is really nice. We enjoyed very much.
James has been really nice all the time. His friend Liette was wating for us when we arrived and explaned everything although James write very clear lots of things we could need. Every time I texted him , he answer me inmediatly.
The only mad thing is the parking but it is not a problem of James is a problem of Boston. James also gave to us lots of indications about it and a pass for nigth parking, very nice.
We really recomend to stay at James. If we are so lucky of comming back we stay there again.
Thank you very much James.

The apartment was nice and as advertised. Frank was very good and prompt in communicating. The apt is located on ground level, which I liked, and was easy to access. About a block or so from the Garden, which can be seen from the apartment. Within several block of amenities and restaurants. Faces a busier street, but wasn't overly noisy--and the bedroom is in the back part of the apt. There is meter parking on the street. There's a smaller parking garage several blocks out the door to the right, and then a half block to the right again before going on a bridge-like part of the street. King bed. I would stay there again if available.

My stay with Jill was a great experience. Her home is near to downtown (only a short walh to bus or T), but on the other hand in a friendly and quiet neighborhood. The ideal starting point for a great holiday!
The room and Jill provides all you need for a comfortable stay.
Jill is a very interesting person who provides a lot of information about the Boston and the life there. It was a pleasure to stay with her!
And also with the pets who are absolutely lovely.
Since I had to shorten my stay due to personal reasons I hope to come back to Boston soon and that I will have the chance to stay again at  Friendly Great Boston Neighborhood!

We came to Boston for two days with friends to visit the city for the first time . We have not met Eran and Michael but all the instructions given by email were very clear and easy to follow. We found the key hanging on the front gate, in safety in a locker, and we quickly settled into the apartment. Considerate, Eran and Michael had left us details about the nice places in the area, how to get to the subway and where go to eat . We had clean towels left on the bed as well as coffee, tea, cakes, cereals and bread left to our attention in the kitchen for breakfast. Everything was clean, comfortable, friendly and the apartment was exactly like on the photos! We had a great time and we found the neighborhood very nice, just half an hour from downtown by subway. We recommend the apartment of Michael and Eran without hesitation! :)
Excelent location at Beacon Hill. The apartment is clean and comfortable. It is exactly as described at AirBNB. Very nice óption to stay in Boston

Susan was an excellent host! She was very helpful and accommodating throughout the process. The cottage is beautiful, in great condition, and in a very convenient location for visiting the Boston area.  I would highly recommend this listing to anyone.

Kevin and Julia were great host and had thought through a lot of details down to a chocolate on the pillow, directions, recommendations of places to go and eat. They made it all very easy having thought through the visitor's experience e.g. a photo of the keys with labels to know which one to use. 

The location of their apartment was excellent for the Hynes Convention Center where I went. The apartment was also easy to get to via public transport. Kevin and Julia were also very prompt in answering the questions I had. The room was large, comfortable with good hanging space and a large bed and good pillows. They also provided Wifi access.

Our host made us feel welcome. He had to come over to the apartment to help with the WiFi as the router seemed to be having a problem. We also needed bath soap and paper towels which he quickly provided.
This apartment is in a very convenient neighborhood in north Boston. We loved the Italian restaurants and bakeries and the ability to walk to many historic sights. Thanks James for renting us a great place.

My second time traveling to Boston was wonderful with this cute and cozy apartment! We can find everything we need here and they are all very clean and new. Jason gave us a enthusiastic welcome. He and Nicole are great hosts. The information binder provided by them is also very useful. The restaurants on the list are amazing!

We love Back Bay so much. The environment is great there and quite near to the shops on Newbury St. It became my favorite place in Boston now.

This was my first Airbnb experience and everything turned out great!  The place was exactly as described (see details), and Jonathan was a very friendly and accomodating host.  My stay in the master bedroom suite was brief, as I was visiting my daughter who lives in town, but I can see this place and its amenities would be well-suited to a longer stay as well.  Jonathan's Brownstone is impeccably restored and super-clean.  On-street parking worked out OK, though later at night I had to search a bit (parallel parking skills required!).  Overall, highly recommended!  Thanks, Jonathan.

Adam's apartment is conveniently located just round the corner from the Boston Symphony Orchestra. Staying in his apartment was just what I wanted, much better than staying in a hotel. The location is quiet, and I had a large bedroom. The kitchen has all the appliances you'd expect. Adam is a great host. He introduced me to his friends who dropped by, but most of the time he wasn't there, and I had the place to myself. There is a grocery store and a liquor store close by, so self catering for breakfast and a couple of other meals wasn't a problem. The internet connection worked fine, but I had to try a couple of servers before I had a good connection. Overall this worked very well for me, and if location is a key consideration I would certainly recommend Adam's apartment.
I had a great experience at this location!  Large room, comfy bed, and a great neighborhood.  It's ideal for single women or for a couple who is interested in experiencing Boston.

Danielle is a very great host,nice and charming person. Everything was perfect. The room was perfectly clean and the bathroom too and you get all the privacy you need  . Danielle lives very close to the subway station and 5min later your in the center of Boston.
We definitly recommend her room.

Susan, Steve and their boys were perfectly lovely, gracious, welcoming hosts. The cottage is amazing and very much felt like home-away-from-home; every time I thought "Hm, I wonder if there's an (item)..", there was - kitchen and bathroom both had everything we needed. We had a terrific stay, and even wound up staying an extra day due to a blizzard shutting the city down, our flight home being canceled. We were warm and cozy inside, watching 18" of snow fall overnight, and Susan and Steve made sure we were well taken care of. Thank you so much!

From the moment we walked in to the the last goodbye Ken N Jez were the perfect hosts; making sure we had everything we needed and helping us maneuver our way around Boston on public transportation.  They have a great hot, steamy shower, bed nice and comfy and their kitchen is in a fun 50's decor.  I wouldn't hesitate to stay with them again.

Michelle truly is an airbnb SUPERHOST! Her kindness, warmth and intelligent conversation are outstanding. She really knows urban Boston and her neighborhood in depth. We felt so lucky to taste her yummy baked goods and wonderful potluck contributions! Finally, the fleece bedlinens were SO comfy!
Thank you for a memorable stay.

We had a fantastic time at Nicole & Jason's apartment. It was in a fantastic location, and the yellow folder was so helpful to find things to do and places to eat. Jason was great greeting us (earlier than the usual check in time) and checking everything was ok a few days into our stay. We hope to come back and stay at Nicole & Jason's next time we visit Boston.

This place was great.  It was easy to find, easy to check in and centrally located.  We would stay here again.  We have two children and the spacious 2 bedroom accommodated the 4 of us easily.  

Jason also hosted several people who were renting to a rooftop cookout and 4th of July fireworks show.  Great experience for the entire family (even the teenager had fun).

This was the perfect place to stay in Boston! Close to everything, clean and cool (which was a huge plus in this heat) and quiet, easy to get to and get around from, and all around fab! Caroline was super helpful, so quick to respond to any questions, and the perfect host - her guide to the city was great! Would 100% stay here again if we ever come back to Boston, thanks again for a great experience!

From the moment we walked in, my family and I were pleasantly surprised by the attention to detail that Jason has put into this apartment. The kitchen is fully stocked, the linen and bedding is very comfortable and the location is wonderful. The loft even has a foosball table and a nintendo Wii. My mother, who is a complete psycho when it comes to hygiene and cleanliness, was very happy with the apartment and that is a very big compliment! Jason was available via phone, text and email and provided a detailed welcome package. I would definitely stay in this apartment again when I visit Boston next time.
Great place!  Wonderful location, so close to the airport and close to several restaurants/bars. The room was clean and all ready for me.  Great place and would definitely stay again!

When I was first looking for places to stay in the Boston area I knew I wanted to stay in JP and Lynne and Erik's house seemed like it would be a good place to stay - It turned out to be an amazing place to stay. If you are looking to explore an interesting lively area of Boston I highly recommend staying there. The neighborhood has many things to discover like Tres Gatos, (a tapas bar/records store/bookstore in one) and lovely streets & older homes surrounding Jamaica Pond. Lynne & Erik's house is just a short walk to all, and it's convenient to the T to get into Boston. The house is really cool - it feels like a retreat because of all the greenery in the yard, and because of it's airy farmhouse style. I loved the decor which (to me at least) had an old New England feel with a 70's vibe - which I appreciated as a Californian. I felt right at home. The room is private and has windows with a great view of the yard. There is a nice couch where you can sit and read, and a space where you can hang up your clothes. It's was also very clean and comfy. Yes, the bathroom is not next to the room, but it's really not a hassle. 
I didn't get to meet Lynne who was away, but Erik was really fantastic. He had a lot of knowledge of JP and the city and lots of things to share about the neighborhood. He gave me a great recommendation on where to grab a bite when I first arrived (City Feed) and he suggested visiting the Isabel Stewart Gardener Museum, which I don't think I would have made time for otherwise -  and I am so glad that I did! He also makes a great cup of coffee.  They also have a very sweet & friendly dog. I wish that I would have had more time to sit and enjoy the yard or to just read in the room or chat. I would not hesitate to stay there again. Thank you for graciously opening up your home and for taking the time to answer my questions about JP.

Chris and Kelly were the most perfect hosts!  They were already on vacation when we arrived, but arranged for a friend to met us at the condo to give us the keys.  Seamless transaction and their friend was awesome and helpful.  The condo is beyond gorgeous.  Looks even better than the pictures.  Both beds were very comfortable, which was greatly appreciated by our sore legs on Monday night.  The location was perfect as well.  Right next to the Red & Orange T lines and 1 block from the Blue & Green T lines.  Getting around Boston couldn't have been any easier.  Hopefully Chris and Kelly will go on vacation during the Boston Marathon next year so we can rent their condo again!

The apartment was very nice, and looked exactly like the images posted. Moshen himself was a great host and definitely made the experience for my first use of Air BnB a great one. The neighborhood is situated in a very quiet neighborhood and very close to the red line(a great way to move around boston). The rooms were all very clean, Moshen was always in contact with me if I ever needed something or had a question. 

This is a highly recommended place to stay if you're looking for a great price and quality of a BnB.

Wonderful place - spacious, modern, clean, quiet, yet in a great location. Check in/check out was simple. I travel to Boston often and will definitely rent again. In fact, I was looking to rent it in Nov, but it's fully booked. That says something about how great the place is.

Robin came by one day to bring some things we needed but unfortunately I wasn't there at the time but a few of my family members did get to meet her.  She had even given me her daughters contact info because we were hoping to have my granddaughter meet her because they both love art but we were on the go so much didn't get to do that. The house itself was wonderful and met the needs of all nine of us.  Couldn't have asked for any better location especially with train right across the street.  Had grocery stores within walking distance and if too much to carry back just caught the train back to the house.  All my family would definitely stay with Robin again.  Thank you for allowing us to use your house.
Wonderful stay with Bob. The place was beyond comfortable and so well decorated. Would definitely stay here again.

We loved staying at Linda's place. Everything was immaculate and close to transport to the city. She is  a lovely  hostess...very interesting and helpful and easy to talk to. Nothing was too much trouble. We would certainly highly recommend staying with her.

The place was really clean and very easy to move around town. Lev is nice and attentive. Everything was great! It was really easy to contact him, and he was willing to help with anything. Wonderful host
I LOVED Paul's place.  Very lovely, and extremely close to the airport.  Paul is a FABULOUS host.  Very open to communication and change.  I will stay again when in Boston.

Great place - astounding view and lovely building. Very comfy bed and quiet surroundings. Just enough space for my daughter and I with room to spare.
It was a new area of Boston for us to explore.

Beautiful apartment, and we enjoyed our stay, even with record snow in Boston.  The apartment was exceptionally clean, the host left detailed instructions, that covered everything in the apartment, as well as, local restaurants and the like.  The apartment was close to restaurants, buses, metro, coffee shops and grocery stores, and we had no problems getting around in the snow.  We chose this location, because it was 2 - 3 blocks from our daughter's apartment, and would definitely stay again if opportunity arises.

Bruce and Barry were great! They picked us up at the airport when we arrived and throughout our stay ensured that our stay was perfect. They provided great recommendations  about places to see in the area.  The house is beautiful old house with all of the best modern touches while keeping its old charm. The room was a beautiful, extremely clean and comfortable. The shared bathroom has an amazing shower!

Not to mention cute doggies!

The house is in a nice, quiet neighbourhood, close to a beach and only a few minute walk to the subway station. Also in the neighbourhood are a few nice restaurants and ice cream shop. 

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay with Bruce and Barry, and highly recommend them!
It was an absolutely great experience. Clean and hospitable. Easy commute. Loved it.
My boyfriend and I stayed here for a reunion weekend.  Diana was a great host and the apartment is beautiful, comfortable and incredibly convenient!

The apartment is beautiful, spacious, very clean, and in a great location. Philip was a great host and made all the arrangements for my stay super easy. He was very quick with all communications. I would highly recommend staying here, and I hope to do so again in the future!
wonderful experience. Home was very clean, instructions for everything very clear, and neighborhood is darling.  Dorothy and Seth are very accommodating!

Shawn's place was exactly as described and even better than the pictures. He kept in contact with me up until I arrived and we met not long after I checked in. I ended up leaving a day prior to my checkout date, but he was completely ok with that and made my stay extremely easy. He was super friendly and I was very happy with my stay. I have no complaints what so ever !

We were absolutely blown away by our stay! I surprised my boyfriend with a weekend away from school and could not be happier with how it turned out. The pictures are very true to life and everything was wonderfully comfortable and updated. Elizabeth could not have been more accommodating and helpful! I would spend every weekend in the suite if I could!!

It is so ironic that Julie mocked my not wanting to place a negative review on the site. I did not wish for her to lose business because of my concerns but rather to fix the bed for the next traveler. I rent out a condo in Florida and we appreciate feedback if something needs fixing or is not up to par so we can make improvements for the next renter.

We are in the midst of a Resolution Process, but I do need to defend myself. I did not break the pullout bed; I did not crawl over the bottom of the bed. My niece and I did not open the fold-out bed in it’s original position, because there was a little desk on the opposite wall, and it did not appear that it would fit that way, once pulled out.
So, we pulled the pull-out couch around (bed still tucked neatly inside) and opened it out into the room. I DID NOT step on the bed, but went to the right of the bed and lay down on it. The bottom third of the bed promptly fell down--and at the time, it was actually comical because the end of the bed fell right down to the floor. I NEVER stepped on the bed; all I did was lie down on it.....that began the conversations with Julie, because I figured I would be on the mattress on the floor that night. She did come over while we were out to dinner and the bed was out and she left a note to not get in the bed from the bottom.  Since I had done nothing except lie down on the bed ( I weigh 112 pounds) and it had crashed before, I chose not to risk lying on it again...(the black mesh was all that was holding up the end of the bed...)...and I slept on the mattress on the floor both nights--hence the request for a small refund since we did not feel we had the two beds, as expected. We were in for a bridal shower for a very short weekend, with every moment planned and did not have time to start searching for another place. The rest of the apartment was just fine and in a great location.

The Carney family have a lovely home in a really convenient part of town.  My stay was only very brief but the room and bathroom(s!) were clean, comfortable and beautifully decorated.  

Mary was away when we stayed but Barney was the absolute epitome of hospitality. 

If I am ever in the area again I would definitely look for a vacancy here.

Jez and Ken were the most welcoming hosts i've met so far! I felt like i was living in a 5 star equivalent hotel. Room was cozy and very very comfortable. Utmost important, they made me feel at home. It's a shame i was only there for a night!  Thank you guys!

Very pleasant and comfortable accommodations in central Jamaica Plain, near the businesses of Centre St. and beautiful Jamaica Pond. Ray was a friendly and responsive host and made sure that I had whatever I needed. Kitchen access was also great.

My boyfriend and I stayed with Jez & Ken for two nights upon arriving in Boston at the start of our holiday. In advance of arriving, Jez & Ken had been great at answering my many questions. We could not have asked for anywhere better to stay. Although Ken was away, Jez (and the cats) made us very welcome and went out of his way to help. On our first and only full day in Boston, the weather was against us in the morning but Jez kindly gave us a lift to the station, via a local viewpoint for a photo opp! The room was great and we were made to feel very at home. If we're ever back in Boston I know where we'll be staying! Thanks!

Lovely room and congenial hosts in a beautiful home. Easy walk to metro 
for quick trip downtown Boston. Plenty of local restaurants and area seed safe. Shared bathroom and b/f 
provided. A real find.

We stayed with Edward for three nights and were very happy with our experience.  Edward is helpful and gracious.  The house is lovely and met all of our needs.  The East Suite is very private and nicely appointed.  Clean, nice bed linens, comfortable bed and very nice private bath.  The roof deck as beautiful and quite a bonus on a lovely Boston afternoon or evening.

Great location within short walking distance to the Center of Harvard and Metro Station to Boston. The Cabin is clean and tidy with a nice arty Flair. Despite the very Central location totally quiet and in a very green area. 
Breakfast in the fridge and Big TV Movies And Games if needed. Very comfortable futon bed - overall to be totally recommended! despite we didn't meet Christopher he was available via sms for any questions.
Many thanks for a Good night sleep And comfortable stay in Harvard!

Alice was a wonderful host.  The room was comfortable, the breakfast was good and the company was excellent. The location is only a short walk from the T with easy access to downtown Boston.  This was my fifth Boston Marathon and the best experience I've had in Boston.

Great location, quiet area, neat apartment and conveniently located. Walking distance from a lot of local restaurants and shops.
Our host made sure we were comfortable from the time we checked-in until the morning we left.

We had an awesome stay at Carlos' condo.  It was neat and had everything we needed.  We couldn't find the ac remote and Carlos had one brought to us immediately! Very attentive host! It's also central to many great spots for food and drinks.

Ray's home is clean, comfortable, spacious and lovely. The neighborhood is great, with Jamaica Pond at one end of the street and amazing shops, clubs and restaurants just around the corner.
Ray is pleasant and accessible and provided us with some very good recommendations for dining in the neighborhood.
We enjoyed our stay and would absolutely return to Ray's the next time we are in Boston.

Lisa is a great host! She provided useful tour information about Boston and loved to share her life or opinions with us! We are just like friends! Her home is just like my home:) We have everything we need! TKS! Also, the public transportation is easy! There is a bus stop just across her house's street and you could take metro after 2 stops of the bus! Lisa is sweet to provide free passes for bus or metro! You don't need to worry about the fare about the bus or metro! Thanks! Just come to stay:)

I had a wonderful four nights at Mohamed's house. It's in a nice quiet area with excellent public transport links to the centre of Boston. 
The house is very attractive. It's tastefully decorated and stylishly furnished. The bedroom has lots of drawer space and plenty of wardrobe room. The bed is a very large single and the air conditioning is good without being aggressive. 
Mohamed is a calm, fun, intelligent, wall and welcoming person.
The house was as described in the listing. It has been keep up very nice. It met all our needs and our kids had a wonderful time staying at the place.

Me and my mum had a great stay in Valery's Apartment. It was our first airbnb experience and first time in Boston, but Valery was super helpful and made sure everything was very easy and convenient for us- providing us with lots of useful advice and suggestions of things to do and maps etc. The apartment was comfortable, clean and tidy and really well situated just a few minutes walk from a T stop. Valery is an excellent host- we would definitely stay at his place again, and I highly recommend it!

Steve and Megan were great hosts.. very accommodating and knowledgeable.  Everything was well organized and ready for us when we got there.  We would definitely swing by again if we are in the Boston area.

The apartment was amazing and Paul was a great host. He was able to recommend some great sites in Boston and some great places to eat. The apartment was extremely clean and better than the pictures. The location is perfect and walking distance to most sites. We would definitely stay here next time we are back in Boston.

My husband and I had a lovely time staying at Helen's! Helen and her husband were so warm and welcoming. Helen even met us outside to help direct us to parking when we got to the residence and took us in and showed us around. The apartment was even prettier than the photographs and had all of the equipment and spices we needed for cooking snacks that we brought. Helen also went the extra mile by having things like coffee, milk, and her amazing homemade granola stocked. In addition to having a wonderful host and staying in a great apartment we also loved the neighborhood. Jamaica Plain is a cute neighborhood worth exploring when you visit Boston and the train was only a 3 minute walk from the apartment so made getting downtown fast and simple.
Marie was very welcoming and the apartment is in a great location.  We enjoyed our stay.

My boyfriend and I stayed at Julie's lovely apt over a weekend. It was the perfect location to drop off our things and walk everywhere. We want to avoid having to travel by car as much as possible. Julie's apartment was very clean and welcoming and I would definitely recommend anyone coming to Boston to stay at Julie's place. Thank you Julie for being a wonderful host. Blessings.

CONVENIENT LOCATION:
Rachel, our Host, has an apartment unit in a two-unit townhouse located in South End that is in an ideal location in Boston.  The apartment is located in a very quiet and elegant neighborhood, yet it is only 300 yards to the Back Bay train station (Amtrak and the Orange T Line) and 700 to 800 yards to Copley Square, Back Bay’s Newbury St. (with its restaurants and shops), and the Star supermarket near to the Prudential Center.  There is also a Trader Joe’s at the Prudential Center

The apartment is also super-convenient to the T (Green Lines) at Copley Square, which connect to Brookline, Boston College, and the main Museums, as well as to Downtown Crossing and all the other T lines and the trains.
A few steps away between Huntington Ave and Columbus Ave is a pedestrian walkway that runs over half a mile (or about a Kilometer) from Dartmouth Street to Massachusetts Avenue; this is a pleasant walk among gardens, children’s playgrounds, and between residences

GREAT COMMUNICATION WITH OUR HOST RACHEL:
