Loved this place and hated to leave! Nitzen was very kind. He took the time to meet us and show us around. The shuttle was so convenient. The place was clean and felt homey. We enjoyed Charleston and the area. Highly recommend!
A lovely apartment in a quiet, very friendly location, but close to the city. It totally lived up to our expectations.

Joe was a perfect host. He left written instructions and recommendations, so everything went smooth. His place is very well kept and it's located in a very "Bostonian" part of the city. A very good experience.
A great place to stay, I felt cozy and warm here. Highly recommended!
We stayed for two nights and had a really good time! Jason and Stephanie are great hosts and we felt just like home.

Before arriving in Boston, James sent easy to follow directions on how to get to his centrally located home. Upon our arrival and throughout our stay, my daughter and I, were greeted with a happy, kind-hearted family. James was particularly helpful in any directions we needed for navigating around the city. Afeng was sweet and lovely. She saw to it that our stay was as comfortable as possible. It was a pleasure learning more about the Chinese culture and we felt comfortable and safe in their home. Thank you so much for making our stay in Boston simply awesome! Please remember to come visit us in California, too!
My friend and I just had another great stay at the Carney's house! Great place to stay when you are visiting Boston!

My fiancé and I spent 3 nights in this lovely apartment.  We chose it in part for these reasons: In the neighborhood we wanted to be in, Back Bay; the price was right, for the area; a king size bed; and the photos of the apartment made it look like a lovely, clean, uncluttered, modern and comfortable apartment.  We were happy and satisfied on all of these points. The apartment looks as good, or better, than the photos, is comfortable, with a small outside porch with chairs, and we loved the rooftop terrace where we drank coffee in the mornings.  

The neighborhood, just off of Mass Ave. is in walking distance of so many restaurants and shops, and not as touristy as Newberry or Boylston Streets.  It is also close to a few places with live music.  It is central enough to get anywhere in Boston/Cambridge easily.  

We rented bicycles from Community Bikes for $25.00/day. With bikes we rode along the Charles River, and used them to get around, in general, for a couple of days.  

We did not meet Dan, but he was easy and quick to communicate with and available by phone/text/email.  Thank you Dan and Gina for sharing your place with us, we enjoyed it!

Our hostess greeted us at the door upon our arrival from the airport. Gracious and energetic, though she was on her way out, Antoinette took the time to walk us through her beautiful home, show us our room and where everything in the kitchen, we might possibly need, could be found. 
Traveling to a new part of the country, my anxiety was eased finding our home away from home to be well appointed, in an upscale neighborhood and just blocks from a fun shopping/eating district. We found it easy to explore all of Boston via public transportation.

Had a great experience at Lou's cozy flat. Lots of room and a nice outdoor space. Easy access with the blue line 5 mins away. Not the best place if you want to be in the heart of the action, but it was perfect for us. Cute toiletries and chocolates were a sweet touch. Had some issues finding the place and Lou was easy to get in touch with to quickly sort it out.

Alice is a fantastic host. She really made us feel at home. It was esp. difficult for me since I broke my wrist on the first day we were in Boston. Alice was very helpful and supportive. She literally went out of her way to make our stay with her very pleasant. Thanks Alice.
We highly recommend her!

This giant, beautiful house in Allston was perfect for my sister's non-traditional bachelorette party! Jeffrey and his wife had a little welcoming gift, ample amounts of space, a perfectly clean home, with many charming touches, comfortable beds, and tips and instructions for just about everything needed (recycling, thermostat, etc.). This rental was so, so gorgeous and I would absolutely rent it again. We mostly just used the space to cook a few appetizers, get dressed, and drink a champagne toast before heading out for the night, but I am so appreciative for the big size of the home and that they were able to accommodate our big group without fearing the "bachelorette" connotation :)

I would recommend this rental to anyone looking for a charming, clean and comfortable home with lots of character! It was an ideal backdrop for our special night.

Wonderful experience! We have stayed at Kara's apartment as a family of five people. The apartment is well laid out, has two very nicely furnished bedrooms, a big living room with a couch wich is fit to provide comfortable night rest for one person, the kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need to feel yourself at home (coffee machine, tea pot, microwave oven, laundry machine, drying machine, etc). We have been provided with plenty of towels, extra bed sheets, complementary coffee and tea sets.
Prior to our arrival, via e-mail we have been given clear instructions about check in and check out procedures, which made it very easy to find the place and get assistance of 24 hour concierge service, located in the building.
Apartment building is located in a nice neighbourhood, close to the center of Boston. There is a 24 hour grocery store just across a street, there are cafes and restaurants in the building.
It's a very comfortable apartment for a family stay.

We had a great weekend at Brooke's flat in back bay.  The space was comfortable with everything you could need and the location was fantastic.  Brooke was very helpful and flexible.  She had her cleaner come early so we could get a few hours bit before check in.  She communicated and got back to us quickly with questions.  There was a bit of noise on Saturday night, but that is what you get with any location like this -- right in the heart of everything.  We would definitely stay at Brooke's again.
Alex is one of those hosts you would hope to meet every time. She is friendly, responsive, and conscientious. The rooms are always clean and decorating in good taste. I highly recommend this host.

We enjoyed a three night stay at the PINK ROOM.  As first-time Airbnb guests we were not quite sure what to expect; Andrea was a attentive and gracious host and we found the accommodations to be just as advertised. She worked hard to made us very comfortable with how we share the very pleasant spaces in her charming house. The room was clean and comfortable, the coffee and tea service was much appreciated, as was the loan of her iron and ironing board. She shared a lot of information about the neighborhood and we enjoyed walking from her place to a couple of Jamaica Plan restaurants.

First time using airbnb for business travel and it worked out beautifully. Megan and Stephen were welcoming hosts who went the extra mile in their hospitality. They were quite accommodating, letting me drop my things off before the room was ready. From printed maps to the welcome letter with local recommendations, they had obviously put a lot of thought into the details to make the stay as easy as possible. Highly recommend the hosts and location!
Liz was wonderful.  I can't say enough about her kindness. Her home was beautiful and very clean. Thank you Liz for making me and my mother's time in Boston so memorable.

My boyfriend and I stayed at the Moroccan luxury suite for our birthday and had the most wonderful time! Elizabeth was a wonderful host, she was there to help with all of our questions and needs.  The apartment is in a gorgeous area of boston, very close to plenty of great things to do.  Staying at the apartment made our weekend special, I would recommend it to anyone!

We were so happy to find that the space looked exactly like all the pictures; that doesn't always happen. The book prepared by our hosts was clear, easy to understand and very helpful, even though we were already familiar with the neighborhood. For newcomers to the area it is essential.

Tim's place in Somerville was great. The information and Charlie card provided made everything so easy. The neighborhood was very walkable and access to both Boston by subway and Harvard by bus is a breeze. We would definitely stay there again if traveling to Boston.

We had a wonderful stay at Marisa's condo. The location is superb! It's within walking distance of the Freedom Trail, the North End, Boston Common, etc. It's the perfect central location for all of your exploring. The condo is small and cozy, and very comfortable. Keep in mind that the kitchen is tiny and there isn't an oven, but this is pretty standard for the area. It was the perfect size for us to make a few meals on the stove top and have breakfast each morning. Marisa and Lin were both great to work with, and checked in several times during our stay to make sure we had everything we needed. It was a great experience overall.
This place was awesome, great location and very nice inside. Many great restaurants right down the street. Would definitely stay again.

Our stay in Izzy's place was fantastic. The location is perfect, rooms very clean, and bed very comfortable. He was very quick to respond to any questions I had and had very clear instructions. (Just need to make sure you read it!) Defiantly a place I would recommend to friends and family.
Francine was a good host. A few kinks (think we might have been the first guests in that house) but a beautiful flat in a lovely area
Didn't get to meet the host, place was perfectly fine, as described and in a convenient location. Would stay again!
My boy-friend and I stay here for two days. Sean is a very kind host, but the apartment was very small And not so clean

The apartment is in a great neighborhood, near the T, whole foods and the Bunker Hill Monument. The apartment itself was good, the futon easy to use and comfortable, the kit was great though it did not have all the essentials so check before you plan on making a meal. Jen was a great host, very nice and flexible.

Sean was very accommodating and communication was fantastic. The apt is exactly as described, it's a great spot to drop you bag and explore Boston.  If your going to a game at Fenway like we were there is not a better place to stay it couldn't have been more convienent.  Sean was great when it came to letting us check in early and check out late, I couldn't recommend this place more.
A little confusion at first getting the key.  Room was as described.
Beautiful bedroom in convenient and beutiful neighborhood. We haven t met Josefa, but she was nice enough to set up the key pick up at out best convenience.

Parking was easy and adjacent to the buildings and saw host once. Sarah and her son have a graceful demeanor. 
The only coffee was instant decaf-with-milk premix. Bfast is bread and jam. Had to get my own bath soap: The only bath soap were a couple of used bars and there was no hand soap.  Toiletries needed restocking. 
The room and bed were spacious, on its own floor, with a door lock. 
The neighborhood was noisy: yelling at night and music from neighbors echoed clearly through closed windows/door.  If you're a heavy sleeper: not an issue. 
I would not walk in this neighborhood too late and too often.

Andrew's apartment was my first experience using AirBNB, and he made it very smooth and painless. The apartment is exactly as described and pictured in the listing, no surprises. In a great location close to Kenmore Square, Fenway Park, and the T. Andrew went out of his way to keep me informed, excellent host. 

Great place to stay in the Back Bay, and Andrew was an excellent host.

It is a lovely place onky 15 minutes away of the center of Boston. It was easy to find and we had a very fluent communication. The place itself was perfect for our staying, with a vey comfortable bed an even better shower which are very important thing to us. I strongly recommend this place! Thank you very much for everything Anthony! For sure we will go again in our next visit.

Joe is a very nice host. The place is exactly as described and Joe made a last minute arrangement for me as I needed to extend my stay by one night. He is very responsive in answering my questions as well.  Thanks Joe!

The location was good but the apartment is located above this tavern and when we were there for the weekend, it was really noisy. The noise continued all the way till 3.30am. We were woken up several times during the night so light sleepers may wish to take this into account. As per the other reviews, the lights from the theatre across the apartment can be really bright as well. Apartment itself is slightly old but has all the amenities you would need for a short stay.
Tony was a wonderful host. Place was clean and organized. Made getting in and out a breeze. Highly recommend if looking for a convenient beacon hill apt.

The apartment is nice and Alexandra was polite. She left some resources for touristy things in Boston, and very clear instructions related to the rental. We didn't see much of her, but enjoyed meeting a French couple who happened to be renting the second AirBnB bedroom.

Our only real complaint was that the bed is not a real bed, but a fold-up bed with a futon-type mattress. It didn't provide as good of back support as a real mattress.
The location is outstanding. Pictures were but deceiving but the room was clean and comfortable. Building looks a little rough from the street and there was a foul smell upon first entering the hall.

Didn't have a chance to meet, but everything was straightforward and as described.  The bed was firm and comfortable.  The room was clean.  Good location.  It isn't advertised as the Ritz. It's not even a beautiful house, so don't expect it.  However, for the price and location, it was perfectly adequate.

It was difficult finding a 1 bedroom apartment in Boston in a reasonable location in mid October over a month ahead of time.  We paid over $300 a night.  The apartment was fine although the pull-out couch very very uncomfortable.  The most difficult part was communication with the managing company.  Traffic was backed up and we couldn't get to the apartment until just after the concierge left, and finding someone to help was difficult.  I encountered the RUDEST MOST SARCASTIC female on the phone I have ever imagined.  So stressful.

Me and my 3 friends wanted to rent this apartment for 3 nights. Drori responded within 10 minutes and let us know, that it was only free for 2 nights, and he offered us a larger apartment for one night right around the corner, and even offered us a cheaper price due to the inconveniance. Both places were super, clean, spacious - and in a great part of Boston, if you like great food as much as we do. We really liked, that we had a phone number to the super in charge, because we came from NM with a bad experience of Airbnb. But in this case, it was totally professional and high quality service! They even offer storrage of your luggage in a safe place between travels. I have good experience from Europe as well with airbnb, but this is high and beyond. I highly recommend this place! You are totally safe renting a place through this guy.

Apartment very clean.
close to the city
no problem to find a place to park
Chritine is very lovely.
Thanks again

This is a great little studio apartment. It's located behind the house at the very back of the driveway. When you walk in, the bathroom is located right in front of you from the entry way. The bathroom is perfect and the stand up shower is fantastic. Upstairs takes you to the living area. This is a great little area. Living area plus a bed area and kitchen with a nice island to sit at. Plus there is air conditioning. Michelle was very accomodating. One major issue seems like squirrels or mice might be getting inside the structure as I noticed holes at each end of the upstairs. Didn't see any. But not sure what else those holes would be from. Otherwise, it's a great rental property for the 3 nights we had it.
Staying at Appleton street was very convenient. The flat is centrally located and we were able to walk to most destinations.

The host was great and attentive, checking on us to make sure that everything was alright. She left us some milk and cereal which was really nice of her. The house was clean and neat. 
Great place to stay in Boston!

We arrived into Boston and used GPS to get to this location. Christine greeted us and showed us into her apartment. Her very excitable dog Bella met us too and  was a bit over excited to see us. The guest room has a big comfortable bed which we happily spent three nights in and the room has cable TV which is a really nice touch. Hot water in tap and shower was never an issue at this property. Getting to the T (subway) is very easy, just 5 minute walk away. Location is very good.
This is a great apartment in the heart of Little Italy! Uber drivers were very impressed with the location as we were dropped off. This is a real local's experience!

The description of the studio apartment was accurate.  It's location was convenient - 15 min walk to the Hynes Convention Center and close to the T subway station.  Hotels in the area are expensive.  Since I was coming for a conference, the airbnb option was perfect for me. There is a keyless entry system with a combination code that also made it convenient.  I never met Will, but he was available over the airbnb website for questions.

Check in instructions were detailed and very helpful. It was convenient having electronic key entry-pad locks and not having to carry keys around town. Neighborhood was good, safe, and conveniently located, especially with bike lanes on Mass Ave. and on nearby streets; and with Boston's bike share program Hubway located a block away. Listing was accurate and I would consider staying again if wanting to stay in the same location. The studio floods with fantastic daytime light but unfortunately does the same in the evening. We therefore would have greatly welcomed darker curtains and/or shades to aid in our sleeping past sunrise which was prior to 6AM but we are "grounded in reality" in knowing that the host is not in control of when the sun rises, and of the nearby street lights.
Aaron was an awesome host!! Very hospitable and welcoming. He even let us play his new board game!

Larry was a great host - he met us at the property and gave us lots of great local tips on places to eat and shop and tourist sites to see.  He was also really communicative before and after, making key collection and check-out hassle free.  The flat is really nice - clean and light, the decor is very simple but the flat is even better in reality than in the pictures provided.  However the best thing about it is the location.  The street is full of great little cafes, boutiques and close to a lovely park, the main shopping district and almost on top of the famous Freedom Trail which we had great fun walking.  We would definitely recommend staying here, it made our trip!

We were able to check into our room early, which was very accomodating. The studio appartment was pretty much identical to the posting, the only exception being the amount of dust on light fixtures and appliances. The location was absolutely perfect. All parts of Boston-the Back Bay, the North End, the South End were all within walking distance. Overall, we were pleased with our stay.

The host made me feel generally welcome but to be clear you are not really sharing someone's house, you are renting a room and have communal use of a kitchen and bathroom. There is no communal lounge.

The house had a "tired" feel to it.

Very accommodating. A friend and I needed a place to stay when we visited Boston for PAX East and Sean was flexible enough in his schedule that even with all the activity during the day we were able to get into the apartment without much trouble at all.

Great location, in accessible walking distance of the main places we wanted to visit while the appartment is very quiet at the back of the building.  Has all to fill the basic requirements for our stay, we enjoyed, thanks.

Location is the best thing about this place. You are close to both downtown Boston and the fun areas of Cambridge (including Harvard U). The problem is that it feels like a hostel. The rooms are small and very close to each other so not much privacy there. They are also very noisy since Montsignor Highway is a major connector of Cambridge and Boston. (You can hear cars, trucs and car horns pretty much all night). If this place was cheaper, it would have not been a problem, but for the price we paid, there are certainly some better options in Boston.

We were only going to be in town for a few days and this place was just right for us. Our flight was delayed and I let Sean know and he was great about it. He even checked to see if we had made it in. The apartment is small but it worked because we only needed a space to shower and sleep. It's in a really cool neighborhood and there are lots of things nearby. Unfortunately we were there with when there was a lot of snow so we didn't get to walk around much. But anyway, this was a great spot for us and I would definitely stay there again.

First and foremost, Sean was extremely easy to get a hold of and consistently communicate with. He even helped explain how this whole airbnb process worked in a bit of confusion on my end. The Studio was perfect for our stay in Boston as we weren't planning on relaxing indoors too much. The location is great for walking and public transport and there are various food, drink, and shopping options within a block or two of the studio. Staying at the studio can be easily compared to crashing at a friends place. Nothing fancy but it's a safe and comfortable place to recharge. This spot worked out great for our budget and expectations. Sean also was flexible with check in time as traveling emergencies got us in quite late to Boston. We were very happy with our stay and would recommend Sean to any future travelers!

Lawrence was a great host, and the apartment was exactly as I expected. Great location, and he was very responsive to all messages.
Thanks!
The place was as described and even nicer in person. Perfect for 1 or 2 people for a short stay in the north end and in boston in general.

Good host with a great location apartment in Beacon Hill and as described from the listing. The apartment is a historic building and was not very clean but cannot expect a complete clean home from a old building like that. The home came with bare necessities so if you are expecting a fully stocked apartment, it is not. No elevator so stairs up the third floor was pretty narrow  and difficult so if you are a family with a lot of stuff it does get difficult. What we loved most that it was a great location to everything.

I didn't get a chance to meet Hermina, but she was very helpful by sending all relevant information right after the booking. I did meet Donna, the house manager, and she was nice. Check-in and check-out were super easy.

The house is in a very convenient location in Dorchester, within walking distances to the Red line station, some grocery store, and tons of nice Vietnamese restaurants. The room E I booked is a quite small (maybe the smallest room) in the house, but a very cozy one indeed, with a bed, a chest of drawers, and a closet. I wish there were a desk in the room I could use to do some work with my laptop. But I was able to use the living and the table in the dining room so it wasn't a issue. The shared kitchen, dining room, living room, and bathrooms are all very clean. Guests were all quiet and courteous.  In all, it has been a nice experience, and I highly recommend it.

First, the positives, the apartment (we were in Apt. 2), is right next to a police station so you do feel safe.  You are within a five minute walk from the Fields Corner T station and you can be anywhere in Boston in 30 minutes.  You are close to shopping and a very nice restaurant, The Blarney Stone.  Also the beds were comfortable.
Now the negatives, the Dortchester neighborhood is pretty low income, unclean, with half of the storefronts vacant.  It is improving but slowly.  Take a look at the Wiki page for this neighborhood before you rent.  We did, however, feel safe walking around.  The apartment is as pictured, but  was unclean in the kitchen area and the upstairs bathroom.  The towels were thin and used, and there were no washcloths.  The wood flooring in the main level was squishy and we avoided walking on certain areas for fear of breaking it.  The house is Victorian; but this back apartment had no Victorian features.  Also, there is a lack of curtains in the kitchen, upper bath and upper hallway.
Although we had a great trip to Boston and the apartment was habitable, we would not recommend.

The apartment is in an excellent location - central to Back Bay shopping and dining.  Unfortunately, not sure worth the money charged.  The AC unit did nothing to cool the apt, and it was very hot.  Front door was swarming with flies and mosquitoes (I think there's a drain right there), and there were mosquitoes in the apartment.  Cleaning people also came early and had clearly been in the space when I expected to have total privacy.  All in all, great location, but not the best Air BnB experience I've had.

So I will begin with the 2 positive thoughts Great location and Eddy was great( Ahmed's Assitant)
With that being said I would never stay here again. The room was in total construction mode and I was made aware of this the day I arrived even though I booked months ago. The light fixture was dangling, open holes everywhere, dust and debris covered the whole kitchen which made it unusable. I am shocked that Airbnb allows this place to be a representation of them. Ahmed could've notified me ahead of time as I would have prefer to pay more and stay some where else. I also asked if this place had been inspected for asbestos to which I never received an answer. Further more, I will be filing a complaint with the city of Boston as I'm sure they would like to know that city code is being ignored.

Comfortable 3rd floor bedroom within a short walk to stores & public transport. The hostess and her family are very friendly & welcoming. Street parking is available 6 pm to 8 am right out front, but not during the day.
Perfect place not far from downtown; located in a nice neighborhood and close to public transportation; everything went smoothly! Thank you for a perfect stay!

It was great staying with Alexandra - her room is exactly as the pictures portray, and it is very comfortable. She was very welcoming and the place was kept very clean. The room is also just a couple minutes walking to public transportation, both bus and train. Highly recommended!

Jianmin is very friendly and helpful. He is a really good host. 
The room is big with a queen sized bed (140x200cm), a fridge, a couch and your own bath with direct connection to the room. However the last persons stay was still visible and you do not get any light from outside as the 4-5 windows have closed blinds which you cannot reach through the plastic warp over the window.  The room itself is in a beautiful and old house (unfortunately a lot of things are just everywhere standing around).  
In the morning you get breakfast with coffee, orange juice, fruits, toats, oatmeal etc. and you can go outside into a really beautiful area with old buildings and trees. To get to Boston is a little more problematic but if you have a car or bike you can get in 15 mins (car) to the train station "Chestnut Hill"  where you can park for free.

Unfortunately, we can't agree with the many positive reviews. The house was easy to find and just a short 7 minute walk from the T-Station "Airport", but not what I would describe as clean. After arrival I started to clean a bit. E.g. the hob in the spacious kitchen, which you can use including all the inventory(and what's perfect for a nice breakfast), was kind of greasy and that didn't change during our three day stay. Sure this isn't a hotel and the guests are responsible for cleanliness as well, but the host takes a cleaning fee. If they would clean the house on a regular basis, it would be a nice accommodation, as we really liked the premises. Our basement room had a little fridge, a mirror, a tv and a luggage stand what we appreciated. Somehow we missed the "warm welcome" feeling  we experienced at other airbnb locations.

I stayed in this home with two work colleagues during a conference at Harvard Medical School. I'm sure that the T would have made our morning/evening commute shorter, but the 1.5 mile walk through NorthEastern was perfectly fine for us. Having only one bathroom, it was a bit cramped for three coworkers (we were all on the same daily schedule). The house was clean and comfortable, close to many markets and restaurants. Having keyless entry was extremely convenient! During our stay, the pull-out bed was not working, but that was totally fine for me. The back porch was great for relaxing and enjoying breakfast in the summer air.

Izzy was very helpful with directions and he was easy to get in touch with, as I had some questions.  This is a great location that is a short walk to the airport shuttle.  The room is in the basement and it gets hot during the day.  The house has A/C upstairs, but this does not reach the basement room so it was pretty hot.  The neighborhood a little bit ethnic, which I didn't mind, but if this makes you uncomfortable you might want to look elsewhere.  I felt safe, and the lockbox system is secure.  

For a traveler like myself who had an early flight out of Logan, this was the cost effective option.  Can't beat the price for a location so close to the airport!
Great experience to stay here! The host was very nice and free drinks were prepared! Everything was new and clean, and convenient to the downtown! Highly recommended!

Disappointing stay, would not book again. 

Arranged to meet at 130pm, and I arrived early, at 1245, which wasn't a problem, I was content to wait. Aaron's sister didn't show up until 140, though. I was shown into the room and given keys. 

Later that evening, I was informed that I would have to switch rooms--since I had arrived early, the room that I initially booked, the 2nd bedroom, wasn't ready, so I was given the 3rd bedroom as an 'upgrade'.  (I made my Aug 13 reservation on July 30-why the room wasn't ready, I have no idea.) I was informed that other guests would also be staying for the weekend and had booked the larger room. As a courtesy, it would have been nice to know that there would be another party staying at the same time. 

Aaron has two rooms that he rents, which I didn't know until I arrived, and up to 6 people could be staying at any given time. And there's one small (full) bathroom for 6 people to share

The house smelled musty and stale, but the rooms themselves were fine as a place to sleep and shower. The refrigerator smelled TERRIBLE, and there was a smoke detector/carbon monoxide detector/SOMETHING that continually alarmed low battery. We told Aaron about it in the morning, called him to tell him again later that same night, and it STILL wasn't fixed by the time I left. HUGE safety issue

There's a weird pricing scheme going on with the listing for the 2nd bedroom. It's now listed for much less than what I originally paid. I'm not sure what recourse I have regarding this, if any. 

My interaction with Aaron was minimal. I said "good morning" to him one day, that was all the face-to-face interaction I had with him.

Sean was good with communication, it was cheap and for one night worked ok. We did have several problems however. Room really is very small. Arm length and a half wide and two lengths long, clean enough but not sparkling which is ok can't expect too much for 80 a night, but I wouldn't stay there again. I've stayed at the Hostel in Chinatown and although you don't get a private room you still have more space than Sean's place and as a single traveler you'll save 20 bucks. Our biggest problem was in the bed. I laid down and there was no way it was holding us for the night. We literally had to sleep with the mattress on the floor because the plywood and 1x planking couldn't hold us. I'm not small but we aren't huge either. Id say if your going to build a bed do it with materials that will hold weight, 2x4's and posts not extra flooring really poorly put together. Sean should spend the money and go to ikea. Our other problem and this one was awkward was a knock on the door around 1030 am wanting to look at the "apartment" I was in my underwear and well 4 people in that tiny room with me in my undies was a bit awkward. One person one night on a budget ok, but I'd still stay at one of the hostels if traveling alone and honestly with two of us even as a couple it was too small.  We really aren't that picky I promise, it just even for the inexpensive price was not worth the value.

Great location in Back Bay. It makes it easy to see the main sites in Boston and Cambridge. The place is as advertised. The only thing to be aware of is noise. This unit is beside the main entrance of the building and the walls don't offer much of a sound barrier. I'm a fairly deep sleeper but I was awoken both mornings I was there by the sound of the front door closing as people left the building. That said, at this price point (low) in this location (great), I'd still recommend the place to a single traveler that's looking for a no-frills option.

This was a bad experience. DONT BOOK THIS PLACE or any of the other places DROR manages. Getting the keys was a total headache. Because these are rental properties and not actual homes, I had to go to a real-estate office to get keys. Nobody there had any idea who I was and I had to make multiple phone calls to finally get the key. One lady who was supposed to be the emergency number actually hung up on me. Finally a guy in the office who doesn't even work with Dror was able to figure it out. But he was exasperated because apparently this happens a lot. 

Dror wasn't even in the country and was absolutely no help. This is a company, not an individual, regular person like you and I. The apartment is not a home, it's a rental property that nobody cares about. And you are treated like a bothersome client not a guest.
Great host! Very convenient to get to via public transportation. Clean, and very nice apartment. Has AC! Very clear about directions and logistics. Very helpful in accommodating our group.

The owner is very nice and place was very clean when I arrived. That being said, there is a mouse that will visit you. haha I stayed for a week and it was sitting on top of my luggage when I woke up in the morning. The man who was cleaning also left the gas on in the kitchen after he was done. These things aren't the owners fault, but you should consider them when looking to stay here.

Had a great stay here recently. So honored to be their first Airbnb guest. The place was almost complete when I stayed this week but the hosts took some cash of the cost as some minor repairs were still in progress-much appreciated!

This place was adequate with nice hosts. I felt safe and mostly comfortable (comfortable bed, clean). However as other reviewers have mentioned it is the least private room available in this accommodation. So I was kept up one night from other guests talking and walking around. Early check in is not simple as the host works and the hostess needs to clean the room by herself so best checking in a little later. Great stay for people who like hostels and want extra privacy. Not as good for someone who usual stays in hotels.

Pros:

1. Host was very responsive and accommodating with my schedule.
2. Apartment was clean, modern and spacious. Great for a group.
3. Great location.

Cons:
1. Having to go to a different address to pick up the keys was a bit of a hassle. A lockbox at the apartment would be easier.
2. The apartment was a bit difficult to find- set apart in a little courtyard. Took quite a bit of searching.
3. Was woken up at 7am by very loud construction next door that persisted for an hour.
4. No towel rack in bathroom. Toilet paper holder fell off the wall.

We had a great time in Boston and we loved this place.
Its an awesome apt and very well located.
Nice and clean room! Nice and quiet neighborhood! Didn't get a chance to see the host but I enjoyed my stay!

The apartment was very spacious and accommodated our group of five during Boston Marathon weekend. Street parking was safe and remained lit at night, the T was super close and glad to see that Zip Car was available for a future stay. Alisa and Kacey were friendly, answering my questions promptly and providing convenient check-in and out. My only negatives:
- A cat lives there, and with horrible allergies, I required medication during our whole weekend. :(
- The fridge and freezer were pretty full, so it was tough for us to fit our groceries in there. 
- The range, oven and microwave were pretty messy upon arrival.

Lauren was a good host. She and her flatmates were very friendly and helpful, and they were cool with our weird arrival time.

The room was small, but that was fine for us for a short stay. The bed was three mattresses piled on top of each other, but was comfortable enough.

The bathroom wasn't super clean, but the shower was very nice. There's a laundry place just down the corridor in the building that's easy to access and cheap enough ($2 for a wash, $2 for a dry).

Overall we liked staying at Lauren's.
Nice stay at Helen's apartment. We found what was described on the announce. Helen answered quickly to all of our question and was nice with us. The apartment would be cleaner.

Sean was pleasant, helpful and easy to get a hold of.  The apartment is in an accessible location by all means of transport with a great family-style restaurant on the corner (Mama's Place).  I recommend you confirm your check-in and check-out time with him prior to your arrival (I forgot).  

My only complaints:  room is a bit different from how it's pictured and the apartment is in need of some serious cleaning.

This was an excellent place to stay. East Boston is a nice place I felt safe coming home at night, but if it was late I took a cab. I would definitely stay here again. It was exactly as it was described on the website. Easy to use the subway to downtown =D

Reviewing this property is a bit difficult because the apartment is not actually owned by Kitty Franklin of Seamless Transition. She acts only as an agent. She simply books with a corporate housing company and takes her cut. The apartments in the building come in various styles and you don't get to specifiy which you want. Ms. Franklin was rude each time I interacted with her via email and on the phone and she even went so far as to say that she was "doing me a favor" by charging $1800 for a 3 night stay. Save yourself the hassle and ripoff and book (email hidden). I highly recommend the apartment, but stay far away from Seamless Transition. 

The apartment itself (I ended up with the second apartment that you see in the pictures) is nice enough. Small elevator in the lobby. Many small things wrong with the place (holes in dry wall, hot water takes forever to get hot, kitchen light was dangling from the dry wall on the ceiling, etc.) Location is great and there is street, metered parking.

Laura was a lovely host and I very much enjoyed my experience while in the area. The apartment was tidy and in a great location, walking distance from many college campuses and close to the T station. The cat, Lucky, is very playful and interactive, adding a homey feel to the environment. It perfectly fit my needs, and I would recommend this option to those visiting the Boston area.

The place is cozy. Great location, close to subway, center city, beach and everything. Quiet at night. We walked back from subway at 11, still plenty of ppl. Parking could be intense but you can definitely find a spot within walking distance.
The apartment was very clean and well-stocked with fresh sheets, pillows, and towels. It's quite well-appointed for a basement apartment and the park is just as close as it looks!

I had a mixed experience staying at Federico's apartment, though much of the stay was very enjoyable. The apartment was clean, comfortable and centrally located.  Alex, Federico's roommate, was unfailingly gracious and offered to be available throughout our stay if there was anything we needed. Staying at the apartment made it easy for my colleague and me to attend a meeting at nearby Suffolk Law School.  We enjoyed the time we were able to spend in Boston.

However, in some ways, staying at the apartment was more stressful than it should have been.  When I contacted Federico via email the day before arriving to ask how to get keys to the apartment, he replied that his landlord didn't allow him to lease out the apartment, and so we couldn't stay there. Since this exchange happened two weeks after Federico had accepted my request to stay, and two weeks after I'd paid for the apartment, I was surprised to learn the day before my meeting that I had no place to stay in Boston.  Five minutes later Federico contacted me again to say that he might be able to host me after all; he needed to confer with his landlord.  Then, he asked me to contact his roommate Alex.  An hour or so later, Alex let me know that I could stay in the apartment, but that I couldn't tell the landlord, who managed a restaurant downstairs, and was often in the street outside the apartment, that we were from Airbnb. Instead we should claim to be his personal friends.  This was a small lie, and in fact we were never confronted by the landlord.  Still, having to be alert for the landlord made the whole experience feel shadier than it should have. Despite having paid for the apartment, I felt as if I were sneaking in.  

In the end, I was glad that Federico and Alex were able to put us up, and I know it wasn't easy for them to clean the apartment at the last minute and find another place to stay.  Still, I spent a frantic half-hour trying to find another place to stay in Boston the day before I arrived, and I never really felt right about sneaking into and out of the apartment.  It's a nice place, and Alex was very helpful during our stay, but after agreeing to host us and receiving payment, Federico really should have let me know earlier if he was no longer willing, or no longer permitted, to accommodate us in his apartment.

I was assigned to a different apartment from what the pics depict. It was in the very same building though. I loved the location, the apartment was smaller than I expected but it was OK. My biggest problem was the INTERNET which was really really slow and I had to go to Starbucks (couple of blocks walking) every day to get a decent internet connection.

Everything was perfect!. We really loved the room and the house, it is really confortable. The neighberhood is lovely and very quiet. The blue line is very close to the house so it is very easy to get to downtown and all the typical places.
The guys were quick to respond and accommodate my arrival, the location was just fine, and easy to find. Apartment fair and clean. I would stay here again.

Both Christina and Drew were there to welcome me at the apartment.  They gave me a few great tips about where to eat locally and how to get around Boston.  The room faces onto the main road and is therefore quite noisy but I was given ear plugs and slept very well.  The room itself is small but as I was only there to sleep, I really didn't mind. The apartment was clean and tidy.  Also an additional thoughtful touch - Drew also wrote out a list of places to eat in Portland, Maine, which was my next destination, which is was really lovely and useful.
The room was exactly what I was looking for- clean and comfortable.  Right next to the room the owner has a wonderful plant and fish collection, quite pleasant!

Had a great stay here, the best part has to be the location. Walking distance to most places and has a subway stop 5 minutes walk away. The room was spotless and the bathroom was kept well. I would definitely stay here again. The only problem I had was the bed being a little uncomfortable - nothing I couldn't get past and given the price and all the other positive aspects of this stay - not something worth not coming back for! The host was very responsive and very easy to contact as well.

Great location. Facility was very clean and had all the amenities needed for a short stay. My only issues were that the room and bathroom were smaller than I expected and the heat tended to make some noise.

Izzy's place was very convenient and well located, the room was clean and big enough for a comfy bed and a desk. Common areas were great too, I loved the patio the most. Only thing was that, due to the extreamly hot weather, the AC had to stay on all night and unfortunately it's very noisy. . Hadn't the chance to meet Izzy, but was in good company with a few other guests. Overall a nice stay, I suggest the place.

The studio was clean and convenient. Best for 1 but there is a trundle bed and that worked well for the 2 of us. The apartment is light, everything worked, and the small kitchenette was handy. Sean communicates well and is easy to work with.

I spent almost two weeks at Donna's apartment in Beacon Hill.  The apartment was cozy, clean and comfortable and is in a fantastic location right up on the top of the hill.  The building has the air of classic old Boston.  The neighborhood is great for walking and there are lots of shops nearby.  I'd recommend Donna's place to anyone who wants to stay in the area.

Andy is wonderful. The location is golden - the T is right in front of the house. The apartment is very well-kept and clean. The rooms are neat and there is AC available. The kitchen has the necessary items to cook. He was very helpful in terms of providing utilities - we were able to use the hairdryer (provided by Andy) and needles (upon request). The bathroom is small but neat. This is an excellent choice for families traveling for a little while in Boston.

Shivam was super easy to do business with, and was incredibly responsive. The unit is in a great area - my worries about constant sirens proved not to be true. Unit was exactly what we needed! I would definitely use Shivam again on future trips. He even offered to ship something back to me that I accidentally left at the apartment. Great service, great trip.

The apartment was adorable and clean. It had a great view of Fenway park and was in a fantastic location. It was a great place for us to spend the night but would not recommend for someone needing somewhere during the day. We had to leave our things in the apartment when it was not yet cleaned from the guests the night before.

I didn't meet Izzy, but his roommate was very nice and helpful.
The room is in a very good condition, clean and you have enough space. The location is safe and close to the metro station, it is very easy to find the house.

Taskin is great host...had a chance to chat with him few times. I had a  comfortable stay at his place and had enough privacy, he also provided clean linen each time I checked in. The bathroom was fairly clean. It's not a very fancy place but a decent one to stay. 10 mins walk from the T station.

Andy was very helpful and always available. He provided us with high chairs and other items for our children. The area is nice with a nearby pond and playground. Very easy connection to Boston university areas and city centre.
Cindy made me feel exceptionally welcome, the room feels very homely! It's a nice neighbourhood and good access to the touristy stuff.
Very amazing basement. Like an old house of a castle. And the location is good though it took us a little time to find the apartment court.

This is in a good neighborhood, nice and quiet. Minutes walk from greenline transit and Hynes Center. 
The space itself is clean and comfortable, great for one or two. The owner was very helpful, after a rough day of travel he responded quickly to point me in the right direction when I needed it.

This sunny studio was cozy, clean and comfortable in a great location.  The building is very quiet.  Ellen and I communicated by text so that I could get the key.  The bike was a bit elderly but functional and enabled me to get to my meeting at the other end of Cambridge in time.

Slight difficulty in gaining early access despite assurance at booking that bags could be left early. Great location but disappointed that bed linen not available at 5pm.
Kitchen tap tripped constantly throughout our stay & very difficult to sleep with the noise of such. Host was advised by sms of this problem but never responded.
Bernie was a great host and the apartment was perfect! Excellent location in walking distance to parks and all the great sites and shopping I boston.

Sean was friendly and always answered quickly. The apartment was as advertised. We found free parking on the North side of the bridge, which is a 10 minute walk away, not too far if you've previously unloaded all the bags.

Kai was an excellent host. Although we didn't meet Kai he was very responsive to all my text before and during our stay in his room. The room was exactly as described and very good in terms of everything.  The location was excellent, near the T and inexpensive rides in Uber or Lyft to basically anywhere. Convenience stores nearby, walking distance to Fenway Park.  Although Kai has a roommate she was friendly and we didn't see her a lot in our trip. Its near a couple of campuses, so you definitely get the college feel in the area. Overall our experience was great and would definitely stay here again when visiting Boston.
Great place. New and very well appointed apartment. Just a five-minute walk from the T station and on the same block as the very convenient no1 bus.

Didn't meet Dror As he was away , but his team organised the key pickup , which worked out okay. Managed to park hire care on the street whilst we unpacked.  

The apartment was fine but for a maximum of a couple with two children only . Too small for 4 adults. The two flights of steep and narrow stairs was a great challenge.

Jose's apartment was perfect for my needs. The location is terrific; it is set far from the street and underground, so is very quiet; and Jose is an understanding and accommodating host. I stayed 4 nights and did not encounter any problems.  Unlike other guests, I found the mattress to be comfortable. I slept easily, no problem. I highly recommend!

Great location in the middle of everything. Easy walk to downtown, hospitals, MIT, Harvard and Fenway. A simple bachelor crash pad, clean and comfortable. Better location than most of the pricey downtown hotels we usually stay at. Easy local restaurants and grocery stores. Will try to stay with Ben again.

It is unpleasant experience in Boston. The apartment is far away with the description. Old and not hygiene. The bed sheet and quilt cover seems not changed very often. After I complained, the landlord got new beddings for us. But still feel bad. Nobody clean the trash and change the washing towel except you made a special request.  a huge cockroach was fond and made us scared.
Very responsive and easy to deal with!

What a great place!  Fantastic location and super warm.  The noise did not bother us at all.  The apartment had everything we needed and was lovely.  If ever in boston again I would definitely like to stay here and have already recommended it to a friend who is going there in a few months.
Thank you Jason and Jose!

Monica's room was just what I needed.  Really close to the airport, confortable, clean, really nice.  Monica didn't mind that my flight landed after 12 at night, which was of course very helpful.  She was totally cool with me working for a while on her living room desk next morning and her restaurant next door is a real gem.

Tom was in contact as soon as I arrived in Boston, so see if I needed anything.  Access to the apartment was easy and convenient.  The location of the apartment is perfect for many things to do in Boston (and convenient to a T stop, for access to many more).  It's a small studio apartment, but I only needed a place to sleep, so it was perfect.  (P.S.--The water pressure in the shower is fantastic.)

Well sized room for two people with the basic necessities which also included a mini fridge. Our room, the common areas and bathrooms were clean when we arrived. There were good kitchen facilities but we did not have to use them. 

Overall good value for a location that is close enough to downtown Boston.
Sean was once again a great host. He is very accommodating and Boston again was wonderful over new years. The studio is quaint and it is on the first floor which is nice.
Christine is a nice girl, and very helpful of my stay. She had picked me up to the airport. The house is very convenient , just 15 minutes to downtown. I had enjoyed my stay.
It was everything we need! Thanks for the great stay ;)
The apartment was clean and the perfect accommodations for our trip to Boston. Steven was quick to respond to any messages I sent. We really enjoyed staying here. I would highly recommend it!

Great apartment in the North End.  Awesome location close to everything.  Very clean and comfortable beds.  Lots of room for the family.  A little bit of a challenge with the suitcases to go up two flights of stairs, but worth the while to be so close to all of the rich history, restaurants and activities in the North End.  Easy and streamline process for check in, and it was so nice to leave our luggage in the storage area while we enjoyed sightseeing on our last day.  We would stay here again.

Anthony was terrific, very gracious and a great communicator. He was also very accommodating in meeting my difficult schedule. The apartment is cozy, clean and comfortable, with my only complaint being the shower, which is very small (I'm 6', 170 lbs and that's about the maximum for a person in that shower stall).  That aside, the location is great, the unit is quiet and very convenient.  Overall, a very nice experience.  Thanks!

Very simple, but it suits us well for one night (2 adults and 2 kids).
Very well located, in the lovely Beacon Hill!
Close to many things to visit, 15 minutes walk from good italian restaurants and 2 minutes from a supermarket.
Sean was really reactive to come back to give us the keys in the afternoon and easy to communicate.
Rob was responsive, and thoughtful, and flexible when I arrived much later than expected. Nice, high ceilings in a historic rowhouse only a block away from the Amtrak station.

The location is fantastic.

The place needs some work.

More than one towel. Real bed.  Lights.

Well located and clean, a good place to stay while in Boston for those looking for a more refined hotel suite like experience.

My only complaint would be that I kept getting revised check-in information which ended up getting mixed up among email from airbnb and the host directly. When I called to get clarification the person on the other end of the phone was quite rude to me.

The room had a significant amount of sound bleed from the street throughout the night, and the mattress on the floor was not very comfortable. I anticipated some of this because of the low price. 

The biggest concern, however, was that I was charged a $53 cleaning fee. I found obvious evidence that the room had not been cleaned. There were mouse feces and clipped toenails on the floor and in the closet. The shared bathroom had thick layers of dirt and hair - clearly it had not been cleaned for some time.  This was a huge problem and as a result I cannot recommend this booking to anyone else.

This was the first time we had used Airbnb with the hopes of saving some money. We understood that we were not getting a private room in a hotel, but there were some major issues with our stay. Cleanliness was one of our biggest gripes. The kitchen was a disaster with dirty dishes, beer bottles, and trash everywhere. The room was a little untidy but the biggest issues were the dirty sheets on the bed and there being only one pillow for the two of us. It just seemed like hosting guests here was an afterthought especially with the host out of town. The listing description was misleading and this definitely had a "college off-campus house" feel that caught us off guard. The positive was that her roommates were very nice and helpful. One of them let us borrow some clean sheets, towels and an extra pillow. She was also helped let us get into the apartment late at night when we accidentally lost the key. On the downside of that though, we were constantly surrounded by the smell of weed from their rooms, the living room, or the deck. There was also an issue of music blaring through the house at one point, but in fairness I don't think they knew we were there. We had booked for 3 nights but decided it'd be best to go elsewhere on our last night. I can see this being a spot for a college kid that needs a place to crash for the night but really nothing more than that.

Our experience here was amazing! Hermina wasn't around but her and Donna were very helpful with our questions, and checking up to make sure everything was going well. The neighbourhood is alright, the best thing is that the house is very close to the T and a few shops and restaurants. The house itself is very comfortable, it was just a bit hot in the summer. Also, be aware that the Boston Police are right behind the house, so you're safe but there is a chance of noise late at night. Overall our stay here was very enjoyable, a perfect place to come home to.
Great location.  Walking distance to Fenway, hospitals, grocery store and restaurants.  Apartment as advertised.  Property manager Eddie was extremely helpful and accomodating.  Thanks very much.
Stayed two nights. Very clean. Had a small but cozy room. Great to park free on the street. The others in the home were very quiet. I would definitely stay again!

Tom met us at the front door and showed us through the apartment. He was gracious and accommodating. This was our first experience with Airbnb so we were cautious about participating. Some of the other guests had traveled extensively with Airbnb with mostly great results, so we look forward to the next time we can use Airbnb
Flexible and nice service. Clean and well-lighted room. The location is perfect to visit any other area.  Tiffany is kind and great host! !
Great place. Quinn is very helpful, the room is very spacious and clean, the subway is just around the corner.

Host was friendly in initial emails and in person when we got there. The host provided a bountiful number of food items including milk, breakfast rolls, fruit and orange juice. The place was clean. 

It was described as a few steps up. But, there are 6 steps up to the front door, then 16 more up to the second floor and the door to the apartment.

The building is quite old and looks old with peeling exterior paint. The neighborhood is not good although we had no problems. The host came by and showed us where they provide parking in a private fenced lot.
Shawn was helpful & easy to get in touch with. The apartment was small, but cute & everything we needed. The neighborhood was fine. Close to Tstop.

Christopher was a very accommodating host. The place I was going to stay in Boston fell through last minute the day I was arriving. Christopher got back to my reservation request within minutes and worked out all the details easily. The apartment was in a great location, walking distance from great pubs and restaurants like the Green Dragon and Bell in Hand. The Starbucks and Au Bon Pain just around the corner were perfect for morning coffee as well!

 The air conditioning situation was a little odd as the unit only fit in the bathroom window, but it worked just fine. There weren't many utensils in the kitchen, but we had the essentials like cups for water. There was also a blow dryer, which I appreciated. It was also very clean! Overall, it was a perfect place for a weekend getaway.

We rented from Anthony for a weekend in Boston, and found his Condo exactly as he posted. The building/unit is definitely older, however it was all we needed.

- Check-in/Checkout: Used a lockbox close to the apartment so zero issues here, and Anthony let us leave late as our flight was late.
-Cleanliness: The place was spotless, including the bathroom.
-Bathroom: Clean, shower was very very small but had good hot water/pressure. The shower did drip some, but that's minor. 
-Kitchen: We didn't use it much, but seemed relatively well stocked for minor cooking. 
-Location/Neighborhood: Lovely neighborhood. Beautiful, quiet, but close to Beacon Hill bars/restaurants. Less than 10 minutes to Boston Common, 20 minutes from North End. Can walk to all the major tourist attractions. 
-Wifi: Worked perfectly, no (email hidden): The only slight downside was there was only one AC unit for the entire apartment, which was requested that we turn off when we left. It would take about an hour for the apartment to cool down once we got back. Now, we happened to be in Boston for one of the hottest weekends of the year, so this likely won't be an issue most other times.
Nice place, safe, friendly, and helpful host. Will definitely stay here again.

I needed a last-minute place to crash and Izzy's place was perfect. He's a great host and this is a clean place with a nice setup. It's also down the street from a fantastic Italian place called "Rino's." Recommended.

The room looked just like the picture.  The bathroom was a little bit dirty but to be expected for such a small space.  I did have some trouble communicating with the host.  I asked the address and ended up going back through emails to find it and so I was late to check in.  The host did not meet me there it was another man. I got a text from her asking where I was and the gentleman who let me in seemed to be very frustrated.  I would have liked to see a more professional approach in communication.

Our host, Steve, received us very well. Not only did he guide us to the room and made us aware of all the subtle nuances and conditions of how to go about our stay, he gave a rundown of the amenities and asked if we needed any help or had any questions for him in regards to our stay. He was a very gracious host in providing us our needs such as blankets and water and other amenities to enjoy for our stay.

When problems arose he was quick to address it and correct it. The listing was accurate and I had no surprises coming into this lodging.

Overall I had a very positive experience and would recommend doing airbnb at this place if I happen to be in Boston again.

We had a great stay at Sean's. We needed a place for the night and for that purpose it was perfect. It is a small apartment but with all you need and a comfortable bed. It's close, 3 minutes, to the train that takes you to town and it's a good vibe in the neighbourhood with restaurants and bars.

We didn't meet Sean but his was great in giving guidance and did reply fast. Also he was flexible with check out when we had a late check in at our other stay.
Room is clean. Good for crashing for the night.
Steve is a friendly and kind person, Fields Corner Station in the red line is just 3 block from house and 20 minutes to downtwon, the neighborhood is safe and quiet.
Helen's place is nice and clean. Everything's pretty good except that there's no AC in the room.

This was our first Airbnb experience and was really very good.Michelle´s house is very nice and tidy and very close to the subway.We were six and we were very confortable.Michelle also laid out some great tourist information to get us started.All in all , a perfect trip.

We enjoyed our stay in the apartment very much - clean, well-equipped. Alan's agent/manager Eddie greeted us and provided a lot of handy info. Superb location - we walked to the symphony, the Isabella Stewart Gardner museum, Newbury Street, etc. Parkland surrounds the neighborhood on three sides, so the neighborhood is very quiet. 

A minor flaw was the building front door key. It typically took 15-20 seconds of jiggling the key in the lock. It didn't affect us much but other guests may be more frustrated. A key copied off the lock (rather than another key) would probably help.

David's place is really close to the station, which was really convenient (especially in the polar vortex cold). His apartment's located on the top floor, so you'll need to climb a few flights of stairs to get there. We had small luggages so it was a pretty decent walk up. 

The room was comfy, provided with sufficient blankets, hangers in the wardrobe, but just one towel. The walls were really thin though, so we could hear everything from the other room! If you need absolute silence when sleeping, you can use the earplugs that David provides. There is only one bathroom shared among the three rooms, but it was fine for us when we were there. 

Overall, it was a pretty good stay. Thanks for hosting us!

Greg was a nice guy. He definitely made us feel welcome and offered us to use any/all of the amenities his condo had to offer. The roof top deck was my favorite part. I wish the description was more accurate. The listing said there were 2 bedrooms with 2 separate beds. Granted, our host was moving within the week overseas, but then his profile should have been updated saying so. For the price I paid, 2 blow up mattress, (one that had a hole in it) and no furniture was not my ideal setup for a vacation. I do feel we should have been reimbursed some of the money we spent. All in all, it was a place to sleep which is really all we needed for our short stay.

Miss Franklin is prompt and professional. The apartment was everything that it claimed to be. Comfortable and clean.
Thank you.
Needed a place last minute, which was no problem! Great location and fair price:) Thanks a lot!

I lived here during 3 weeks. My host was very helpful and was a beginner with AirBNB. His place has improved a lot during these 3 weeks. I felt really like at home and could cook as much as I wanted. The room was very confortable.
On the map, the room seems far from the center but there are frequent buses and finally it was quite easy to reach my work place.
I enjoyed my stay a lot!

We had a great time experiencing Boston and this is a perfect location! Lawrence was incredibly responsive and friendly. The apartment is as described in the listing and reviews. The apartment could use a few updates, but if only staying for a short time and planning to be out and about it is a great place to stay! We would definitely stay here again!

Steven's place is in a great location, just around the corner from the Orange Line.  He was flexible with our arrival and departure times, very easy to work out all the details.  His space is in an older building, best suited for 1-2 people.  I'd say it may not be for everyone and is probably more comfortable for younger travelers.

This was a great place to stay in Boston, especially if you're going to see the Red Sox. Eddie was a brilliant host, so friendly and with very helpful tips on getting round the city and good restaurants and bars etc. Whole booking process and checking in couldn't have been easier. The apartment was clean and neighbourhood safe and very quiet. Wifi fast and reliable. Perfect space for two people and rollaway bed pretty comfy. Would definitely recommend!!
Thanks for making us so welcome and all the help from you and Neil.  Dianne and Edwin
Good place to sleep and take a shower! Good located and connected to the city! But the bathroom is very small and not so clean!

I really appreciated staying at Islams place. It was clean, the neighbourhood was save and the appartment is located close to downtown. Furthermore, his brother, who also stayed at the house during my visit, took care of me by giving me a ride to different sight seeing places and helped me out if I had any questions or needed some help. It was a lot of fun! So I definitely recommend to anybody, who is planning a trip, to stay at Islams house and have an enjoyable time!

My first impression while getting the keys was not good, the instruction by the host was not clear and had to walk with my luggage to get them. Sean is responsive and replies back in a minute. The greatest thing is the location. I liked the tuned piano and the window in the bathroom too. The apartment is old and needs to be renovated as some previous guests mentioned. However, he put several decors and items such as old books and typewriter to look the apartment more classical and it was not bad. I can't recommend others but for me, I would stay again if I visit next time.

Tiffany and her staff were all very responsive to any inquires and requests.  They were all cheerful and pleasant to deal with.  The building, the room and the bathrooms were all clean.  I already have another reservation at this property for my next trip to Boston.
Another great night in Izzy's clean and cozy place - thanks!

We had a great experience at Alexandra's place! Nice room and great hospitality - there was coffee in the kitchen and a nice binder of information about local spots, parking, and details of the place. Room is exactly how it looks and very clean. Only complaint is one bathroom for up to three rooms of guests -- had to wait a couple times, but not a big deal at all! Highly recommend this spot!
Amoy made sure everything was taken care of. The room and bathroom were clean, and I had a towel and sheets when I arrived late from the airport.  Thank you again.

The location is great, there is a T-stop practically right outside the front door, great places to eat, get coffee, groceries and just about anything else right around the corner. Sean is a great host, very helpful and responsive. The place is a bit small, but it's also cheaper than the average airbnb place, and a good deal for a student/professional visiting Boston for work.

Christine was very helpful, she went out her way for us. She picked us up at the airport on the day of our arrival, which we greatly appreciated. She also got her dog to stay with a friend, because we were scared. 
The location is very convenient, it is a 15 mn walk to the city. Just take the Harbor Walk, it is very nice.
On the dark side, the room is next to a highway so it is very noisy. Also the place is not clean (not only the bedroom but also the bathroom).
Our overall impression is that the price does not match the experience, by far.

Great location, good communicator. But the place really is a college dorm with share bathroom with two other roommates. Bathroom was not clean and ran out of toilet paper.his room wasn't clean ( may not bother a young man, his own drity laundry still in the hamper!)
Bernie's place was great. A few blocks from the Copley and Hynes T stations. Great for short stays, and if you don't plan on doing any cooking.

Listing as described. clean, spacious room with large couch, TV an A/C.  Aaron accommodated a late arrival and was friendly. showed me the unit and I have absolutely no complaints. quiet neighborhood. accessible to all of Boston. would def stay again!
I had a great stay. The apartment is in an absolutely fantastic location. The check-in directions were very clear and easy to follow. Sean was very responsive.

We really enjoyed our stay at Islams house. From the outside the house didn't look so inviting but the inside was very nice! Even though Islam himself was not there everything was prepared for our arrival. The airport T Station is only a 5-10 min walk away. The only little issue was that all the people in the house had to share one bathroom. But it was not really a problem and it worked out fine. We would recommend Islams place for a stay in Boston.

Sean was an excellent host- quick to respond & available when we needed. He gave us pointers on exploring Boston & let us use his bike- both were much appreciated! The apartment is in a great location, easy to get to from the airport (a few blocks from the Blue Line subway), & had what we needed. We would stay here again in the future.

The  location is a quick walk to the subway station and a quick train ride to downtown Boston. You can have cafe fee. But I think there should be more furniture in the room. At least a desk and a bigger sofa. In the bath room there should be a shampoo.

Mr.Quinn was a great host. He provided everything I need. And I mean everything! Very helpful and kind. Apartment might look slum from the outside but inside is clean and well taken care of. Parking might be difficult during work days but easy at night.

Jay was very accommodative regarding check in and out, and he provided information about the surrounding area. He was also available anytime for assistance, if needed. Apartment location was great for my activities at Northeastern, as well as for access to the T.

My intention was to experience boston like a local... And that I did. My expectations were exceeded. What a great suburb. Close to t station and walking distance to river, parks, shops etc. The condo was.... Fun! First time experience with AirBnB and would definitely do it again. The host was very helpful and friendly. 10/10

We had excellent prearrival communication, and the apartment is just as advertised. You cannot overstate the convenience and character of the location. Beacon hill. Close to the T, close to biking (hub way rental - excellent) the esplanade, countless choices for food and drink. 

 We imbibed Boston and were very happy with this choice. Thank you Larry for a great stay.

Communication and location were great. 
However, the apartment was not clean. The bed sheets looked used and unwashed. There was no light in the apartment. 
Unless you are desperate, I would not stay here.

Karla was very easy to contact and keep in touch with. She answered all of our questions. Her room mates were very friendly and helpful. The apartment is easy walking distance to transportation and we found it simple to get around.
The house is very clean and it is very close to subway station. It takes just 10 minutes to downtown by subway.

Sean was very helpful with all of my questions, and very patient when I had "issues" with the key (my fault!). The location was great for us, short walk to the Green Line subway, and walking distance to many restaurants and shops.
Super friendly host and his dog is super cute and smart. The room was clean and neat. I had everything I need for my stay. Ohh, Andrew's coffee was good too.

Dror called very quickly and gave me friendly, thorough information.   The apartment needs some love.   The sofas appeared heavily used and discolored and I was not comfortable enough to sit on them, and the dinning table chairs were stiff and mismatched.   There was no place I was comfortable.  There was no interior lock on the front door and, being a woman staying alone, whenever people walked by in the hall I was a bit uncomfortable.  The bathroom was small but adequate and clean - there were no hand towels.  The kitchen was clean and much nicer than in the photo.  The location is great and this would be a nice place to stay if someone would make a trip to Ikea and spent $3-4k on new some furniture.     With additional fees I ended up spending $374 for one night.
The place was clean and in reasonable condition. Close to a good small grocery. A 15 minute walk to a bunch of restaurants. A fine spot for 2-3 people. Parking is tough.

This home was in a really great location in Boston as it was conveniently nearby the Boston Common, Faneuil Hall, a T station, and a nice assortment of restaurants and cafes. The house itself is definitely spacious with its three stories and two bedrooms/bathrooms and it had a lovely, cozy, rustic feel to it. The kitchen seemed well-stocked with supplies and we had no issues with wifi. The host was also flexible with check-out time. 

However, as the house seemed relatively old, there were some maintenance issues. Unfortunately, the heating was broken the first day we got there (which was painful as it was snowing that weekend) - while the host got us space heaters the second night, we were a bit bummed that she didn't treat our comfort as a higher priority. The locks were often difficult to work with, as it usually took several attempts to lock and unlock the doors. The hot water also sometimes didn't last long enough for a 5-10 minute shower and a few lights were broken in the house. In addition, the shower in the basement also did not have adequate drainage and the laundry machine was not functioning on the last day of our stay.

I stayed here for a week and everything went smoothly.  The room was very clean and quiet and the fridge in the room was very convenient.  I did not meet Ari but he was always available via message if I needed him.

Clean, toiletries and towels provided, amazing location right near Newbury St., and the code entry was really convenient to use. It was basically sort of like a hotel stay -- there wasn't much in the way of a host, but it's great if you prefer more of a hotel type experience.

I stayed at Federico’s for little over 2 weeks, until I could move into my new apartment. It was a great choice and probably actually “your best option.”

Location: 
     The place is in the harbor point apartment complex. It is right by the water, so I could walk about a minute and visit a bench or a walkway right by Boston harbor. Pretty nice view of the skyline and planes taking off and landing at Logan Airport. There is also a beach nearby. 
     I had to commute to downtown everyday, and it was very easy to get in and out of the city. JFK/UMass redline T station was about 8-minute walk from the door, and I could get to downtown in about 20-25 minutes (total, including the walk to the station) and Cambridge in around 30 minutes. The JFK library was also within walking distance. Another convenient thing about harbor point was that there were couple Zipcars across the street from Federico’s apartment, and South Bay Shopping Center was about a short 5 minute drive. The shopping center has everything you can possibly need; there is a Shaw’s, Stop and Shop, Target, Best Buy, Home Depot, TJ Maxx, Office Depot, etc. and even couple restaurants… like Panera, Applebee’s, and Olive Garden. It was perfect for me, since I had to buy couple things for my apartment before moving in. 

Apartment: 
I had my own room and my own bathroom. The room was a pretty good size with a small desk (and a desk lamp), a large dresser, a huge closet, and a queen bed. There was central heat/air conditioning thing that I could control for my own room. Everything was very nice and clean. In-unit laundry made my life so much easier. Internet, a TV, a nice kitchen and a living room… nothing bad to say about the place. 

My Experience: 
	I initially felt pretty bad, because the only flight I could get on landed in Boston close to 2 in the morning… but Federico was cool with it and even offered to pick me up. Federico and Flavia were very welcoming, friendly, and fun. When I got home, they often asked me to join them for meals… Flavia is an amazing cook.
